title: AVP, Data, Analytics & AI Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Role:

The AVP, Data, Analytics & AI Engineering is the executive leader responsible for the strategic vision, architecture, development, and scaling of our enterprise data platforms and AI solutions. This individual will lead a team tasked with turning enterprise data assets into high-performance, compliant, and secure intelligence frameworks that drive automation and strategic decision-making across the entire company. The role bridges the gap between modern cloud data stack engineering and emerging AI paradigms (like LLMOps and Agentic workflows). This individual will ensure that Anaplan engineering standards drive direct, measurable business value while maintaining top-tier data security, governance and responsible AI practices.

Your Impact

This is a critical role that requires an executive and organizational leader with a high degree of enterprise transformation leadership, discretion, and the ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, sales-driven, SaaS environment. This individual will work directly with the CFO, CRO, CHRO, CIO and Product leaders while building a high-performance engineering team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create Advanced Analytics/Decision Intelligence driving predictive analytics, propensity, forecasting, experimentation, causal thinking, optimization.
  • GenAI/Agent Engineering that is essential to the enterprise agent strategy – MCP, RAG, embeddings/vector search, tool calling, agent architecture, evaluation, grounding, orchestration. Architect and govern the Enterprise Agentic AI Strategy, deploying multi-agent frameworks and LLM-powered tools at scale.
  • Architect and deploy enterprise-grade multi-agent AI systems for complex, multi-step workflows, integrating with ERP, CRM, and ITSM to automate high-value decisions end-to-end.
  • Design internal AI tools and agents (e.g., AI Finance Bot, domain-specific LLM applications) and lead the roadmap for next-generation agentic platforms as emerging capabilities mature.
  • Drive Data Governance & AI Readiness – quality, lineage, observability, catalog, access controls, PII, retention, AI data governance.
  • Provide business context to a Semantic & Context Architecture with metrics layer, business ontology, entity relationships, metadata, knowledge graphs/semantic models.
  • Scale the team – build, mentor, motivate and lead high-performance team across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and AI Engineering.
  • Partner collaboratively with business units, product teams, security, legal and compliance teams to deliver AI and data solutions that align to enterprise goals.
  • Drive Anaplan beyond pipelines feeding dashboards into a Modern Data Architecture environment.

Your Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Math or a highly quantitative field of study.
  • Leadership experience of 12+ years in data and software engineering environments, with at least 5 years in a senior manager or executive role leading cross-functional teams.
  • Strong familiarity with core technical stack - cloud data ecosystems (eg. Snowflake, Databricks, Vertex AI, AWS Sagemaker).
  • Experience moving to modern data architecture environment, with Deep Datawarehouse/lakehouse (AWS Redshift, Databricks), streaming/batch, APIs, data products, ELT, CDC, structured + unstructured data experience.
  • Proven experience with AI/ML engineering and success deploying ML models into production, feature engineering, model serving, monitoring, MLOps.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex agentic systems, context-engineering strategies, and distributed database details into clear, business-relevant narratives for non-technical and executive boards.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Backend Engineer, AI Systems
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs for AI-powered applications

  • Develop inference orchestration systems that connect LLMs, application services and external tools

  • Design APIs for streaming responses, asynchronous processing and real-time interactions

  • Improve system performance through caching, batching, concurrency and database optimisation

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and error handling for production services

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues involving latency, service failures and high traffic

  • Work with ML, frontend and mobile engineers on API design, system integration and deployment

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of backend software engineering experience building production systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Node.js or similar backend technologies

  • Experience designing and maintaining REST or gRPC APIs, databases and distributed services

  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, concurrency, caching and message queues

  • Experience building scalable services and optimising latency, throughput and resource usage

  • Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Docker and cloud infrastructure

  • Ability to debug production issues using logs, metrics and distributed tracing

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, inference services or AI-powered applications

  • Experience with model serving, streaming inference or orchestration frameworks

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration

  • Familiarity with PyTorch, vLLM or open-source model deployment

  • Experience building real-time communication, messaging or high-traffic

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Chemical Engineer (Solid Propellants)
descriptionHtml:
Chemical Engineer

We are looking for a Chemical Engineer to develop and improve the propellants and laboratory capability behind our solid rocket propulsion systems. You will combine practical laboratory work with engineering judgement, working on formulation, preparation, characterisation, incoming-material inspection, and the scale-up of propellant solutions from laboratory experiments to propulsion hardware.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, formulate, prepare, and improve solid propellants for different propulsion requirements.

  • Plan and conduct laboratory experiments, characterise materials, and document results clearly.

  • Work with propulsion engineers to connect formulation, processing, material properties, and motor performance.

  • Support incoming-goods inspection, supplier engagement, and the evaluation of specialist chemicals and raw materials.

  • Investigate unexpected results, non-conformances, processing issues, and material compatibility questions.

  • Improve laboratory procedures, equipment capability, data quality, safety, and the scale-up of successful formulations.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, polymer science, energetic materials, or a related field.

  • Hands-on laboratory or process-development experience for solid propellants.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials behaviour, experimental design, and laboratory safety.

  • A careful and methodical approach to traceability, measurement quality, process control, and documentation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to investigate unexpected results.

  • The ability to work collaboratively with propulsion, test, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, catalysts, or energetic materials.

  • Propellant characterisation, burn-rate measurement, thermal analysis, rheology, mechanical testing, ageing, or compatibility.

  • Scaling a formulation or laboratory process toward repeatable production.

  • Incoming-material inspection, chemical quality control, supplier qualification, or non-conformance investigation.

  • Hazardous chemicals, explosives, or regulated laboratory processes.

  • Laboratory data systems, statistical analysis, or Python-based data processing.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A quick phone call with one of the Talent team

  • An onsite assessment centre with a role focus and a final stage interview with the Complaints Management team to discuss your fit and capability for the role.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: CTO Cofounder - PreSeed PropTech Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Founders Factory × Nua Materials

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory baut und finanziert gemeinsam mit außergewöhnlichen Gründer:innen und führenden Unternehmen neue Start-ups; unser Gründerteam verfügt über eigene Exit-/IPO-Erfahrung, und unsere mehr als 300 Portfoliounternehmen haben seit 2015 über 900 Mio. USD an Anschlussfinanzierung eingeworben.

Für Nua Materials suchen wir eine:n technische:n Co-Founder & CTO, der oder die gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Gründer aus einem validierten Konzept ein skalierbares Produkt und Unternehmen aufbaut.

Die Chance

Neuartige und nachhaltige Baustoffe gibt es längst, doch viele schaffen den Weg in reale Bauprojekte nur langsam. Für Bauunternehmen, Wohnungsunternehmen und Projektentwickler sind Informationen und Nachweise fragmentiert, Produkte schwer vergleichbar und neue Materialien mit zusätzlichen technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Risiken verbunden. Gleichzeitig steigt der regulatorische Druck: Wesentliche Teile der neuen EU-Bauprodukteverordnung gelten seit 2026, der Digitale Produktpass für Bauprodukte kommt.

Viele bestehende Lösungen setzen bei Dokumentation, Nachweisen und Zertifizierung an – nicht bei der eigentlichen Auswahl- und Kaufentscheidung. Genau dort setzt Nua Materials an. Ein zentraler Baustein ist der Nua Score, der bereits in einer ersten Version vorliegt. Bisherige Gespräche mit Herstellern, Bauunternehmen, Projektentwicklern und Gebäudeeigentümern bestätigen den Bedarf und zeigen Interesse an Pilotprojekten.

Was du aufbauen wirst

Als Co-Founder & CTO verantwortest du in der frühen Phase Produkt und Technologie.

  • Du definierst mit Nutzer:innen die entscheidenden Abläufe und baust den ersten nutzbaren Prototypen.

  • Du entwickelst den Nua Score weiter und baust eine robuste Daten- und Systemarchitektur für unterschiedliche externe Datenquellen.

  • Du entscheidest, was jetzt gebaut, später ergänzt oder automatisiert werden sollte – und was bewusst nicht ins Produkt gehört.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit ersten Kund:innen und Partnern und baust später ein kleines Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam auf.

Die ersten Monate sind sehr operativ: Wir suchen eine:n technische:n Gründer:in, der oder die selbst baut und Produktentscheidungen mitträgt.

Wen wir suchen

  • Produktentwicklung: Du kannst aus einem noch unscharfen Kundenproblem einen klaren, testbaren Produktansatz entwickeln und technisch umsetzen.

  • Datenbasierte Produkte: Du hast Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Plattformen, Bewertungs- oder Vergleichssystemen und kannst konkrete Fehlerquellen, Datenqualitätsprobleme und Validierungsentscheidungen beschreiben.

  • Technische Breite: Du bist stark in Backend und Datenarchitektur und kommst im Frontend weit genug, um frühe Produktversionen selbst auszuliefern.

  • Vertrauen im B2B: Du baust nachvollziehbare Systeme, die bei risikoaversen Unternehmenskunden, langen Entscheidungswegen und hohen Nachweisanforderungen bestehen.

  • Gründermentalität und Marktverständnis: Du hast gegründet, warst eine:r der ersten technischen Mitarbeiter:innen eines Start-ups oder hast vergleichbare Verantwortung übernommen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, professionelles Englisch und Erfahrung im DACH-Markt sind wichtig.

Besonders interessant, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung in Construction Tech oder PropTech

  • Hintergrund in Bauingenieurwesen oder Materialwissenschaften, idealerweise mit LCA-/EPD-Erfahrung

  • Erfahrung mit Vergleichsplattformen oder Marktplätzen

Was wir bieten

  • Kapital und Gründerfinanzierung für die Aufbauphase

  • Enge Unterstützung durch Founders Factory in Produkt, Daten, Wachstum, Finanzierung, Recht und Personal – auf Basis bestehender Markt-, Kunden- und Produktarbeit

  • Zugang zu ersten potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Bau- und Wohnungswirtschaft sowie zu unserem internationalen Netzwerk



-------------------
In English:

Founders Factory × Nua Materials

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.

For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.

The opportunity

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.

What you will build

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.

  • Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.

  • Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.

  • Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.

  • Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.

The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.

Who we are looking for

  • Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.

  • Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.

  • Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.

  • Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

  • Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.

Especially relevant, but not required

  • Experience in ConTech or PropTech

  • Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience

  • Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces

What we offer

  • Capital and founder funding for the build phase

  • Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work

  • Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

title: Customer Service Executive

The Role

title: Customer Service Expert (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
TÄGLICH MIT EINEM LÄCHELN BEI DER ARBEIT

Sunny Cars ist seit 35 Jahren der Mietwagenexperte für den perfekten Urlaub! Dank unserer umfangreichen Leistungen genießen unsere Kund*innen in über 120 Ländern weltweit rundum sorglosen Mietwagenurlaub. Für den perfekten Service vor, während und auch nach der Anmietung sorgt ein verlässliches und serviceorientiertes Team. Denn Sunny Cars ist nichts wichtiger als zufriedene Kund*innen.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich für unser Customer Service Team.

Da wir uns stetig weiterentwickeln, unterstützt du immer wieder bei verschiedenen internen Projekten – alleine, in der Gruppe oder mit den Teamleiter*innen und trägst deinen Teil zum Unternehmenserfolg bei.

title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
descriptionHtml:
Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy

Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams.

trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen.

Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten.


Das Team

Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten.

  • Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind.

  • Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert.

  • Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter.

  • Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

  • Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings.

Nach wem wir suchen

Dein Hintergrund

  • Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil.

Deine Fähigkeiten

  • Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren.

  • Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich.

  • Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren.

Dein technisches Verständnis

  • Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.

Deine Sprachkenntnisse

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau.

  • Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientierung

  • Du lernst trawas Produkte, Prozesse und den Energiemarkt kennen.

  • Du verstehst, wie Kundenbeziehungen bei trawa funktionieren – vom Onboarding bis zum QBR.

  • Du baust erste Beziehungen zu Kund:innen und internen Stakeholdern auf.

  • Du wirst von erfahrenen Customer Success Manager:innen begleitet und übernimmst erste eigene Aufgaben in der Kundenbetreuung.

Monat 2: Erste Verantwortung übernehmen

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Kundenaccounts und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für operative Stakeholder.

  • Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Playbooks, QBR-Vorlagen und Tools und wirst zunehmend sicherer in der selbstständigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -themen.

Monat 3 und danach: Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung

  • Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Bestandskund:innen end to end.

  • Du erkennst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Kund:innen noch besser betreuen und ihre Erfahrungen mit trawa weiter verbessern können.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben.

  • Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte und Kundenerlebnisse, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstands beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und bis zu zehn Workation-Tagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du wirst Teil eines tollen Teams, in dem Coaching und Mentoring großgeschrieben werden. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche.

  • Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft.

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

descriptionHtml:
hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Für unser CSM-Team suchen wir jemanden, der unsere Pflegeeinrichtungen von der Einführung an begleitet und dafür sorgt, dass sie die versprochene Entlastung im Alltag wirklich spüren.

Aufgaben

  • Schulungen: Du schulst das Pflegepersonal und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten die Funktionen und Vorteile unseres Services sowie der intuitiven hellomedOS-Webapp verstehen und im Alltag sicher anwenden.

  • Kundenbetreuung: Du hältst engen Kontakt zu unseren Partnereinrichtungen, stellst ihre Zufriedenheit sicher und arbeitest aktiv daran, die Zahl der versorgten Patienten zu erhöhen und die Zusammenarbeit auszubauen.

  • Potenziale erkennen: Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten und die Entwicklung vor Ort, um gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb gezielt Potenziale bei bestehenden Kunden zu realisieren.

  • Stimme der Kunden: Du gibst die Stimme unserer Kunden weiter – sammelst ihr Feedback, ihre Anregungen und Kritik und leitest sie an die richtigen Stellen weiter, um unseren Service und unser Produkt kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder Customer Success: Du hast in der Pflege gearbeitet oder bringst Erfahrung im Customer Success / Account Management mit, idealerweise im gesundheitsnahen Umfeld.

  • Kundenorientierung: Du zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung aus. Es fällt dir leicht, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden einzugehen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die deren Alltag erleichtern.

  • Sprache: Du kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch (mind. C1) – im Pflegealltag unserer Kunden ist das der Schlüssel zu Vertrauen.

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du kannst Kundenfeedback und Standortdaten strukturiert analysieren und daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten, um das hellomed-Kundenerlebnis und die Zahl der versorgten Patienten kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, teamübergreifend mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, unsere Kunden ab und zu vor Ort zu besuchen, um Schulungen und persönliche Beratungsgespräche durchzuführen. Die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen ist daher erforderlich (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit).

Benefits

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den hellomed-Gründern zusammen – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, regelmäßigem Sparring und viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen.

  • Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Dienstwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung, um dich bei Kundenterminen und Reisen optimal zu unterstützen.

  • Du hast 27 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.

  • Wir versorgen dich täglich mit Getränken, und bei regelmäßigen Teamevents sorgen wir für unvergessliche gemeinsame Momente.

  • Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Du hast jederzeit die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzubilden oder Schulungen zu besuchen.

We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager for In-House legal teams at Harvey, you are the custodian of value for a portfolio of corporate legal departments at some of Europe's largest companies — you own their mutual success plan and, with your Account Executive, their renewal. You will lead each legal function from first adoption to Harvey being embedded in how the team works, moving it along the AI maturity curve by connecting our technology and legal expertise to the General Counsel's own goals and the metrics they report to the business.   • Prove value and expand: align each legal team on measurable outcomes, capture ROI evidence and value stories the GC can take to the business, and qualify expansion into new teams and regions with your Account Executive.

  • Run your book and own renewal readiness: know whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow with evidence; prioritise by value, renewal timing and risk; surface risk early — including competing AI tools — and partner with your Account Executive to renew and expand our strategic partnerships.
    What You Have

  • Extensive background in strategic customer success or account management at Enterprise SaaS, legal (big law or in-house or in-house) or top tier management consulting firms.

  • History and comfort conducting change management and wide-scale adoption for large technology projects.

  • Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, and a capability of influencing stakeholders at every level, including at the executive level.

  • Results driven mindset and the ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks and demanding customers seamlessly.

  • A strong commitment to be collaborative and proactive with a team-first mentality.

What We Offer

Ideal candidates for the Enterprise In-House CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • 5+ years in customer-owning roles — Customer Success, account management, legal operations, legal-tech consulting or an in-house legal or transformation role — working with corporate legal teams or an equivalent enterprise function.

  • An understanding of how in-house legal teams work: how a General Counsel is measured, how legal operations runs change, and how legal interacts with IT, procurement and the business.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily, can show how it has changed your own output, and have a point of view on how AI changes in-house legal work.

  • A track record of leading enterprise implementations or transformation programmes across multiple teams, regions or stakeholder groups, with measurable outcomes grounded in concrete use cases.

  • Confidence in technical conversations about workspace configuration, integrations, permissions and data handling, and judgement on when to bring in specialists.

  • Strategic planning and revenue-based prioritisation across a portfolio, including early identification and mitigation of risk.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal Engineering, Product and Support teams; comfort running in-person meetings with executives.

  • Adapting seamlessly in the face of high-speed change and growth, with a strong point of view and proactive self-management.

Typische Tickets?

1st Level Support

  • Gerätekonnektivität: Überprüfung, ob der APN korrekt gesetzt ist.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the position

We're looking to add a passionate Cybersecurity Engineer to our London office to help protect Jane Street’s employees, data, and infrastructure from the wilds of the internet. Our Cybersecurity Engineers are responsible for developing and using monitoring tools to guard the firm, as well as handling incident response and remediation when a threat is found.

Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. We consider ourselves to be tapped into developments in the broader cybersecurity space, and can tell the difference between the latest cool hack by security researchers and what actually matters in our day-to-day.   • Be Extraordinary: Fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformational creativity.
  • Create an Open Environment: Striking the perfect balance between employee fulfillment and client satisfaction, all built on mutual trust.
  • Lead with Optimism: Actively driving growth and development to energize our entire organization.

Missions & Responsibilities

The Data Governance Director enforces global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets, while ensuring data directly serves business and media performance objectives. Moving beyond purely operational data checks, this role bridges data control and strategic activation. The Director is responsible for transitioning data operations into an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework, challenging and simplifying existing processes, and leading/up-skilling the Data & Tech team to ensure data is structured, trusted, and actionable for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.

As the Data Governance Director, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will bridge data control and strategic activation by transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. You will lead and elevate the Data & Tech team to guarantee clean, structured, and actionable data for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.

1. Data Governance & Strategy

  • Strategic Alignment: Align data collection directly with business and media objectives, ensuring data is consistent, structured, and actionable across all activation and analytics teams.
  • Critical Thinking & Process Simplification: Actively challenge existing processes, taxonomies, and naming conventions to eliminate complexity and propose simpler, more scalable, and effective approaches.
  • Framework & Model Ownership: Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model.
  • Annual Taxonomy Review: Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.
  • Naming Conventions: Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.

2. Team Leadership & Structuring

  • Team Elevation & Upskilling: Lead, structure, and elevate the Data & Tech team, developing their understanding of the broader digital, tech, and media ecosystem.
  • Workflow Framing: Frame and guide team workflows to break down operational silos, standardizing execution across Maisons and aligning daily tasks with strategic priorities and best practices.
  • Talent Guidance: Direct and advise Data Operations Executives and Associate Directors on best practices for automated data validation beyond basic string checking.

3. Operations & Compliance Management

  • Data Accuracy Enforcer: Drive global data compliance from current baselines up to a strict 95% accuracy target across all channels, Maisons, and markets.
  • Input Data Readiness: Ensure clean, trusted input data flows into Optimus dashboards (and ultimately WPP Open), eliminating fragmented taxonomies and reporting discrepancies.

Qualifications & Profile

  • Experience: 8–10+ years of proven experience in Digital Data Governance, Taxonomy Management, or Media Data Operations.
  • Background: Strong AdOps background with hands-on experience in digital tracking, ad serving, and multi-market data compliance.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of taxonomy architecture, dynamic UTM/naming structures, Accutics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), server-side tracking, and campaign management workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of enforcing governance standards across multi-brand, multi-agency, and international team environments.
  • Key Soft Skills: Great autonomy, strong organizational skills, and a strategic mindset. High level of diplomacy, active listening, and the ability to communicate technical data governance standards clearly to both executive stakeholders and operational teams.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our commitment to shaping the future of media is reflected in active support for the professional development of our talent, helping them reach their full potential. This approach goes hand-in-hand with a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, reflecting our dual priority: valuing our people while adopting sustainable practices across our industry.

WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media and WPP global networks, enabling them to expand their professional network and stay at the forefront of marketing and advertising innovation. We foster an inclusive work culture where team accomplishments and expertise are regularly celebrated through engaging internal events.

  • Social Impact: Opportunities to participate in community and solidarity missions via our "We care and we act" program.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Interview: An initial phone or video interview with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your experience, expectations, and answer your questions about the role and company.
  2. Operational Interview: An in-depth interview with key operational leadership to evaluate your technical background, leadership style, and cultural fit.
  3. Case Study / Technical Assessment: A case study presentation to demonstrate your practical skills in data governance architecture, taxonomy framework design, and stakeholder management.

We are committed to making this process as fast, transparent, and collaborative as possible.

title: Data Protection Executive
descriptionHtml:
📍 Lincoln Hybrid – 2 days per week in our city centre office, with 3 days working from home

Passionate about all things data protection? Looking for a role where you can take real ownership of your work and put your knowledge into practice?

We're looking for a Data Protection Executive to join our Compliance team and help ensure we're doing the right thing when it comes to handling personal data across Goodlord.

With the volume of personal data flowing through our platform, tenant referencing and insurance services, there's plenty to keep you busy!

You'll take ownership of our day-to-day data protection activities, from managing data rights requests and maintaining our records to helping colleagues across the business navigate data protection queries with confidence.

There's a task-driven element to this role, so you'll need to enjoy getting into the detail and managing a busy workload. But it's not just about ticking boxes. You'll be naturally curious, confident asking questions and keen to understand how we can improve the way we do things.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Managing data rights requests, including subject access requests, deletions and objections, ensuring they're handled accurately and within legislative timeframes.

  • Providing practical data protection advice and guidance to colleagues across Goodlord, including our frontline Customer Support and Referencing teams.

  • Taking ownership of our Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), working with stakeholders across the business to ensure they're accurate and up to date.

  • Reviewing and maintaining our privacy notices to ensure they accurately reflect how we process personal data.

  • Reviewing our existing data protection processes, ensuring we can demonstrate compliance and identifying opportunities to improve the way we do things.

  • Supporting our Director of Compliance with risk assessments and the implementation of legislative changes.

ABOUT YOU

You should apply if you have:

  • Hands-on, demonstrable experience in a dedicated data protection role, handling data requests, designing records of processing and having responsibility for legislative compliance.

  • In-depth knowledge of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and an awareness of recent legislative developments.

  • Experience managing subject access requests end to end, including the application of exemptions and redaction.

  • Experience of completing data protection impact assessments and legitimate interest assessments

  • Confidence working independently, prioritising your own workload and meeting legislative deadlines.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate legislative requirements into clear, practical guidance for colleagues across the business.

It would also be great if you have:

  • A relevant professional qualification, such as the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection or IAPP CIPP/E.

  • Experience managing personal data breaches, including assessing whether they're reportable to the ICO.

  • Experience working in an FCA-regulated firm, ideally within insurance.

  • An understanding of the residential lettings sector, specifically the process of tenant referencing and associated data processing activities.

We're not expecting you to know everything, but you'll need a solid grounding in data protection, the confidence to take ownership of your day-to-day responsibilities and the ability to recognise when to ask for support.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Fleetcraft

We're building the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft.

Aerospace demand is surging. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short.

The world needs more aerospace capacity, but the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and barely changed in decades. Fleetcraft is the full system to operate and manage aircraft maintenance. Our agents already work alongside technicians and controllers in 10+ maintenance organisations across 4 continents. They capture the repair as it happens and turn expertise into intelligence the whole operation can use.

Our seed was led by Susa Ventures, alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. You'll work with a team that has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit, and with an aviation advisory board whose members have run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US.

The role

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll own customer implementation end-to-end.

You’ll translate complex operational requirements into AI-solutions, work hands-on with customers to drive adoption, and turn what you learn in the field into sales and engineering priorities.

This is a highly hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll spend time in our office with the team, but also on-site with customers in hangars, maintenance facilities, and manufacturing environments, around the world. You’ll work directly with technicians, operators, managers, and executives to understand their workflows, deploy Fleetcraft into live environments, and make sure the product becomes mission-critical.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with exceptional learning velocity, commercial instinct, and technical competence. You should be pragmatic, intentional, and very structured. Aerospace experience is not required - the ability to learn quickly, adapt, and handle complex implementations with high emotional intelligence.

You should be technically fluent enough to understand AI and software systems and commercially curious enough to understand what drives customer value.

  • 2+ years in consulting, technical implementation, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles in enterprise B2B.

  • AI-native: You already use AI extensively in your work, experiment constantly, and instinctively find ways to move faster with it.

  • Technically fluent: You can hold your own with engineers and translate customer needs into actionable engineering requirements.

  • High emotional intelligence: Equally comfortable earning the trust of CEOs, IT directors, senior engineers, aircraft technicians, and pilots.

  • Structured and resourceful: Able to manage multiple deployments, solve complex problems, and bring clarity to ambiguous situations.

  • Bias to action: You take ownership, learn quickly, and prioritise getting things done over perfect plans.

What we offer

£75k–£110k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.

A small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. Relocation support if needed. Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up.

If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk.

Interview process

  1. Initial screening interview with a co-founder (30 min)

  2. Technical interview (45 min)

  3. Take home project

  4. In-person meeting (1 hr)

After the in-person meeting we check references and then make an offer.

We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Fleetcraft is an equal opportunities employer.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

title: Director Accounting & Finance - FTC
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on accounting and finance leader to provide maternity cover of 14 months during a period of continued business development and finance transformation.

This is a broad role combining financial reporting, month-end delivery, cash and debt-facility reporting, corporate governance support and finance-systems ownership. You’ll work closely with the CFO, Finance and Accounting colleagues, business leaders and external advisers to maintain reliable reporting, effective controls and continuity across key workstreams.

You’ll be equally comfortable reviewing accounting entries, explaining budget variances, coordinating an audit and resolving a NetSuite reporting or access issue. Success will mean keeping essential processes running smoothly while progressing agreed improvements and making risks, decisions and dependencies visible.

🥇 What success looks like

  • Month-end close, consolidated reporting and board-reporting inputs are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Lender reporting and compliance requirements are met, with clear oversight of deadlines and dependencies.

  • Budget holders receive useful analysis and timely support.

  • Audit and adviser workstreams progress with clear ownership and well-organised evidence.

  • Finance systems remain reliable, and agreed implementation and reporting improvements continue.

  • Responsibilities, decisions and outstanding matters are documented to support a smooth handover back.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Audit, governance, tax and technical accounting

  • Coordinate audit delivery, acting as a central contact for auditors and internal stakeholders and tracking evidence requests, issues and deadlines.

  • Draft consolidated and entity level financial statements along with relevant footnote disclosures under IFRS and US GAAP.

  • Initiate implementation of IFRA 18 and ASU 2024-03.

  • Support corporate governance processes and associated financial documentation and reporting.

  • Support the CFO with Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) and Corporate Criminal Offence (CCO) workstreams, including documentation, information gathering and follow-through on agreed actions.

  • Coordinate accounting advisory workstreams, ensuring clear briefs, ownership, timely responses and resolution of outstanding matters.

  • Ad hoc technical accounting assessments, documenting agreed conclusions and supporting implementation.

Financial accounting, close and consolidated reporting

  • Deliver assigned month-end close activities, including intercompany eliminations, and coordinate with entity accounting teams.

  • Prepare and coordinate consolidated monthly financial reporting under US GAAP and IFRS, ensuring completeness, consistency and clear explanations of significant movements.

  • Review assigned journals, reconciliations and intercompany activity, resolving issues with the relevant preparers and reviewers.

  • Maintain close timetables, support the resolution of blockers and ensure appropriate documentation and review evidence.

  • Support the preparation and validation of financial actuals and analysis for board reporting.

Equity administration and insurance

  • Administer Carta, including reporting, supporting bookkeeping, maintaining records and coordinating approved changes with relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate corporate, office and other insurance matters, working with brokers, Legal and business owners on renewals, coverage questions, policy changes and emerging requirements.

  • Maintain clear records of outstanding actions, approvals and responsibilities across both workstreams.

Finance systems and reporting

  • Act as the day-to-day Netsuite administrator, covering month-end requirements, ongoing maintenance, user access, configuration and issue resolution.

  • Facilitate work with external Netsuite support partners, prioritising requests and coordinating delivery, testing and implementation.

  • Develop and maintain Netsuite reporting for Finance, including reports and saved searches that improve visibility and reduce manual work.

  • Administer and maintain Netsuite Account Reconciliation system, including period roll-forwards, assignments and troubleshooting.

Cash, treasury and loan facility reporting

  • Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, certificates, utilisation requests and other required submissions, including event-triggered reporting.

  • Maintain a clear compliance calendar and work with the CFO, Legal and Accounting teams to ensure timely, accurate reporting and escalation.

🤩 About You

Essential experience and skills

  • A recognised accounting qualification ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent.

  • Experience drafting consolidated and entity-level financial statements under both IFRS and US GAAP.

  • Strong experience across financial accounting, consolidated reporting and month-end close in a multi-national environment.

  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience, including administration, reporting and working with external support partners.

  • Experience coordinating external audits and managing relationships with professional advisers.

  • Confidence managing cash reporting, debt-facility reporting and compliance deadlines.

  • Sound technical accounting judgement, with the ability to identify when specialist advice or escalation is needed.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing operational and project demands and supporting Accounting and Finance team members.

  • Clear communication and the confidence to challenge constructively, explain complex issues and drive actions to completion.

Desirable experience

  • UK and US accounting and reporting requirements, including US GAAP and IFRS.

  • NSAR and NSPB administration or implementation.

  • Carta and equity-related accounting or administration.

  • Senior Accounting Officer support (familiarity with Criminal Finance Act), insurance coordination or corporate governance support.

  • Subscription, e-commerce or other high-volume transaction businesses.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary
