title: Director - Business Development
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. 

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.  

DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS  

Based in Munich, Germany, as the Director - Business Development, you will drive Rocket Lab’s growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for defense, national security, civil space, and commercial applications across Germany and Europe
  • Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large defense, civil space, and government contracts, including opportunities with German and European government agencies, defense organizations, space institutions, and prime contractors
  • Engage with key customer stakeholders, government officials, policymakers, and industry leaders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab’s solutions align with their evolving mission requirements and strategic priorities
  • Develop and maintain relationships across the German and European space and defense ecosystem, including government organizations, prime contractors, industry partners, and relevant European institutions
  • Collaborate closely with Government Affairs and cross-functional teams to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government-funded programs
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business
  • Monitor German and European industry trends, government priorities, procurement initiatives, policy developments, and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies
  • Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities
  • Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab’s capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements
  • Identify and pursue opportunities associated with European sovereign space and defense capabilities, dual-use technologies, and evolving European procurement priorities
  • Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business
  • Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders across Business Development, Government Affairs, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations
  • Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe
  • Build awareness of relevant European government programs and procurement pathways, including opportunities involving ESA, the European Union, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, DLR, and German defense and space organizations 
  • Support Rocket Lab’s positioning within the evolving European space and defense landscape, including launch sovereignty, European sovereign capability, dual-use technology, and defense modernization priorities
  • Develop an understanding of relevant export control and regulatory considerations affecting Rocket Lab’s ability to pursue European opportunities, including ITAR/EAR and applicable German and European requirements
  • Travel as needed for business opportunities, customer meetings, industry events, and capture activities
  • Other duties as assigned or required

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace, space, defense, or related technology sector
  • In-depth knowledge of government acquisition processes, government contracting, and the national security landscape within Germany and/or Europe
  • Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace, space, or defense industry
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Strong understanding of German and European defense priorities, civil space programs, government procurement processes, and the broader European space and defense ecosystem
  • Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master’s degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business
  • Specialization in German or European government business development, with deep experience selling to German or European national security, defense, civil space, or government customers
  • Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms
  • Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs
  • Experience working with or within organizations such as DLR, Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, German federal government entities, ESA, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, EU defense bodies, NATO, or other European space and defense institutions
  • Experience pursuing European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways
  • Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense Fund (EDF), European Defense Industry Program (EDIP), EU Space Program initiatives, and related European defense modernization priorities
  • Familiarity with NATO space and defense structures and European security and resilience priorities
  • Understanding of export control regimes and regulatory considerations relevant to European business development, including ITAR/EAR and German/EU requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English
  • Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project
  • General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software
  • Experience with proposal development, writing, and best practice capture processes, and ability to independently complete cost and technical proposals
  • Experience working with subject matter experts to collect and create compelling proposal content and detailed responses

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our: Data Privacy Policy.

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.   

Important information:

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. 

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do:

The Global Field Marketing Organization drives market penetration, customer engagement, and pipeline generation across key regions in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The team owns regional go-to-market strategy and execution — high-touch account-based marketing, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions — and works cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Events, Brand, and Demand to drive customer acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Director of EMEA Field Marketing to own the customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy and execution across EMEA, and to establish CoreWeave as a recognized and trusted brand in the region.

This role will lead and grow a team of regional marketing managers, and partner closely with sales leadership to align marketing investments and resourcing around the GEO go-to-market strategy supporting customer acquisition and customer expansion across enterprise and AI-natives. As leader of Field Marketing for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our regional marketing strategy across high-touch account-based marketing, 3rd party conferences, field programs, executive engagement, and partner-led motions.

This role will own how CoreWeave shows up in the region — building awareness and credibility with European AI-native builders and enterprise buyers, and adapting the global brand narrative for a market with distinct data sovereignty, regulatory, language, and cultural requirements. Your leadership will drive the expansion of CoreWeave's presence and reputation in the dynamic and rapidly evolving EMEA AI-Cloud market.

Success is measured by pipeline created and progressed, conversion rates across the funnel, deal velocity in priority accounts, and growth in regional brand awareness and consideration among target accounts.

In this role, you will:

Regional Strategy & Pipeline Ownership

  • Own the EMEA customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy end to end, carrying accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline targets by segment, country, and priority account.
  • Align marketing investment and team resourcing to the GEO go-to-market strategy, ensuring the regional plan reflects where Sales is prioritizing acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.
  • Balance investment between near-term pipeline generation and the brand and category-building work required to make CoreWeave a known quantity in EMEA, and be able to articulate the tradeoff.
  • Set the channel mix across ABM, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions based on ROI analysis and attribution data.
  • Build distinct motions for acquisition and expansion: net-new account penetration and category presence on one side, deeper multi-workload engagement within existing customers on the other.
  • Prioritize across a multi-country region — sequencing investment across core markets and emerging ones rather than spreading coverage thin.
  • Manage a multi-million dollar regional budget with explicit ROI rationale, and defend allocation and resourcing decisions to marketing and sales leadership.

Brand Presence & Market Development in EMEA

  • Own CoreWeave's overall brand presence in EMEA — partnering with the Brand, Communications, and Product Marketing teams to build awareness, credibility, and consideration in a market where CoreWeave is still establishing itself.
  • Adapt the global brand narrative for regional realities: data sovereignty and residency, EU regulatory context, local infrastructure footprint, language and cultural nuance — without fragmenting the global story.
  • Land regional proof points — customer stories, local infrastructure milestones, partner wins — and make them visible in-market.

Sales Partnership & Account-Based Marketing

  • Serve as the senior marketing partner to EMEA sales leadership — in pipeline reviews, account planning, and forecast discussions — translating GEO priorities into funded, resourced programs.
  • Direct high-touch ABM against CoreWeave's priority AI-native and enterprise accounts, partnering with Sales to define coverage, nomination criteria, and progression goals at the account and contact level.
  • Drive disciplined lead and opportunity handoff with Sales and SDR, with agreed SLAs, shared quality definitions, and acceleration plays for stalled or late-stage deals.
  • Build expansion programs alongside Sales and Customer teams that deepen engagement in existing accounts and surface new workloads, teams, and buying centers.

Market Presence & Executive Engagement

  • Expand CoreWeave's presence across the EMEA AI-Cloud market, selecting the third-party conferences, field programs, and technical and developer-led moments where CoreWeave should show up — and holding each to a pipeline and brand thesis.
  • Partner with the Executive Marketing team to connect regional CXO and VP engagement to opportunity progression in named accounts.
  • Work with Partner Marketing to activate partner-led motions in-region — including the regional systems integrators, resellers, and cloud and ecosystem partners that carry disproportionate weight in EMEA — turning joint narratives into named-account plays and co-sell pipeline.
  • Provide clear regional input into global campaigns and launches so they land effectively with EMEA audiences and buyer personas, and flag where regional adaptation is required.
  • Partner with Developer Marketing to grow developer advocacy and engagement with in EMEA communities 

Data-Driven Optimization & Scalable Systems

  • Manage the KPIs that matter — account and contact coverage, engagement, meetings, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion rates and stage progression — in Salesforce and the marketing automation and ABM stack.

title: Director, Government Affairs, Germany & EU
descriptionHtml:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the role 

NinjaOne is a unified IT operations platform for endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and security, used by IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs) worldwide. Cybersecurity and data regulation, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and DORA, now shapes how our German-speaking customers and partners buy and operate IT tooling. 

As Director of Government Affairs, you will be NinjaOne's principal voice in Germany and at the EU level. Your priority is to build trusted relationships and shape the debate in the institutions where German cybersecurity and economic policy is discussed, above all the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU e.V. and the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland e.V.. You will also represent NinjaOne in Brussels, with EU institutions and EU-level trade associations, in coordination with our global policy team. 

Location: Berlin, Germany 

What You'll be Doing

Germany engagement (primary focus) 

  • Build and run NinjaOne's government affairs strategy for Germany and the EU, aligned with global priorities and EMEA growth goals
  • Hold an active role in the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU and the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland, including working groups, committees, and sponsorship decisions
  • Develop relationships across parties and institutions: Bundestag committees (digital, economic affairs, interior), federal ministries, state governments, and the BSI
  • Engage trade associations such as Bitkom, eco, BDI, and BITMi, and identify where NinjaOne should lead, join, or sponsor
  • Represent NinjaOne at political events, parliamentary evenings, banquets, conferences, and roundtables. Evening and weekend commitments are expected

Policy shaping 

  • Draft position papers, consultation responses, amendments, and briefings on cybersecurity, data protection, digital resilience, and software supply chain topics
  • Advocate on German implementation of NIS2 and on the CRA, DORA, GDPR, and AI Act, with attention to how they affect endpoint management and MSP delivery models
  • Coordinate with Brussels-based associations and global colleagues so that German positions and EU-level positions stay consistent

EU engagement 

  • Build relationships with the European Commission, European Parliament, and Council, and with ENISA, on files that affect endpoint management and MSP delivery models
  • Take part in EU-level trade bodies such as DIGITALEUROPE, and in Commission consultations and expert groups
  • Work with our global policy team to keep German and EU positions consistent

Business partnership and advisory 

  • Brief executives, Legal, Product, Security, and Sales on regulatory developments and their business impact
  • Partner with Business Development on public sector and regulated-industry opportunities, while keeping advocacy separate from sales activity
  • Work with Marketing and Communications on German-language policy messaging, speaking opportunities, and thought leadership

Governance 

  • Keep all activity compliant with the German Lobbyregister, the EU Transparency Register, and NinjaOne's anti-corruption, gifts, and hospitality policies
  • Manage the government affairs budget, memberships, and external advisors, and report on activities and outcomes
  • Other duties as needed 

About You

Required 

  • 8 to 12 years of experience in government affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, or political advocacy, with meaningful time in technology, cybersecurity, or another regulated industry. 
  • A record of influencing policy, such as drafting amendments, leading coalitions, or shaping consultation outcomes, rather than only monitoring it. 
  • Working relationships or demonstrated access in German political and institutional circles, ideally including the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU, the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland, Bundestag committees, federal ministries, or the BSI. 
  • Solid knowledge of the German and EU cybersecurity and data regulatory landscape (NIS2, CRA, GDPR, DORA, AI Act), and working knowledge of how EU institutions and policy processes operate. 
  • Experience with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, telecom, public sector, or critical infrastructure. 
  • Comfort and credibility at political receptions, banquets, and parliamentary events. 
  • Native-level German (C2) and fluent business English. 
  • Strong drafting skills for policy documents, in German and English. 
  • Willingness to travel regularly, and the right to work in Germany. 

Preferred 

  • Experience in EU-level lobbying groups or trade bodies (for example DIGITALEUROPE, or a Brussels-based public affairs firm or association). 
  • In-house government affairs or public policy experience at a comparable SaaS or cybersecurity company, such as CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, or similar. 
  • Prior role in a parliamentary office, ministry, regulator, political party, or public affairs consultancy. 
  • Familiarity with the MSP and SME IT ecosystem. 
  • Advanced degree in law, political science, public policy, economics, or a related field. 
  • Experience managing external consultants. 
  • Familiarity with ENISA, the Commission's consultation process, and EU cybersecurity certification schemes. 

What helps you succeed 

  • Credibility with senior officials and the judgment to stay discreet and non-partisan. 
  • The ability to translate technical issues into policy language, and the reverse. 
  • Independence and comfort working with limited supervision. 

What You’ll Love 

  • Grow personally and professionally with one of the fastest growing companies
  • Enjoy your lunch covered by NinjaOne 3 times/week at the office
  • Access to our Corporate Benefits Platform (with discounts for brands such as Expedia, FitX, Zalando and many more)
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation 
  • Collaborate with a curious, kind, international and intercultural workforce  
  • Enjoy your work environment with its location in the heart of Berlin, directly at the Alexanderplatz (close to all transit)

title: Director of Hardware
descriptionHtml:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role:

This is a defining leadership role at an exciting stage of CoMind’s growth. You will inherit a talented multidisciplinary engineering team and have the mandate to shape how the hardware function operates — from technical standards and development practices to team structure and long-term capability. You will:

  • Establish best-in-class hardware development processes and quality standards across mechanical, electronics, and opto-mechanical disciplines.

  • Build and develop a high-performing team, identifying capability gaps and creating a bench of talent for future product programmes.

  • Work closely with the Systems Architect, Technical SMEs, and Programme Management to drive delivery across CoMind’s product pipeline.

  • Take translational research outputs through the full development lifecycle into commercial, regulated medical device products.

This role leads the hardware engineering function at CoMind, with responsibility for building and sustaining a high-performing team of mechanical, electronics, and opto-mechanical engineers. As a functional leader, you will own the engineering capability, standards, processes, and tools that underpin CoMind’s medical device development programmes.

Working in close partnership with the System Architects, Technical Subject Matter Experts, and Programme Management, you will ensure the hardware engineering function is resourced, structured, and equipped to deliver across CoMind’s product pipeline. You will set and maintain the technical standards and development processes that govern how the team works, ensuring alignment with medical device regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in medical device product design and development, with hands-on experience across the full development lifecycle. You will combine deep technical credibility with the people and organisational skills needed to influence decisions at both programme and organisational level.

 

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development

    Functional Ownership & Standards

    Cross-Functional Delivery

    • Take outputs from the translational optical research team and data science team through the development process and into commercial products.

    Strategic Planning

    • Provide strategic and tactical planning input to ensure adequate engineering resources are available to deliver business goals and objectives.

    • Support development from concept through to product realisation, including industrialisation and scale-up.

Skills & Experience:

  • Essential

    • Substantial experience of new product development within a regulated environment, including the medical device industry — with clear progression through the full product lifecycle from concept to commercialisation.

    • At least 5 years in a leadership role within a complex, multidisciplinary product development environment, ideally including medical devices.

    • A track record of delivering complex medical devices incorporating optoelectronic systems, real-time embedded systems, SoCs, and safety-critical components.

    • A rigorous understanding of the application of regulatory standards (FDA, ISO 13485, and IEC 60601) to product lifecycle processes.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

    • CAD modelling, FEA, tolerance analysis, and material selection

title: Director of Procurement & Trading
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Role

This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading: fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly.

You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space.

You report directly to the C level and sit on the commercial and operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement.

The core purpose of this role is to build one buying strategy that combines three things:

  • Spot trading, run as a repeatable system with a regular market-coverage schedule and clear KPIs;

  • Strategic buying, where you negotiate allocations, framework agreements and terms with Tier-1 manufacturers and develop private-label and direct-from-factory categories;

  • Supply planning, where you set the mix of spot, contract and stock and keep price and inventory risk under control.

Each part on its own is not enough. The job is to make them work together so that Andercore buys at the right price, secures supply when the market tightens, and never holds stock it cannot sell.

What You Will Do

  • Build and run the procurement machine: Develop and execute procurement strategies that support an 8-digit monthly procurement spend with exponential growth. Negotiate favourable terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers on a daily basis.

  • Lead and develop the team: Manage 10+ team members, set clear priorities daily, coach emerging team leads, and create a culture of accountability and speed. You will need to be assertive and hands-on. Be the player-coach. Close deals yourself and hire the people you need to scale

  • Create scalable processes: Design, implement, and continuously improve procurement workflows, playbooks, and controls. Processes are implemented in days and weeks at Andercore — not quarters and years.

  • Own supplier relationships: Source, evaluate, and onboard suppliers. Maintain and expand a high-quality supplier network with strong retention across existing and emerging markets.

  • Drive margin improvement: Identify cost-saving opportunities, optimise purchasing decisions, and improve payment terms to boost net revenue margin and cash cycle.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Accounting, and Product & Engineering to align supply with demand and ensure operational excellence.

  • Full P&L responsibility: for the supply side.

  • Leverage data and AI: Use data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor supplier performance, and identify market trends. Embrace AI tools to automate and scale procurement operations.

  • AI-native procurement: automate processes from RFQs through to order confirmations, with sellers as co-designers of the agents.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue and margin targets consistently met or exceeded through high availability and competitive pricing.

  • A robust, high-quality supplier network with strong retention and engagement across existing and emerging markets.

  • Streamlined, repeatable processes that reduce time-to-onboard, minimise errors, and allow the team to scale without linear headcount growth.

  • A high-performing, motivated team with emerging team leads and strong cross-functional collaboration.

  • Accurate, data-driven reporting that drives continuous improvement and informs executive strategy.

  • Run a category management that unlocks and owns new product lines

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top university or business school.

  • 4+ years in a high-performance environment: for example commodity trading / high-velocity B2B procurement.

  • Proven ability to build processes and delegate effectively. You must be able to create systems that outlast your personal involvement — not do everything yourself.

  • Strong assertiveness and people leadership. You will manage a young team that needs clear direction, daily prioritisation, and coaching.

  • Ability to operate at both strategic and granular levels: setting category strategy in the morning and reviewing individual POs in the afternoon.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with a high-intensity, fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift daily.

  • Proven results negotiating from the smaller side of the table, i.e. securing allocation, pricing and terms when you are not the biggest customer.

  • Hard-working, proactive, and independent. Willing to go the extra mile to get the job done.

  • A personal track record in spot or commodity trading with margin ownership.

  • Experience scaling a team, plus forecasting and inventory risk management.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, or construction / infrastructure / energy materials.

  • Exposure to AI-driven operations or automation of procurement workflows.

  • Familiarity with cross-border trade and international supplier management.

  • Tier-1 strategy consulting background (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain).

This Role Is Not For You If…

  • Your procurement experience is in slow-cycle, enterprise purchasing (annual contracts, quarterly reviews). Our cadence is daily.

  • You are strong on analysis but weak on implementation. We need someone who executes, not just diagnoses.

  • You prefer to do things yourself rather than build teams and processes. Delegation and system-building are non-negotiable.

  • You need a fully structured environment to be effective. Here, you will create the structure.

What We Offer

  • A critical leadership role with direct impact on company growth and P&L.

  • Highly competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

  • A smart, ambitious team backed by top-tier investors — building something that doesn’t exist yet.

  • Berlin headquarters with a global, multicultural operating environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Electrical Engineer (Wiring & Assembly)
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

Your Role:

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer and Wireman possessing recent exposure to working within an automotive environment to build, assemble, and test wiring harnesses, complete SMT PCB assembly, and offer practical support throughout the lifecycle of intricate loom projects. The Engineer will also assist in troubleshooting power, network, and CAN diagnostic issues on active vehicles.

 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Harness Assembly, SMT & Design Support

    • Build, crimp, and assemble intricate electrical harnesses and high-density sensor looms.

    • Execute SMT PCB assembly and accurate fine-pitch hand soldering.

    • Collaborate with senior engineering personnel to support loom architecture design.

    • Help select appropriate interconnects, cabling, protective shielding, and backshells tailored for severe environments.

    • Apply CAN network diagnostics to troubleshoot physical hardware faults on active platforms.

    • Incorporate practical design for manufacturability (DFM) principles during physical assembly steps.

    • Assist with generating schematics, 3D spatial routing, and production documentation.

    • Wire and integrate discrete analog and digital sensing elements into robust system looms.

  • Testing & Debugging

    • Diagnose and resolve hardware issues across experimental PCBs, custom cabling, and vehicle-level electrical setups using bench test equipment and live platform evaluations.

    • Perform comprehensive isolation checks, continuity verification, and operational validation on fully assembled sensor and power looms.

     

Requirements:

  • Academic Credentials: Bachelor's degree or higher diploma (B.Eng, HND, BTEC) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

  • Industry Practice: 2 to 3 years minimum working with physical wiring systems, loom construction, or hardware assembly.

  • Manufacturing: Demonstrated proficiency in surface-mount soldering, cable routing, and fine-pitch assembly.

  • Core Portfolio: Track record of building complex sensor looms and functional wiring harness projects.

  • ECAD Software: Working knowledge of platforms like Zuken E3, Altium Designer, HarnWare, or AutoCAD Electrical.

  • Spatial Design: Familiarity with CATIA V5/V6, SolidWorks, or Creo Schematics is advantageous.

  • Bus Networks: Expertise diagnosing and resolving physical CAN network communication faults.

  • Workmanship Standards: Awareness of IPC-WHMA-620, military specs, or automotive quality frameworks.

  • Bench Testing: Competent in operating oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and test fixtures.

  • PCB Integration: Proven history fabricating custom looms and hand-soldering SMT PCBs (2 to 4 layers) is essential.

     

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.

title: Elektroniker (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Embodied AI, das die menschliche Arbeitswelt revolutioniert. Mit modernster Robotik und fortschrittlicher künstlicher Intelligenz entwickeln wir transformative Technologien, die neu definieren, wie Arbeit über verschiedenste Branchen hinweg erledigt wird — und ermöglichen es Unternehmen, Abläufe zu optimieren, die Produktivität zu steigern und neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen.

Überblick

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Electroniker, der die elektrische Verkabelung und Steuerungssysteme unserer autonomen Robotersysteme installiert, verkabelt und in Stand hält. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem Mechanical- und Hardware-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle elektrischen Komponenten zuverlässig funktionieren und nahtlos in die Gesamtsysteme integriert sind.

Deine Aufgaben

Elektrokonstruktion und Planung:

  • Elektrokonstruktion gemäß geltenden Richtlinien und Normen.

  • Erstellung von Schaltplänen für unsere Robotersysteme.

Installation und Verkabelung:

  • Verkabelung und Installation elektrischer Komponenten und Steuerungssysteme in unseren Robotersystemen.

  • Montage von Schaltschränken, Steckverbindern und Sensorik nach technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen.

  • Verlegung und Anschluss von Kabeln unter Einhaltung geltender Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards.

Test, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung:

  • Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Systeme vor Auslieferung und Installation beim Kunden.

  • Diagnose und Behebung elektrischer Störungen während der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Wartungs- und Sicherheitsprüfungen an bestehenden Systemen.

Zusammenarbeit:

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Mechanical- und Software-Teams zur Integration elektronischer Komponenten in die physische Struktur der Roboter.

  • Unterstützung bei Vor-Ort-Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen beim Kunden.

  • Reisebereitschaft ~50%

Qualifikationen & Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen sowie Kenntnisse in Verkabelung, Verdrahtung und Anschlusstechnik.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten (z. B. Multimeter, Oszilloskop).

  • Kenntnisse relevanter elektrischer Sicherheitsnormen und -vorschriften.

  • Erfahrung in der Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder im Maschinenbau von Vorteil.

  • Selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit.

Was wir bieten:

  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten von zu Hause aus bei Bedarf

  • Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

  • Attraktive Vergütung und hervorragende Karrieremöglichkeiten

title: Engagement Manager (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
descriptionHtml:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.
  • Project Delivery: Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Feasibility & Economics: Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Team Leadership: Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.
  • Work Experience: Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.
  • Technical Depth: You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

title: Engineering Manager - Decathlon Digital (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Decathlon Digital recherche un·e Engineering Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris ! 

Chez Decathlon Digital, nous mettons la technologie au service du sport avec une ambition claire : impacter positivement 2 milliards de personnes d’ici 2035 tout en préservant notre terrain de jeu commun. Rejoindre nos équipes, c’est concevoir et opérer un écosystème numérique à très haute volumétrie (e-commerce, data, IA, cloud) qui connecte plus de 1900 magasins dans 54 pays. Pour soutenir cette accélération - marquée par le déploiement de l'IA et l'essor de nos modèles circulaires - nous recherchons un·e Engineering Manager engagé·e, capable de fédérer et de faire grandir nos talents techniques tout en relevant des défis d'architecture et de scalabilité à l'échelle mondiale.  

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant qu'Engineering Manager, tu accompagnes et guides une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de développeur·euses, quality engineers et support engineers. Tu incarnes la culture tech de Decathlon Digital et joues un rôle clé à l'intersection de l'humain, de la technologie et du produit afin de créer un environnement sain et stimulant où ton équipe peut innover et livrer de la valeur durablement.   Management et Développement Humain
  • Recrutement et intégration : Recruter les futurs talents de l'équipe et garantir une expérience d'onboarding de qualité.
  • Animation par le sens et la confiance : Incarner le modèle managérial de Decathlon en donnant le cap, en responsabilisant les ingénieur·es (internes et externes) et en favorisant l'autonomie dans la prise de décision (principe de subsidiarité).
  • Accompagnement de proximité : Être le premier soutien de ton équipe via des points réguliers (1-on-1s), pratiquer l'écoute active et co-construire les parcours de développement de tes coéquipier·ères.
  • Culture de l'apprentissage : Créer un environnement psychologiquement sûr où l'on expérimente et où l'on apprend collectivement de chaque retour d'expérience.
Delivery et Excellence Opérationnelle
  • Pilotage de la livraison : Garantir une livraison fluide et prédictible des produits en collaboration étroite avec le·la Product Manager (PM).
  • Fiabilité et performance : Piloter les indicateurs de santé des applications grâce aux pratiques de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Facilitation : Identifier, anticiper et lever les obstacles afin de fluidifier le quotidien des équipes d'ingénierie.
Vision Technique et Qualité
  • Architecture et conseil : Sans coder au quotidien, comprendre les enjeux techniques complexes et challenger constructivement les choix d'architecture avec les Tech Leads et Staff Engineers.
  • Culture qualité : Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de Software Craftsmanship (tests automatisés, CI/CD, sécurité, performance, clean code).
  • Alignement stratégique : Aligner la roadmap technique de l'équipe avec la stratégie globale et les standards de Decathlon Digital.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu possèdes une solide expérience en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu'au moinds d'une prémière expérience réussie en management d'équipes techniques.
  • Leadership : Tu adoptes une posture de Servant Leader (leadership au service du collectif), faisant preuve d'empathie, d'écoute active et de capacité à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs.
  • Approche produit et agilité : Tu es orienté·e solution, produit et utilisateur·rice, avec une solide maîtrise des méthodes agiles au sein d'environnements complexes et internationaux.
  • Communication : Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes et communiquer efficacement aussi bien avec des profils techniques qu'avec des parties prenantes métier (Product, Business).
  • Langues : La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international.
  • Valeurs : Tu partages nos valeurs (vitalité, responsabilité, générosité, authenticité) et adhères à l'esprit du sport - collectif, dépassement de soi et bien-être - quel que soit ton niveau de pratique.

Environnement Technique & Pratiques :
  • Cloud, Architectures distribuées haute volumétrie, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Craftsmanship, Data & IA

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITÉ

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Engineering Manager (London)
descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The role At Zopa, Engineering Managers shape how our people grow, leading teams of talented Engineers working on products used by millions of customers. You’ll help raise the bar for how we deliver, not just what we ship. This is a role for an experienced people manager who enjoys taking ownership and making things better. You will work closely with Product and other partners to plan ahead, navigate trade offs and tackle challenges early. Engineering Managers at Zopa drive change beyond formal authority by building coalitions, shaping thinking across functions, and using insight and influence to move the organisation forward. When things are ambiguous, you bring clarity by making decisions, setting priorities, and helping teams move together. We’re looking for Engineering Managers who don’t wait to be told where the problems are. You’ll use customer feedback and service data to spot opportunities, improve quality and reliability, and help your team deliver confidently through complexity. The team We’re growing across several product-engineering tribes at Zopa, including Current Account, Product Enablement and Operational Efficiency. Each team works on different problems, but they’re all united by a shared belief in ownership, collaboration and thoughtful challenge. You’ll join a supportive community of Engineering Managers who care deeply about people, impact and continuous improvement. During the interview process, you’ll meet Zopians from across the business so we can find the team where you’ll have the biggest impact. We work in a hybrid way, with this role spending a minimum of three days a week in our London office.
About you:
  • As an experienced Engineering Manager, of at least two years in a leadership role, you’re someone who naturally:
  • Owns outcomes. You look for problems to solve, not just tasks to complete, and you’re comfortable leading through uncertainty.
  • Is self-driven and proactive. You work with minimal direction while helping others find clarity and focus.
  • Brings strong opinions, held thoughtfully. You challenge ideas, influence decisions and stand your ground when needed, while staying open to learning and changing your mind.
  • Learns quickly from mistakes. You reflect openly on what didn’t work and using that insight to do better next time.
  • Cares deeply about people. You bring proven experience supporting engineers’ development, performance and progression.
  • Keeps a strong technical bar. You’ve helped build, run and improve production systems, and you treat quality as a first-class concern across the SDLC
  • Communicates clearly and empathetically. You engage with engineers, product partners and stakeholders, explaining not just what you’re doing, but why.
    • At Zopa, we value experience, and we’re just as interested in mindset, judgement and potential. We want to meet Engineering Managers who bring curiosity, conviction and care to their work, and who want to maintain and evolve a culture where both people and products can thrive. #LI-JA1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. descriptionHtml:
About XYZ Reality


XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

Location: UK (Remote)

 

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat, but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

 

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

 

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

As an Account Executive, you'll drive new revenue in data centre construction, owning your accounts from first conversation through to expansion.

 

You'll act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, making the business case for XYZ Reality's engineering-grade AR in terms of ROI, risk reduction and delivery certainty, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles through to close.

 

You'll carry annual and quarterly targets as a core member of our growing revenue team.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own and grow a portfolio of data centre accounts, from winning new business to expanding existing customers, with clear account plans aligned to revenue targets.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end - prospecting, qualification, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.

• Build relationships from site teams through to the C-suite, positioning XYZ Reality as a strategic partner rather than a technology vendor.

• Turn customer delivery and cost challenges into compelling business cases that demonstrate ROI, risk reduction and operational impact.

• Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Project Delivery so that what we sell is what gets delivered on site, with a smooth handover after close.

• Build your own pipeline within your accounts, keep accurate forecasts and records in Salesforce, and support RFPs and formal bids, where required.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

  1. Proven experience owning complex, enterprise sales cycles with annual quotas.

  2. Track record of closing six-figure-plus deals with multiple stakeholders and long decision cycles.

  3. Strong experience in value-based and solution selling, including account planning.

  4. Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally for meetings, demos and site visits.

 

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

  1. Experience selling into data centre construction or other mission-critical environments.

  2. Background in construction technology, SaaS or cloud-based solutions.

  3. Comfortable engaging senior executives while also working on site with delivery teams.

  4. Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

  5. CRM discipline, ideally Salesforce, and comfort working within structured sales processes.

  6. Proactive, coachable and energised by building long-term customer relationships.

 

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

💰 Market leading OTE

🩺 Private healthcare

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🎄 Extra Christmas shutdown days

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to help achieve our mission.

You will work directly with founders and senior leaders on high-priority initiatives across hiring, market expansion, partnerships, operations, and growth.

This role is for highly capable generalists who enjoy solving problems, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We are looking for people who can turn ideas into execution and create meaningful impact from day one.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority projects across hiring, operations, growth, and market expansion.

  • Build relationships with candidates, recruiters, universities, communities, and external partners.

  • Support new market launches and expansion initiatives.

  • Help identify opportunities and solve operational challenges.

  • Represent ActAI at events, communities, and external engagements.

  • Work closely with founders on strategic initiatives.

  • Take ownership of projects from concept through execution.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to operate independently with limited structure.

  • Strong execution skills and bias toward action.

  • High ownership and willingness to take on unfamiliar challenges.

  • Comfortable working across multiple functions and disciplines.

  • Strong alignment with ActAI's mission and ambition.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
descriptionHtml:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout. Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues. Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur : 1. Analyse de documents 2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques 3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1. Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github ! A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)
Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles) Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater ! Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! Diversité & inclusion Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
