You'll lead discovery with enterprise clients, structure what they actually need, design the solution, defend it in the steering committee, and hand delivery a scope that holds. This is an Expert seat: the architecture benchmark of our Consulting Practice, no people management.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discovery and solution design on our enterprise engagements, turning ambiguous business problems into signed target architectures across CRM, data, custom software, and agentic AI

  • Own the architecture through delivery, so what you design in pre-sales is what gets built, without structural redesigns after signature

  • Scope six-figure engagements with estimates that hold, phasing that corporate procurement can sign, and risks named up front

  • Build the team's Solution Design Toolkit: discovery framework, architecture decision template, and an honest agentic-fit assessment that says where agents add value and where they don't

  • Present and defend architectures in front of CIOs, CFOs, and business unit heads, in German and English

  • Create reusable solution patterns (master data ownership between CRM and ERP, agent orchestration on HubSpot, data remediation before AI) that consultants and engineers actually use

  • Partner with our AI & Engineering Practice as the architecture counterpart: you own the solution design, they own the technical blueprint and the build

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 6+ years in consulting or solution architecture, with at least 2 years personally owning solution design for enterprise clients on the advisory or vendor side, from discovery to signature

  • A track record of structuring ambiguous business problems into architecture options, scope, and risk, with artefacts you produced yourself and can walk us through

  • Architecture-level fluency across at least one enterprise CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Dynamics), one ERP (SAP or Dynamics), data platforms (warehouse, CDP, or MDM), and integration patterns (event-driven, API, iPaaS or middleware)

  • At least one AI or agentic solution you designed or delivered that ran in production for a client, with business outcomes you can name and failures you can explain

  • Experience leading conversations with CIO, CFO, procurement, IT security, and business stakeholders inside corporate groups, including telling an executive no with a case behind it

  • Commercial judgment on scoping and estimating engagements, and ownership when estimates miss

  • German and English at full business fluency, with the ability to present the same architecture to a CFO and to a delivery team

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on HubSpot enterprise experience or HubSpot Solutions Architect certification (we fund it if you don't have it)

  • Direct experience with EU AI Act and DSGVO as design constraints in regulated industries (manufacturing, financial services, healthcare)

  • A background in one of our core client sectors: industrial manufacturing, building products, or B2B distribution

  • Talks, articles, or teaching on enterprise architecture or applied AI

Your Team

You'll join the Strategy Consulting team within Thorit's Consulting Practice, which owns the strategy layer of our engagements. The Team Lead Strategy Consulting seat is currently open, so you'll report directly to the Practice Lead Consulting until it is filled. Day to day you'll work with our CRM Implementation and Managed Services teams, the Project Management Practice, and the AI & Engineering Practice in Böblingen and Lisbon, which builds what you design. Our company language is English.

Tech Stack

  • Core: HubSpot (CRM, Marketing, Sales, Service, Operations Hub), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude AI

  • Architecture & design: architecture decision records, C4 and sequence diagrams, Miro

  • Enterprise landscape you design against: SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), CDP and MDM concepts, iPaaS and custom middleware

  • AI & agents: LLM-based agents on Claude and other models, retrieval, orchestration frameworks, evaluation and guardrails; the engineering team builds with Claude Code and Cursor

What We Offer

  • 31 days of paid vacation: 30 days plus one additional company day each year, well above the German statutory minimum of 20

  • Company pension (Allianz): employer contribution from your second year, rising with tenure from €50 to €290 per month

  • Lunch allowance: €5 tax-free per working day via Lunchit, up to €100 per month, usable anywhere

  • Business Bike: bicycle leasing through payroll with full insurance and free brand choice

  • Corporate Benefits: discounts across several hundred brands for private use

  • Hybrid Flex model: two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ, the rest where you work best

  • Real ownership: direct client leadership on enterprise engagements, and a Practice that builds and operates agentic systems rather than presenting them

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software agents that act on goals instead of waiting for clicks; for an enterprise, that translates into less manual work and more margin. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but a concrete example of an enterprise engagement where you personally took a client's business problem through discovery to a signed target architecture, including what you scoped, what you told the client not to build, and how far delivery deviated from your design, is required.

title: Expression of Interest
descriptionHtml:
Expression of Interest — Join Cosine

London, UK

About Cosine

Cosine is a UK-based AI lab building autonomous software engineering systems for organisations where reliability, security and control matter most. We develop the models, agent tooling, infrastructure and products that enable AI to tackle complex software engineering work in real customer environments.

Our work brings together research, engineering and commercial teams to deploy advanced AI across enterprise, government, defence and other highly regulated sectors.

We’re always hiring exceptional people

We welcome applications from talented people who want to help build Cosine, whether or not we have an advertised role that matches their experience.

For the right person, we can create an opportunity. This expression of interest is a direct route into our hiring process, allowing us to explore where your strengths could make the greatest contribution.

We’re particularly interested in ML engineers and researchers, alongside people with experience in software engineering, infrastructure, product, customer deployment and commercial growth.

Where you could make an impact

  • ML engineering and research: Improve model capabilities through training, post-training, data curation, evaluation and efficient inference.

  • Software and infrastructure: Build the agent systems, developer tooling and deployment infrastructure behind reliable AI software engineering.

  • Product and customer deployment: Turn advanced capabilities into useful products and deploy them successfully in complex customer environments.

  • Commercial and partnerships: Build relationships, develop markets and help enterprise and public sector organisations adopt Cosine.

These areas give a sense of our work. We also welcome applications from people whose expertise could strengthen Cosine in other ways.

What we look for

We value evidence of strong work: systems you’ve built, research you’ve delivered, products you’ve shipped or commercial outcomes you’ve achieved.

You’ll bring depth in your field, sound judgement and the ability to take ownership of difficult problems. You should enjoy working closely with people across disciplines and turning ideas into results.

What we offer

You’ll have meaningful ownership of problems across models, agents, infrastructure, product and deployment, working closely with colleagues across research, engineering and commercial teams.

This is an opportunity to shape technology used in environments where quality and reliability have real consequences.

Apply

Submit your CV or LinkedIn profile through the application form below, along with a short explanation of what you’d like to contribute at Cosine. Include relevant projects, publications, a portfolio or examples of your work where useful.

Where we see a strong fit, we’ll arrange an initial conversation to discuss your experience and the role we could build around it.

You don’t need to wait for a matching vacancy. Apply below.

  

Cosine is an equal opportunity employer.

We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

  

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

What you can expect:

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

  • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

  • Dog-friendly office - bring your dog to work

  • Weekly team breakfast & lunch

  • Monthly socials

  • Pension

  • High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work - not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you want structure, clarity, strong collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

  

Agency & Data Protection Notice

To comply with UK GDPR and our internal data-protection and equal-opportunity obligations, we only accept candidate applications and agency submissions via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). This ensures appropriate privacy notices, lawful processing, auditability, and consistent retention controls.

Any CVs or candidate details received outside the ATS (including via email, Slack, or direct message) will be treated as unsolicited, will not be considered as part of the recruitment process, and will not give rise to any fee or payment obligation.

descriptionHtml:

Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken?
Lightspeed ist die führende All-in-One-Plattform für Handel und Gastronomie. Nach dem erfolgreichen Launch in allen deutschen Großstädten ist Stuttgart unser nächster Stopp! Als KI-getriebenes Tech-Unternehmen bieten wir dir eines der besten SaaS-Produkte auf dem Markt.

title: FINANCE DIRECTOR (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Perspektive CFO | FINANCE & CONTROLLING | TRANSFORMATION | NRW

DAS UNTERNEHMEN

Unser Mandant ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich People Services mit mehreren Standorten in Europa.

Das Unternehmen befindet sich auf einem ambitionierten Wachstumspfad und wird von einem renommierten Private-Equity-Investor begleitet. Im Mittelpunkt der nächsten Entwicklungsphase stehen die weitere Professionalisierung der Organisation, die Digitalisierung zentraler Unternehmensprozesse sowie der Ausbau einer skalierbaren Unternehmensstruktur.

Finance übernimmt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: Ziel ist es, eine leistungsfähige Steuerungsfunktion aufzubauen, die Transparenz schafft, Wachstum ermöglicht und die Grundlage für zukünftige strategische Entwicklungen bildet.

Für diese anspruchsvolle Aufgabe suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die die Transformation des Unternehmens aktiv begleitet und den Finanzbereich konsequent weiterentwickelt.


DIE HERAUSFORDERUNG

Als Finance Director berichten Sie direkt an den CEO und übernehmen die Verantwortung für die operative Steuerung der Bereiche Finance und Controlling.

Ihr Fokus liegt dabei weniger auf der klassischen Finanzverwaltung als vielmehr auf der Entwicklung einer modernen Steuerungsfunktion, die den Anforderungen eines wachstumsorientierten und international aufgestellten Unternehmens gerecht wird.

Zu Ihren wesentlichen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Verantwortung für Finance & Controlling einschließlich der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung beider Bereiche
  • Aufbau einer skalierbaren Finance-Organisation, die das zukünftige Wachstum der Unternehmensgruppe unterstützt
  • Professionalisierung von Controlling-, Reporting-, Forecast- und Budgetierungsprozessen
  • Entwicklung aussagekräftiger KPIs sowie transparenter Steuerungsinstrumente für Management und Investoren
  • Digitalisierung und Standardisierung der Finance-Prozesse
  • Business Partner des CEOs sowie der internationalen Führungskräfte in allen finanzwirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Profitabilität, Effizienz und Cashflow
  • Unterstützung strategischer Wachstums- und Transformationsprojekte
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den internationalen Gesellschaften zur Etablierung einheitlicher Finanzstandards
  • Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen im Rahmen zukünftiger M&A- oder Exit-Aktivitäten
  • Mitwirkung an der strategischen Vorbereitung und finanziellen Steuerung eines zukünftigen Shareholder-Exits

    • Sie leisten damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens und schaffen die finanzielle Transparenz, die für nachhaltiges Wachstum und zukünftige Transaktionen erforderlich ist.


    IHR PROFIL

    Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Finance & Controlling und verstehen Finance als aktiven Treiber unternehmerischer Entscheidungen.

    Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Finance- oder Controlling-Funktion, beispielsweise als Head of Controlling, Finance Director, Senior Finance Manager oder Finance Business Partner
  • Einen ausgeprägten Controlling-Hintergrund sowie Erfahrung in der finanziellen Steuerung wachsender Unternehmen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Professionalisierung von Finance- und Controlling-Strukturen
  • Hohe Affinität zu KPIs, Datenanalysen und digitalen Finance-Prozessen
  • Erfahrung in Private-Equity-geprägten Unternehmen oder vergleichbaren leistungsorientierten Umfeldern
  • Kenntnisse in der Vorbereitung oder Begleitung von Financial Due Diligence-, M&A- oder Exit-Prozessen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, finanzielle Zusammenhänge in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen zu übersetzen
  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität kombiniert mit hoher analytischer Kompetenz

    • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.


    WAS DIESE ROLLE BESONDERS MACHT

    Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, den Finanzbereich einer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe entscheidend weiterzuentwickeln und die Transformation des Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

    Gemeinsam mit dem CEO schaffen Sie die finanziellen und organisatorischen Voraussetzungen für die nächste Wachstumsphase und begleiten den weiteren Wertaufbau des Unternehmens.

    Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die:

  • Finance als Steuerungsfunktion versteht
  • Transparenz schafft und fundierte Managemententscheidungen ermöglicht
  • skalierbare Strukturen entwickelt, die mit dem Unternehmen wachsen
  • Transformation pragmatisch und nachhaltig vorantreibt

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Utilities
descriptionHtml:
Jij vertaalt complexe vraagstukken in energie en infrastructuur naar AI die echt wordt gebruikt.

Van netcongestie en aansluitaanvragen tot inspecties en klantprocessen: utilities werken met complexe systemen, grote hoeveelheden informatie en hoge eisen aan betrouwbaarheid.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je dicht op de operatie van de klant. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI voor processen die moeten blijven draaien

Je kent de praktijk van energiebedrijven, netbeheerders of andere utilities: technische assets, werkorders, klantvragen, datastromen en de afstemming tussen operationele en IT-systemen. Denk aan:

  • Aansluitaanvragen sneller verwerken in tijden van netcongestie, met AI die de informatie ordent en medewerkers helpt bij de beoordeling.

  • Agents die inspectierapporten, technische documentatie en werkorders samenvatten en voorbereiden voor monteurs en planners.

  • Klantcontact over contracten en jaarafrekeningen.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in utilities, zoals energie, netbeheer of technische infrastructuur: je kent de processen, data en systemen van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met assetmanagement, slimme-meterdata of OT/IT, en met klassieke ML zoals lastprognoses.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d), B2B & Venture Development
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Bling ist Deutschlands führende Familien-Finanz-App: Taschengeldkarte, Sparfunktionen und Finanzbildung für über 150.000 Familien. Auf dieser Infrastruktur bauen wir gerade zwei B2B-Ventures auf und du arbeitest an beiden, als rechte Hand unseres Growth Lead B2B und des Geschäftsführers von Bling Schule. Du übernimmst die Themen mit der höchsten Priorität, übersetzt strategisches Potenzial in umsetzbare Projekte, schaffst Prozesse, die skalieren, und machst uns dort schneller, wo es den größten Unterschied macht.

Bling Schule ist eine eigene Gesellschaft und digitalisiert den Schulalltag: Schulverpflegung, Schulkiosk, Klassenkasse und Abrechnung auf einer Plattform, über 100 Einrichtungen sind live. Der Markt ist von veralteter Software geprägt, rund ein Drittel aller Schulen arbeitet noch komplett analog. Ein Speedboat mit Startup-Charakter, nur mit dem Rückenwind eines Scale-ups.

Bling for Banks ist unsere White-Label-Lösung für Familienbanking: Banken bekommen ihre eigene, gebrandete Familien-App, wir betreiben Technologie und Regulatorik im Hintergrund. Für sie ist das die Antwort auf ein bekanntes Problem ohne bisherige Lösung – den Verlust der nächsten Kundengeneration an Neobanken. In dieser Form gibt es das im deutschen Markt nicht. Unsere Pipeline ist stark, mehrere Banken sind bereits in der LOI-Phase, und wir bauen damit einen Präzedenzfall für einen ganzen Sektor. Wer hier zuerst liefert, definiert den Standard. Deshalb zählt jede Woche.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Strategische Projekte & Partnerschaften

  • Du planst und setzt strategische Projekte gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung um und identifizierst die Themen mit dem größten Hebel und schaffst die Grundlage dafür, dass wir 2027 auf das Zehnfache skalieren können.
  • Du findest, bewertest und qualifizierst Multiplikatoren und strategische Partner jeglicher Form, bereitest die Termine vor und begleitest sie bis zum Abschluss inklusive Unterstützung bei Verhandlungen, Erstellung von Entscheidungsvorlagen & Onboarding.

2. Sales Enablement & Pipeline

  • Du baust Prozesse, Sequenzen und CRM-Strukturen auf, die systematisch qualifizierte Leads erzeugen und steuerst Outbound-Kampagnen mit.
  • Du analysierst KPIs entlang des Sales-Funnels und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab

3. AI Operations & GTM-Engineering

  • Wir sind bewusst AI-first. Du baust eigene Workflows mit Tools wie Claude und n8n, um Recherche, Outreach, Analyse und Reporting zu skalieren
  • Du automatisierst unsere Kern- und Betriebsprozesse, wo der Hebel am größten ist und du erledigst damit Themen, für die früher ganze Teams nötig waren

4. Special Projects

  • Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Projekte mit Sales, Operations, Product, Finance und Legal
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Gründerteam an C-Level-Themen für Investoren, Joint Ventures und strategischen Partnern
  • Du agierst als unternehmerischer Allrounder mit hoher Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit und Hands-on-Mentalität und treibst Themen an, die keinem Team fest zugeordnet sind, aber gemacht werden müssen

Dein Profil

Wie du denkst und was du aufgebaut hast, zählt mehr als wo du warst.

  • Ownership. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, und fängst an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.
  • Company Building. Du willst aus erster Hand erleben, wie ein Unternehmen von null aufgebaut wird, so effizient und AI-native wie heute möglich.
  • Strategische Tiefe. Du verstehst Marktdynamiken schnell, kommst von Daten zu Entscheidungen und bist ein echter Sparringspartner für die Geschäftsführung.
  • Context Switching. Du kommst mit Mehrdeutigkeit und parallelen Prioritäten klar und behältst bei zwei Ventures mit unterschiedlicher Taktzahl den Faden.
  • Technische Affinität. AI-Tools und Automatisierung sind für dich keine Spielerei, sondern deine Arbeitsweise. Eigene Workflows sind ein starkes Plus.
  • Interesse an Fintech. Beide Ventures sind im Kern Fintech, auch der Schulbereich. Erfahrung oder echte Neugier für Fintech, Payments oder Bildung macht den Unterschied.
  • Der Rahmen: Du hast erste Praxiserfahrung durch Praktika oder Jobs in schnelllebigen Umfeldern, ein laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Studium (jeder Background willkommen). descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The role

You build a new business line at Andercore from zero. You win the first customers yourself, you build the sales and service system behind them, and you own the number. No playbook, no handover. The CEO is your direct counterpart.

We have built this before in one category. You do it again for the next one.

title: Full Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster.

In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries.

We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further.

 

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

 

🥖 The Role

You'll work closely with a small, high-calibre team of engineers, designers and domain experts to build and scale the tools that power our installer software, owning and delivering complex features end-to-end from day one.

The problem space is deep and varied, including:

  • Heat loss modelling and hydronic system design

  • 2D and 3D floor-plan tooling using LiDAR and computer vision

  • Large-scale data ingestion and geospatial analysis

  • Offline-first, collaborative PWAs

  • Hardware integrations (Bluetooth measurement tools, sensors, monitoring systems)

This is not CRUD-only work. You'll be working on meaningful production problems from day one that blend physical reality, real-world constraints, and serious impact.

 

🥞 Tech Stack

Our tech stack strives for simplicity, symmetry and efficiency. Our hard problems come from the real world instead of self-made architectural problems.

You don't need to know all of the below, but you do need an appetite for full stack mastery and owning the problem end to end:

  • Docker, Docker Compose

  • PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Atlas migrations

  • Node, Prisma

  • React, TypeScript, Konva, Tailwind

 

🫵 About You

We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft.

We're hiring at mid-level: you've probably been shipping production code for a few years. We care less about titles and more about impact, judgment, and intent. You'll likely have experience with:

  • Modern JavaScript / TypeScript and frontend frameworks

  • Backend development and API design

  • Relational databases and data modelling

But more importantly, you are:

  • Product-minded – you want to understand real users and real problems, not just tickets;

  • Impact-driven – you balance technical quality with momentum and know when "good enough" is exactly right;

  • Comfortable with ownership – you take responsibility for outcomes, not just code;

  • Candid and collaborative – you challenge ideas openly, receive feedback well, and optimise for the team over ego;

  • Already using AI intensively – you use it every day to make yourself disproportionately more effective, and you can show us how.

… and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

 

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 £50–100k salary, depending on experience

  • 🍰 Equity (options) in the company

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 2 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday (25 plus bank holidays) and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover (Vitality)

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

 

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team of 35, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2–3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone together every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it and what we can learn – and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

title: General Accountant - Accounts Payable
descriptionHtml:
About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a General Accountant - Accounts Payable 

As a General Accountant - Accounts Payable, you will keep our vendor payments accurate, controlled and on time across multiple entities and currencies as Upsun grows globally.

You will join our Finance and Accounting team of 9 people, which provides accurate reporting, strong controls and operational rigour across the business.You will work closely with accounting and consolidation on month-end close and reconciliations, support the external audit, partner with FP&A on spend visibility, and manage relationships with suppliers and our banking and treasury partners.

What to expect

  • Own the procure-to-pay cycle: Manage AP across our 8 entities in Europe, North America and APAC, from vendor master data and invoice processing to employee expense reimbursements, preparing payment runs for execution with our Treasury team.
  • Process accurately and on time: Match invoices and code to the correct GL accounts, cost centers and VAT/tax codes.
  • Work across entities and jurisdictions: Record AP transactions in line with local statutory and group reporting requirements, including VAT/tax treatment, intercompany recharges and multi-currency postings.
  • Manage employee expenses: Review and process expense reports and reimbursements in Payhawk, checking them against the expense policy and supporting receipts. Make sure they’re coded correctly with VAT recovered, and that card transactions are reconciled.
  • Protect every payment: Apply AP and payment controls, including approval workflows, segregation of duties, vendor bank detail verification and duplicate-payment checks, with documentation ready for audit.
  • Partner across the business: Be the go-to contact for the CFO, FP&A and employees across the company on supplier spend, payments and vendor questions.
  • Own your part of the close: Reconcile the AP subledger to the GL, book accruals and prepayments, reconcile employee expense and card accounts, and support the monthly close and external audit.
  • Resolve exceptions: Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, payment rejections, vendor statement differences and employee reimbursement queries across currencies and time zones.
  • Improve daily workflows: Maximize use of our ERP and AP tool (Payhawk) to reduce manual work. Share ideas to automate routine AP tasks, and help the team put them in place.

What you bring

  • Accounting standards: Hands-on experience applying IFRS, French GAAP (PCG) or US GAAP to AP transactions, accruals and reconciliations, plus working knowledge of VAT/GST on purchases.
  • AP operations experience: You have run AP workstreams independently in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment. Covering invoice processing, employee expenses, payment proposals and vendor reconciliations.
  • Controls knowledge: You understand payment and internal controls (approvals, segregation of duties, vendor bank changes), and you apply them consistently. You know when to escalate a high-risk item.
  • Systems skills: You are proficient with a modern ERP such as NetSuite, banking platforms, and AP automation tools. You also have advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Precision and remote collaboration: You are detail-oriented and deadline-driven, especially at month-end. You work well with others remotely across time zones.

Bonus points

  • CPA or an equivalent qualification, such as ACCA.
  • Working proficiency in French.
  • Experience using AP automation tools to reduce manual work.
  • High-growth SaaS or tech environment: used to fast-changing processes and scaling.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Canada, France or Spain. We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

You can expect interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below.

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP&A and IT)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (Director & IC)
  4. 60 Minutes with Cross Team (Data and Analytics) 

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven by making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

WPP is embarking on a major, multi-year global CRM transformation to create a simpler, more connected and consistent approach to managing our clients and growth opportunities across the organisation. The programme will consolidate CRM platforms and processes, standardise core client, pipeline and opportunity management practices, and strengthen the data, integration and governance foundations needed to provide a trusted global view of our clients.

We’re looking for a Global Programme Director, CRM to lead this transformation end to end, turning our ambition into an executable global programme and bringing together business, technology, data, architecture and change teams across agencies and markets.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who can navigate the complexity of a federated global organisation, challenge legacy ways of working and drive the decisions, delivery discipline and adoption needed to establish a common global CRM capability.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the global CRM transformation vision, roadmap and delivery strategy, translating strategic ambition into a clear, executable multi-year programme across agencies and markets.
  • Lead the consolidation and simplification of CRM platforms and processes, establishing a clear approach to global standardisation while managing legitimate local requirements.
  • Drive the adoption of common global processes across client and contact management, pipeline and opportunity management, forecasting, client planning and cross-agency collaboration.
  • Lead programme delivery across CRM product, architecture, data, integrations, security, testing, migration, cutover and deployment, working closely with Enterprise Technology and business leaders.

  • Challenge complexity, local exceptions and assumptions that could undermine the global outcome, balancing business requirements with simplicity, scalability and long-term value.

What you'll need:

  • Strong change and adoption capability, with experience embedding new processes and ways of working and measuring whether transformation has genuinely landed.
  • The ability to translate complex programme, technology and data issues into clear executive-level decisions, risks and trade-offs.
  • A pragmatic, resilient and outcome-focused leadership style, comfortable operating through ambiguity and making difficult decisions when delivery is at risk

Desirable

  • CRM platform certification or deep delivery experience within an enterprise Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 environment.
  • Change management accreditation such as Prosci, or equivalent practical experience leading enterprise-scale adoption.

Who you are:

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a contributor in the SRE organization, you are passionate about delivering solutions to the real-time problems our mission-critical cloud native services encounter. You are also obsessed about achieving the high quality and reliability our customers demand. You will work closely not only with the SRE division, but your technical deliverables will reach the entire engineering organization to enable product teams to continuously deliver features on the vanguard of innovation.

What You'll Do

Location: Remote anywhere in Australia

  • Contribute to building and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure cloud platforms and tools.
  • Apply site reliability engineering principles to improve system stability and performance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues in distributed cloud-native systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support service reliability and operational excellence.
  • Create and maintain documentation to support engineers and improve self-service capabilities.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, learning best practices along the way.

Grow your skills under the guidance of senior team members, while contributing to team knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • About 1 year of experience in a software engineering, SRE, or infrastructure role
  • Australian government security clearance, or ability to obtain clearance (AUS citizenship) required
  • Solid understanding of operating systems, preferably Linux
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or similar
  • Experience with Kubernetes platforms like AKS, EKS, or similar
  • Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Go, C#, Java, or similar
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation practices
  • Experience with observability tools (logging, metrics, APM)
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, ARM, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Exposure to AI development tools

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus and Restricted Stock Unit Eligibility
  • Attractive Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Stipend for Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave for All Employees
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness Support
  • Learning & Development Programs

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not ----- or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to

title: Growth Analytics Associate
descriptionHtml:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Growth Manager - Business Expansion (Berlin)
descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager - Business Expansion (Berlin)

Salary Range: €50k-€65k

At a Glance

You'll win new advertisers and turn their first campaigns into growing, long-term partnerships with Almedia. You'll own the journey from prospecting and closing to campaign launch, optimization, and initial scale-up.

This is a hands-on sales role with clear revenue ownership. Closing the deal is the starting point: you'll learn Almedia’s products in depth, understand what drives campaign performance, and help advertisers build the confidence to commit larger budgets.

 

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Win new business. Identify and engage advertisers, and publishers. Build your pipeline through targeted outreach, referrals, industry events, and your network.

  • Own the full sales cycle. Lead discovery, pitches, proposals, negotiations, and closing. Understand each advertiser’s goals, buying process, and performance expectations.

  • Learn the product deeply. Build a working understanding of Almedia’s platform, campaign setup, targeting, reward structures, reporting, and optimization tools. Use that knowledge to propose campaigns that can deliver.

  • Own the first campaigns. Coordinate setup and launch with advertisers and internal teams. Agree on test budgets, performance targets, measurement, and clear criteria for scaling.

  • Optimize and scale. Monitor early campaign performance, identify what limits delivery or returns, and take action. Use Almedia’s internal tools to adjust campaign settings and ROAS targets, working with Growth and algorithm teams to improve results.

  • Turn results into larger budgets. Translate campaign data into clear recommendations. Secure budget increases, expand into new geographies or operating systems, and move successful tests into sustained spending.

  • Solve problems early. Spot underdelivery, attribution discrepancies, or performance issues before they damage advertiser confidence. Coordinate resolution and keep the advertiser informed.

  • Deliver revenue targets. Take responsibility for new advertiser acquisition and the revenue generated as their initial campaigns scale. Prioritize opportunities with meaningful commercial potential.

  • Keep a reliable forecast. Maintain an accurate pipeline and a clear view of launch readiness, campaign progress, and expected budget growth.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Days 1–30: Learn Almedia’s products, sales process, and campaign optimization fundamentals. Shadow sales and campaign reviews, build your target-account list, and begin outreach.

  • Days 31–60: Own discovery calls, pitches, and proposals. Build a qualified pipeline and work alongside experienced Growth Managers on campaign setup, performance analysis, and optimization decisions.

  • Days 61–90: Close your first advertiser partnerships and own their initial campaign launches. Identify performance improvements, make optimization recommendations, and secure budget increases where results support scaling.

  • Beyond 90 days: Build a repeatable record of winning advertisers and growing their spend. Take on larger opportunities and contribute to Almedia’s commercial growth.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • A record of winning business. You've acquired customers, negotiated agreements, and delivered measurable revenue results in sales, business development, or a commercially focused growth role.

  • The drive to create opportunities. You're comfortable opening doors, reaching decision-makers, and building a pipeline through your own initiative.

  • A consultative sales approach. You ask sharp questions, understand advertiser priorities, and connect your proposal to a clear business outcome.

  • Campaign optimization skills. You can read performance data, diagnose why a campaign is underperforming, and propose changes to improve delivery and returns. You're comfortable forming a hypothesis, running a test, and deciding whether to scale.

  • The ability to learn a technical product. You want to understand how Almedia works in practice. You can learn its tools and explain campaign mechanics clearly to advertisers.

  • Confidence with performance metrics. You understand ROAS, LTV, retention, ARPU, and cohort performance—and how they influence optimization decisions and advertiser budgets.

  • Commercial judgment. You know how to balance an advertiser’s performance goals with a sustainable commercial outcome for Almedia.

  • Ownership and discipline. You follow through, keep your forecast honest, and take responsibility for both closing deals and helping initial campaigns succeed.

     

Bonus Points If You

  • You speak Russian or Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

  • Have sold performance marketing, mobile advertising, adtech, or user acquisition solutions.

  • Have hands-on experience optimizing mobile gaming, app, or rewarded user acquisition campaigns.

  • Have relationships with studios, app publishers, agencies, or advertisers expanding internationally.

  • Have turned small campaign tests into significant, sustained advertiser spending.

 

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: Get It Done. You stay involved from the first conversation through launch and initial scale-up. You bring the right people together and keep progress moving.

  • Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You find promising advertisers and spot opportunities to improve their campaigns before they ask.

  • Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You launch focused tests, respect the time needed to evaluate results, and make timely decisions based on what you learn.

  • Focus on Impact: Deliver What Matters Most. You prioritize advertisers and campaign improvements with the greatest potential to generate sustainable revenue.

  • Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. You make credible commitments, understand the product you sell, and use each campaign to improve the next one.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €50K – €65K

title: Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

About the Growth team

Growth Marketing at Alan covers a broad range of opportunities, including acquisition, segment and market growth, partnerships, content, experimentation, and international expansion.

We are looking for adaptable marketers who can take ownership of a defined growth problem, learn quickly, and evolve as our priorities change.

 

Your mission

As a Growth Marketer, you will independently own an ambiguous but defined Growth problem from diagnosis through execution. You will prioritise the highest-impact actions, coordinate the relevant stakeholders, and connect your work to measurable business outcomes.

Concretely, our team works on missions such as:

  • Developing our channels: scaling paid acquisition, growing visibility in AI search and LLMs like ChatGPT, or growing our strategic partnerships

  • Crafting the go-to-market strategy for our different segments (e.g. retirees, freelancers, companies,...)

  • Producing performance creatives with AI workflows to create assets at scale

Missions you could work on include:

  • Scale Alan's referral program

  • Develop and optimise our B2B and B2C growth through LinkedIn Ads

  • Own search acquisition across markets

 

What you will do

  • Independently own an ambiguous but defined Growth problem from diagnosis through execution.

  • Prioritise high-impact opportunities and make clear trade-offs.

  • Design and run experiments, campaigns, or programmes end to end.

  • Coordinate the relevant stakeholders and move initiatives forward with limited direction.

  • Use business and performance data to make decisions and establish a clear learning loop.

  • Adapt your approach based on results, customer insight, and feedback.

  • Connect your work to measurable business outcomes.

What we are looking for

  • Experience owning a meaningful Growth, acquisition, segment, market, or related Marketing scope.

  • Strong problem-framing, prioritisation, and experimentation skills.

  • Ability to make decisions based on evidence and business impact.

  • Hands-on execution combined with an understanding of adjacent teams and activities.

  • Ability to work with limited direction in an ambiguous environment.

  • Clear communication and constructive stakeholder management.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to expand your scope over time.

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C1 level range.

 

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

title: Hauswart (m/w/d) - Berlin-Lichtenrade
descriptionHtml:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Deine Rolle

Für eine von uns verwaltete Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaft in Berlin-Lichtenrade suchen wir eine zuverlässige Persönlichkeit, die sich um die Wohnanlage kümmert. Du wirst direkt bei der WEG angestellt, die Verwaltung der Anlage übernimmt Ralph und ist im Alltag deine Ansprechpartnerin. Vor Ort bist du das Gesicht der Gemeinschaft für Eigentümer, Mieter und Dienstleister.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Regelmäßige Kontrollgänge durch Gebäude, Außenanlagen und Technikräume

  • Reinigung der Treppenhäuser und Flure, Kontrolle von Ordnung und Sauberkeit sowie Betreuung der Müllstandsflächen

  • Kleinreparaturen und Instandhaltungsarbeiten, z. B. an Leuchtmitteln, Türschließern, Briefkästen und Armaturen

  • Pflege der Außenanlagen sowie Winterdienst nach Bedarf

  • Überwachung der Haustechnik (Heizung, Beleuchtung, Aufzug) und Meldung von Störungen

  • Koordination und Begleitung von Handwerkern und Dienstleistern vor Ort sowie Ansprechperson für Bewohner bei Fragen und Anliegen rund um die Anlage

  • Enge Abstimmung mit der Hausverwaltung bei Ralph und Dokumentation von Mängeln und erledigten Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine Ausbildung im Handwerk oder vergleichbares

  • Berufserfahrung: keine Mindestdauer, Erfahrung als Hauswart oder Hausmeister ist von Vorteil

  • Handwerkliches Geschick

  • Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit Smartphone oder Tablet zur Dokumentation

  • Bonus: abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem handwerklichen oder technischen Beruf

  • Bonus: Führerschein Klasse B

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Verbindlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung

  • Starkes Kommunikationsvermögen und Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und digitale Tools

  • Deutsch: C1

Das bieten wir

  • Eine unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit bei der WEG

  • Freie Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der vereinbarten Aufgaben

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung

  • Eine feste Ansprechperson bei der Hausverwaltung und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Einen Arbeitsplatz in Berlin-Lichtenrade, gut erreichbar mit S-Bahn (S2) und Bus

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Interview mit Recruiting

  2. Interview mit dem Beirat und dem Geschäftsführer von Ralph

title: Head of Marketing, ET Academy
descriptionHtml:
À propos d'ET Academy

ET Academy est la formation créée par Eva ----- 347 000 abonnés sur Instagram), créatrice de contenu voyage. Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres.

Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta.

Le défi

Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes :

  • La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils.

  • Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence.

  • L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories.

Tes missions

Ads et acquisition payante

  • Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois.

  • Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA.

  • Tester chaque semaine de nouvelles créas et audiences, couper ce qui ne marche pas, scaler ce qui marche.

  • Affiner le ciblage sur les profils qui achètent vraiment, à partir des retours de l'équipe sales et des données CRM.

Contenu et organique

  • Construire la ligne éditoriale avec Eva : piliers de contenu, formats, fréquence de publication.

  • Structurer les Reels, carrousels et posts : idées, accroches, scripts, CTA et mots‑clés ManyChat.

  • Structurer et publier les stories chaque jour : séquences, sondages, preuves sociales, appels à l'action vers nos tunnels.

  • Préparer et animer chaque semaine le live avec Eva : thème, déroulé, promotion en amont, relance des inscrites.

  • Analyser les performances des contenus pour reproduire ce qui fonctionne.

Tunnels et qualification

  • Auditer chaque tunnel (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources, pages d'opt‑in, questions de qualification) et prioriser les améliorations.

  • Tester de nouvelles pages, de nouveaux messages et de nouvelles questions de qualification.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec le Head of Sales sur la qualité des leads, le taux de prise de rendez‑vous et le taux de présence aux appels.

  • Automatiser ce qui peut l'être (ManyChat, emails, relances) en tirant parti de l'IA, notamment Claude.

Tracking, data et attribution

  • Mettre en place un tracking très précis de bout en bout, du contenu et des ads jusqu'aux tunnels, au setting et au closing, pour attribuer chaque vente à sa vraie source.

  • Suivre les performances de chaque tunnel : coût par lead, taux de qualification, prise de rendez‑vous, présence, closing.

  • Construire et tenir le reporting marketing, et le présenter chaque semaine à l'équipe.

  • Repérer dans les données les leviers d'optimisation, les prioriser et les mettre en œuvre.

Ton profil

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en marketing d'acquisition, idéalement dans l'infoproduit, le coaching ou la création de contenu.

  • Tu as déjà géré un Business Manager Meta et des budgets publicitaires, avec des résultats chiffrés à montrer.

  • Tu sais imaginer des créas et des contenus qui performent.

  • Tu comprends un tunnel de vente de bout en bout et tu maîtrises le tracking (pixel, UTM, CRM).

  • Tu prends des initiatives sans attendre qu'on te le demande.

  • Tu innoves et tu proposes sans cesse de nouvelles idées à tester.

  • Tu es très organisé : priorités claires, process, suivi rigoureux.

  • Tu es autonome, à l'aise avec les chiffres et les outils d'IA.

  • Tu parles français couramment.

Ce qu'on te propose

  • Un poste à temps plein ou quasi temps plein, 100 % en télétravail. On cherche quelqu'un de vraiment disponible pour tout ce qu'il y a à faire.

  • Une mission sans durée limitée, avec un démarrage début décembre 2026.

  • Une rémunération au‑dessus du marché, avec une part variable liée à la performance.

  • Une petite équipe soudée et orientée résultats, en lien direct avec Eva et la direction.

Le process

  1. Candidature sur Join : CV et exemples de campagnes ou de contenus, avec leurs résultats.

  2. Test pratique : une mise en situation concrète sur nos vrais enjeux (tunnels, créas, contenus), pour voir comment tu réfléchis et comment tu travailles.

  3. Call avec Eva et Pierre, les responsables de la formation.
