title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Head of UK, Ad Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers, agencies and strategic partners to help businesses unlock value through AI-powered advertising solutions while maintaining strong standards for user trust, platform integrity and responsible innovation.

As OpenAI’s advertising business continues to scale, the Head of UK will play a critical role in growing the UK business, building strategic advertiser and agency relationships, and developing a high-performing commercial team. You will work closely with EMEA and global leadership to translate OpenAI’s advertising strategy into a clear plan for the UK market.

About the Role

We are seeking a Head of UK, Ad Solutions to lead and scale OpenAI’s advertising business in the United Kingdom. Based in London, you will lead a team of Client Partners and Customer Success Managers supporting UK advertisers and agencies, with responsibility for country strategy, revenue performance and advertiser success.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will identify the sectors, customers and partnerships that offer the greatest opportunity for sustainable growth, build executive-level relationships across the UK advertising industry, and establish the operating discipline needed to deliver ambitious commercial goals.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations and Policy teams to ensure UK advertiser needs inform product development and go-to-market decisions. Working alongside regional and global account teams, you will also help UK-based advertisers and agencies grow their international activity through coordinated account plans.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the UK advertising market with strong people leadership, commercial judgement and operational rigour. You are equally comfortable coaching a team, engaging a CMO or agency leader, solving customer challenges and building a business in a fast-moving environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the UK commercial strategy, revenue goals and business performance, translating regional priorities into clear plans and accountable execution.

  • Recruit, lead, coach and develop a team of Client Partners and Customer Success Managers, building a high-performance, inclusive and customer-focused culture.

  • Drive forecasting, pipeline management, account and territory planning, and business reviews to improve execution and revenue predictability.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in digital advertising, media or technology, with a strong track record in senior commercial leadership.

  • Have experience leading high-performing sales, account management, customer success or revenue teams, including hiring and developing exceptional talent.

  • Bring deep knowledge of the UK advertising ecosystem, including major advertisers, agency holding companies, independent agencies and technology partners.

  • Can build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and agency leaders, and personally influence complex, strategic commercial opportunities.

title: Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems.

  • Kinematics Power Sizing: Size and integrate high-acceleration hydraulic, pneumatic, or spring-loaded actuation systems, high-speed release mechanisms, and custom dampening systems capable of handling extreme dynamic loads.

  • Autonomous Launch Operations: Design reliable mechanical systems capable of operating independently in harsh, remotely supervised environments—handling self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and system resets.

  • Structural Engineering & Validation: Perform hand calculations and FEA to size heavy-duty structural weldments and moving assemblies, accounting for weld fatigue, shock, and sudden violent loads.

  • Testing & Prototyping: Build custom test benches and field rigs to validate designs, running physical stress tests to failure and iterating rapidly on hardware.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Flight Dynamics to define launch requirements, and work alongside Hardware and Embedded Software engineers to synchronize mechanical actuation with automated launch code.

  • Supplier & Project Ownership: Manage project budgets, timelines, and technical documentation (2D/3D CAD, BOMs, test reports) while partnering with suppliers on heavy-precision machining and series production.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Mechanical & Structural Design: Proven track record designing large-scale, heavily loaded machinery, structural weldments, and rugged mechanisms from scratch (ideally in aerospace, defense, heavy equipment, or robotics).

  • Kinematics Expertise: Deep hands-on experience sizing and designing moving assemblies, high-speed release mechanisms, and pneumatic or hydraulic circuits (cylinders, accumulators, valves) under high-acceleration forces.

  • CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases.

  • Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests.

  • Communication & Mission Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication to document complex engineering decisions, paired with full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, pace, and growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Human Resources Administrator
descriptionHtml:
About Us
At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.

The Role
This role reports to our Chief of Staff and works closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business. It is part-time and currently set at two days per week (0.4FTE).

You’ll keep our people operations running smoothly as we grow, from the moment a candidate accepts an offer to the everyday policies, systems and reporting that help our team do their best work. You’ll make sure the details are right, the paperwork is compliant, and every new joiner gets a great first impression of algo1.

What You’ll Own

  • Support our hiring process. Coordinate the admin behind every hire, keeping candidates and hiring managers informed and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between offer and first day.

  • Manage right to work and visas. Carry out right to work checks, manage visa and sponsorship processes, and keep accurate, compliant records.

  • Prepare offers and contracts. Customise offer letters and employment contracts for each new hire, and manage the signing process through DocuSign.

  • Maintain people policies and processes. Keep our policies and processes up to date, and communicate them clearly so everyone knows how things work and where to find them.

  • Run our people systems. Look after our people systems and the data within them, keeping records accurate and processes efficient.

About You

Must Have

  • People operations experience. Experience in an HR / people operations or recruitment coordination role, ideally in a fast-growing business.

  • Attention to detail. A meticulous approach to contracts, records and data, with the discretion to handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Systems confidence. Comfort working with HR systems, e-signature tools like DocuSign, and spreadsheets to keep data accurate and produce reports.

This is a fast-paced environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and organised. If you’re happiest when you’re making things run better, you’ll fit right in.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is a part-time, office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from working together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it’s easy to get to and a great place to be.

What We Offer

title: Industrial Designer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As an Industrial Designer at Vesoma, you design a humanoid robot built to live and work beside people. You own the human side of the product: the surfaces, materials, and details people see and touch. You are involved in every stage of development and work at every scale, from the first impression to the smallest fastener.

You will join Vesoma's internal design studio. The studio owns everything from product strategy and early concepts to final CAD surfaces and brand assets. Your core is industrial design, but we look for range. A wide set of interests and skills lets you support needs across the whole company.

Key responsibilities

  • Shape how the robot looks and feels. Develop the design language from first sketch to production part. Keep it consistent across every part you touch.

  • Own your scope of the exterior. Design the outer surfaces assigned to you and make them work through the full range of motion. Define panel gaps, parting lines, and material intent. Solve pinch points, collisions, and cable routing with mechanical engineering. Hold fit and finish all the way to production.

  • Design for the people around it. Find every point where people meet the robot: handles, contact surfaces, indicators, controls. Map them early and design them on purpose.

  • Work alongside engineering, not after it. Partner with manufacturing and systems integration so every design can be prototyped fast and built at volume.

  • Carry the language past the robot. Packaging, accessories, and everything else people handle. Give them the same care.

  • Sketch, model, render, and prototype daily. Work on paper and in tools like Fusion 360, Blender, KeyShot, and Photoshop. Judge ideas in physical form when possible, not just on screen.

  • Present and own your work. Present directly to the Head of Design and stakeholders. Argue clearly for your ideas, take feedback on board, and plan the next steps.

Your profile

We look for designers who are also makers. People who take on complex problems, take pride in their work, and hold precision as high as innovation and beauty.

  • Experience: 4+ years as an industrial designer, in-house or at a design studio or consultancy. We hire on the portfolio: range across product categories, depth in form and surface. An exceptional portfolio outweighs years.

  • Core Skills: Detailed, millimeter-precise CAD, including production-quality surfacing. Fast, clear sketching, on paper or digital. Renders that sell an idea in one image. Hands-on model making for rapid prototyping and mockups.

  • Mindset: You have exceptional taste and the range to use it: form, material, interaction, brand. You ask why a thing should exist before you decide how it looks. You are happy to do more than design work. You carry the agility of a startup and the rigor of a segment-leading design studio.

Helpful (but not required) skills and experience

  • Parametric, T-spline, and surface modeling in Fusion 360.

  • Products that move: robotics, wearables, automotive, or consumer electronics.

  • Design for manufacture: injection molding, die casting, sheet metal, LSR.

  • Soft goods or hard-soft interfaces.

  • Graphic design, packaging, or art direction.

  • Time on the factory floor with suppliers.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

Lightning AI is seeking an experienced Senior GPU & Compute Infrastructure Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.

In this role, you will help bring up, validate, and operate large-scale bare-metal compute infrastructure, with a particular focus on GPU-enabled systems. You will work at the intersection of hardware, systems, and software—owning system diagnostics and validation, developing automation, improving reliability, and ensuring clusters are ready to support demanding AI/ML and HPC workloads.

You will play a key role in GPU and system-level qualification, running validation environments and test clusters, and improving the tooling and workflows that support infrastructure bring-up at scale. This includes owning and evolving our image pipeline alongside provisioning and validation systems to ensure our infrastructure is consistent, performant, and reliable from day one.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You'll Do

Systems Bring-Up & Validation

  • Own and evolve systems for image management, deployment, and validation across bare-metal infrastructure
  • Run and maintain test clusters used for system validation, diagnostics, and bring-up
  • Validate firmware, drivers, and OS images across compute and GPU-enabled systems

GPU Diagnostics & Performance

  • Own GPU diagnostics and validation workflows across large-scale infrastructure

Automation & Tooling

  • Build and maintain automation for provisioning, validation, and system bring-up

  • Improve the reliability, repeatability, and scalability of image pipelines and validation systems

Systems & Operations

  • Manage and operate Linux-based systems in production and validation environments
  • Manage virtualization technology
  • Support bare-metal provisioning workflows, including PXE and image-based systems
  • Interface with hardware management systems (e.g., IPMI, Redfish) for monitoring and debugging

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Hardware, and Data Center teams on system bring-up and validation
  • Collaborate with platform and ML teams to ensure systems meet workload requirements
  • Contribute to best practices for provisioning, diagnostics, and lifecycle management of infrastructure

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or related roles
  • Strong Linux systems experience in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with GPU-enabled systems and tools such as NVIDIA DCGM
  • Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning and system bring-up workflows
  • Proficiency in Python or similar scripting/programming languages for automation
  • Ability to debug complex issues across hardware, OS, GPUs, and system software

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand, NVLink)
  • Experience with PXE boot environments, LiveCD systems, or image-based provisioning workflows
  • Experience with hardware management interfaces such as iDRAC, IPMI, or Redfish

title: Inside Account Executive | SMB CEE | New Logo
descriptionHtml:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Inside Account Executive I is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping prospects and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall CEE sales goals.

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office in Amsterdam Zuid 2-3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the NL and have sponsorship to live and work in the NL #LI-Hybrid

What you can expect to do this role:

  • Formulate and execute a sales strategy within an assigned territory (Poland, Czech, Estonia, Ukraine, Moldova and Bulgaria)
  • Work in partnership with other departments (Sales Development, Sales Engineers, Channel and Marketing) to build quality pipeline and ensure our prospects bridge the gap between what Apple creates and their organizations needs.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue attainment on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Develop meaningful relationships with key stakeholders at prospect accounts while managing the entire sales-cycle from prospection to close.
  • Build trusted relationships within the sales ecosystem including Channel Partners and Apple as well as maintaining a strong relationships with other internal Jamf stake holders.
  • Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Outreach.io, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Gong.io and much more.    
  • Use Salesforce.com to document and manage sales activities.
  • Understand and explain business value related to the whole Jamf product experience (WPE) such as Client Management, Mobile Device Management and Mobile Security.

What we are looking for:

  • Professional working proficiency in English (required) and any CEE language (preferred)
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a sales, business or entrepreneurial role (required).
  • General experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) models (preferred).

  • Ability to learn quickly and to take and work with feedback provided.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

Why Jamf?

  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

title: International Expansion - Germany
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Keine starren Prozesse, kein Mikromanagement. Bei uns entscheidest du, wie du arbeitest, mit Tools, die du selbst mitgestalten darfst, und Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wir entwickeln ständig neue Systeme, um unsere Arbeit zu optimieren, statt nur Tickets zu schließen. Und falls doch mal was brennt: Wir löschen gemeinsam.

  • Echte Eigenverantwortung und kurze Wege
    Du bist nicht eine:r von vielen in einer langen Zuständigkeitskette. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in deinem Bereich, in einem überschaubaren Team, mit kurzem Draht zu allen Abteilungen und zur Geschäftsführung, ohne drei Hierarchieebenen dazwischen. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen oder ein Tool sinnvoller eingesetzt werden kann, wirst du gehört.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d) planst, betreust und entwickelst du Systeme, die unser Unternehmen voranbringen. Du kümmerst dich um Server, Netzwerke und Sicherheit und hast dabei alle Freiheiten, Prozesse smarter zu machen.

  • Server-Verwaltung & Pflege
    Du betreust unsere internen Server, kümmerst dich um Updates und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme stabil laufen.
  • Netzwerkadministration
    Du überwachst und konfigurierst Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs.
  • Datensicherung & Wiederherstellung
    Du planst, überprüfst und testest Backups regelmäßig und stellst sicher, dass im Ernstfall keine Daten verloren gehen.
  • Systemmigrationen
    Du planst und begleitest den Umstieg auf neue Systeme, ob Update, neue Software oder neue Hardware.
  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierungen
    Du verbindest Systeme über APIs oder Tools wie n8n. So machst du Prozesse effizienter und reduzierst Klickarbeit und Fehler auf ein Minimum.
  • Domains & Bereitstellung interner Tools
    Du behältst den Überblick über unsere aktiven Domains und stellst interne Tools lokal oder online genau den richtigen Teams sicher und performant zur Verfügung.
  • Technischer Support im Alltag
    Du bist eine der ersten Anlaufstellen bei IT-Fragen und hilfst Kolleg:innen weiter, per Chat oder vor Ort.
  • Einrichtung neuer Arbeitsplätze
    Du richtest neue PCs, Notebooks und Monitore ein und kümmerst dich um Softwareinstallationen, Zugänge und Netzwerkeinstellungen.
  • Neue Technologien evaluieren
    Du testest neue Tools, prüfst ihre Praxistauglichkeit und empfiehlst, was uns wirklich weiterbringt.
  • Abstimmung mit Dienstleistern
    Du betreust externe Anbieter, Partner oder Remote-Entwickler:innen und stimmst deine Arbeit mit ihnen ab.

Dein Profil

Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung in der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Egal ob du sie mit oder ohne Ausbildung gesammelt hast: Uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst, welche Systeme du schon verantwortet hast und was du noch erreichen willst. Direkte Kommunikation, Neugier und Spaß an der Arbeit sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Und wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Administration
    Du hast bereits IT-Systeme im laufenden Betrieb betreut, ob in einem Unternehmen oder für Kund:innen, und weißt, was es heißt, wenn morgens etwas nicht läuft und alle darauf warten.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Netzwerke & Sicherheit
    Lokale Netzwerke, Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs: Du hast sie schon eingerichtet und betreut und weißt, wie man ein Firmennetzwerk sicher aufstellt.
  • Server, Cloud & Systemarchitektur
    Du verstehst, wie lokale Server, Cloud-Server und Serverlandschaften zusammenspielen, und hast Erfahrung mit Docker und Datenbanken (z. B. Supabase) oder vergleichbaren Plattformen.
  • Plattform-Know-how
    Google Workspace, Windows und macOS sind für dich Alltag, nicht Neuland.
  • Backups & Datenschutz
    Du hast einen Plan von Backup-Strategien und weißt, wie man mit personenbezogenen Daten umgeht, von der Speicherung über die Verarbeitung bis zur Löschung.
  • APIs & Automatisierung
    Du weißt, wie man einen authentifizierten API-Call macht, und hast Lust, Abläufe mit Tools wie n8n zu automatisieren.
  • Nachhaltige Lösungen
    Du findest lieber eine saubere Lösung als einen schnellen Workaround.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, regelmäßig Neues zu lernen, ob Tools, Trends oder Technologien.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Erfahrung. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.
  • Nice to have: CRM-Erfahrung
    Wenn du zusätzlich schon mit CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot gearbeitet hast, umso besser.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer - CAD
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Junior Mechanical Engineer, you enter as a member of the early team building the physical body of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. You will work directly with our senior engineers to turn concepts into detailed CAD, back them up with calculations and simulation, and get parts built and tested. You learn fast, and you take pride in getting the basics right from day one.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Detailed Design & CAD: Build and maintain CAD models, assemblies and production drawings from senior engineers' concepts - structural parts, brackets, housings and actuator components.

  • Engineering Calculations: Carry out bearing, fastener and strength calculations, document your assumptions clearly and review them with the team.

  • Simulation Support: Set up and run FEA studies (static, modal, thermal) and prepare the results for design reviews.

  • Prototyping & Testing: Prepare parts for manufacture (drawings, tolerances, BOMs), coordinate with the workshop and suppliers, and assemble and test prototypes - feeding what you learn straight back into the design.

  • DFM/DFA in Practice: Apply the team's DFM/DFA standards in your daily work and flag manufacturing or assembly issues early.

  • Documentation: Keep CAD data, BOMs, release status and design notes clean and up to date so the team can move fast.

  • Cross-Functional Support: Work with the AI, Controls and Software teams on integration details such as sensor mounts, cable routing and mass properties.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond demos to real-world deployment - early-career engineers who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience and a degree (BSc/MSc) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace or a related field. Internships, working student roles, a hardware-focused thesis or student teams (e.g. Formula Student, robotics competitions) count.

  • Core Skills: Solid 3D CAD skills including clean production drawings and GD&T basics, and a strong grounding in machine elements and strength of materials (bearings, fasteners, stress analysis, load paths). Also expected:  

  • First hands-on FEA experience and the habit of sanity-checking results by hand.  

  • Working knowledge of common manufacturing processes (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection moulding) and how they shape a design. 

  • Comfortable in the workshop - assembling prototypes, measuring parts, 3D printing and basic machining.  

  • A basic understanding of kinematics and actuators is a plus.

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are curious, take feedback well and own your work end to end - and you understand that a robot in the real world faces forces and failures that don't exist in a simulation.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Langfuse - Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Why Design at Langfuse

Your work will shape how engineers build with AI.

Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels.

  • Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast.

  • Simplifying complex workflows. Our users run evaluations across datasets, compare experiment results, manage prompt versions, and set up monitoring. You'll map these workflows, identify friction, and design flows that feel obvious in hindsight.

  • Collaborating directly with product engineers. You'll pair with engineers, whiteboard solutions together, and ship designs that work within our existing component system (shadcn/ui, Tailwind). You'll create reusable, consistent UI patterns that the whole team can build with.

  • Shipping design straight to code. You'll use AI coding tools to implement smaller design fixes, build components for the design system, and polish UI details yourself. We are not looking for a perfect engineer here but for someone who can help themselvesherself.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in designing complex web applications, incl. a portfolio showcasing product work that users loved

  • Take ownership of our UI/UX made for developers

  • You want to talk to users

  • Hard worker and thrive working in a small and accountable team

  • Good understanding of best in class UI/UX

  • Excited about open source software and dev tools

Bonus points:

  • You can ship frontend code (we use Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)

  • ML/AI experience or familiarity with the LLM tooling ecosystem

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Contributions to open source projects or design systems

  • Side projects that show craft and taste

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

title: Laser Architect - Beam Smoothing
descriptionHtml:
Summary
We are looking for a Senior Laser Architect to take ownership of beam-smoothing technology within our laser-driven fusion programme. You will work in the Laser Division to connect smoothing performance with science requirements and laser system design, so that beam quality and system reliability support our fusion energy goals.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the beam-smoothing roadmap, from concept through deployment and continuous improvement.

  • Translate science and system requirements into beam-smoothing and laser-system specifications.

  • Guide the design and optimisation of smoothing approaches for uniformity, contrast and focal-spot quality, across coherent and incoherent techniques.

  • Assess how smoothing choices affect the wider laser and facility architecture, balancing performance, complexity, risk and cost.

  • Work with modelling, experimental and engineering teams to turn results into design decisions.

  • Support technology selection and supplier engagement for smoothing-related hardware and diagnostics.

  • Set design standards and provide technical direction and mentoring to the beam-smoothing team.

Required qualifications

  • PhD or equivalent experience in physics, optics, photonics, applied physics, electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Significant hands-on experience with high-power or high-energy laser systems, in research or industry.

  • Solid understanding of beam smoothing and beam quality, including coherence, speckle, propagation and focal-spot formation.

  • Experience designing and analysing experiments on laser performance or beam quality.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating physics needs into engineering requirements.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with laser-driven fusion or inertial confinement fusion programmes.

  • Experience with modelling tools for beam propagation and smoothing.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering practices such as requirements flow-down, verification and trade studies.

  • Experience working with vendors on optical components or beam-conditioning hardware.

Personal attributes

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to weigh trade-offs between smoothing, efficiency, reliability and facility performance.

  • Clear communicator, able to turn complex physics into decisions.

  • Collaborative, hands-on approach.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

Works closely with: laser architects, systems engineering, target physics, diagnostics, controls, operations and external partners.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Lead Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for our first Lead Account Manager to join Omnea’s customer team. You’ll be excited to own expansion quotas and renewal outcomes for our rapidly scaling customer base, to build a function and to have a massively accelerated career trajectory.

You will own the relationship with our customers throughout the entire customer lifecycle, playing a crucial role in managing our largest and most strategic customers. Your key focus will be to ensure customers get meaningful value from Omnea from the earliest stages & beyond, and through your expertise and the building of deep & long-term relationships with our champions, you will drive renewals, expansion and upsell opportunities. You’ll become a trusted advisor & partner to our customers & stakeholders at all levels (from the procurement managers up to the CFOs) and be the voice of the customer internally, working closely with teams across the business (both technical and commercial) to help ensure we are truly operating with customer-centricity at our core.

You’ll be joining us at an incredibly exciting time, just as things are starting to take off! We're a Series A company having raised $25m from Accel, Point Nine, First Round, and 50+ renowned founders and industry experts. We’ve built an incredible & passionate team — every member was a top performer at their previous business - and our CEO, CCO & CFO went on a similar journey with Tessian, going from $0-30m ARR / $8-$500m valuation, and from pre-seed to Series C (Sequoia, Accel, etc.).

We've spent the past 18 months building & deploying our platform to many of the greatest tech companies out there (Lookout, McAfee, Onfido, Typeform, Proofpoint, etc.), all whilst managing to stay lean & operate efficiently.

Now we’re ready to scale. We are looking for our first Account Management Lead to help make Omnea one of Europe’s leading tech businesses: come build with us!

What Can You Expect?

You’ll do whatever it takes to support & champion our customers in their journey with Omnea. There’ll be a constant mix of strategic work (advising customers on company-wide transformation projects, refining our account management playbooks & processes, etc.) and operational work (driving upsell & expansion conversion, managing enterprise onboarding & deployments with your dedicated Solutions & Implementation Lead, etc.). And you’ll consistently be building meaningful relationships with customers, becoming their go-to person for all things Omnea.

  • You’ll focus on delivering long-term customer value in every interaction and build lasting relationships through consistent engagement with our customers - from the end users (Procurement/Finance/Ops ICs) through to the senior management of the companies (CFOs/CIOs/COOs) - resulting in deep trust, strong champions and reference points for all future customers.

  • You’ll be a trusted & strategic advisor to our customers, ensuring they are successful by partnering with key champions & executive sponsors to develop & execute a mutually agreed-upon success plan covering their entire lifecycle. You’ll act as their product expert, from advising on best-in-class configuration of the platform to sharing learnings from or introductions to similar customers.

  • You’ll own the retention and churn outcomes:

    • You’ll proactively drive towards renewal conversations and identity & close opportunities for multi-year contract extensions.

    • You’ll lead efforts to mitigate customer concerns, reduce churn, and enhance overall customer satisfaction and retention, focusing on both proactive and reactive strategies.

  • You’ll own Net Revenue Retention targets, identifying & closing expansion opportunities. You’ll proactively nurture customer accounts, deepening their understanding of product vision, value proposition and features.

  • You’ll identify advocates and expand our customer community to accelerate our GTM motion. You’ll develop and implement proactive initiatives to increase customer adoption and engagement: co-hosting Omnea roundtables with Sales, writing customer newsletters/blog posts/thought leadership etc. with Marketing. You’ll become well-known in this space.

  • You’ll form a pod with a Solutions & Implementation Lead to ensure you are well supported in expanding the accounts. Bring in our Technical Solutions Experts if you need support and the customer wants to go deeper.

  • You’ll partner with teams across the company - Product, Marketing, Sales - to integrate and align our retention & expansion strategies, translating customer insights into actionable feedback and help strategically guide the direction of the product based on the voice of the customer feedback. You’ll leverage these relationships to achieve success for your customers.

As we scale our Customer function, you’ll have an outsized impact on the business, working with our most strategic customers and defining our Customer Account Management & Success playbooks from the earliest stages. The future scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes on the challenge and ultimately, it is hoped that this person will become a future leader at Omnea.

About You

TL;DR: you’re ambitious & hard-working, and you’re as comfortable handling technical product demos as you are communicating to Execs about the success of a project. You make up for any potential lack of experience with hunger and a constant growth mindset. You are someone who will succeed at whatever you put your mind to. You’re intelligent & can work stuff out from first principles. You derive energy from building meaningful relationships, building a community & network around you, and being a true advocate and champion of our customers.

  • You have 5-7 years of experience succeeding in a B2B SaaS commercial role (i.e. you know you can sell! And can manage the longer-term success of customer accounts). You will have consistently performed at the top of your team‍ and are well-known/have a demonstrable history of having the happiest and most successful customers.

  • You’re entrepreneurial and want to be part of building a business. You want to rise faster or earn more than would be possible in any ‘normal’ career and you’re happy to roll up your sleeves and do whatever’s required. FYI, we've signed up to the Future Founder Promise.

  • You’ve got a track record of exceptional performance, whether it’s in academia, work, sport, a sales team, or whatever else you’ve put your mind to.

  • You have strong commercial intuition and have the gravitas to sell to senior leadership (eg. CFOs, CIOs). You can proactively recognise expansion opportunities and mitigate issues that could affect revenue retention.

  • You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You build ultimate trust with customer stakeholders.

  • You’re intelligent and have the capacity to rapidly understand our product inside and out, without the crutch of relying on sales engineers. You can simplify complex problems and translate them into next steps, product configuration or new feature requests.

  • You’re outcomes-focused, and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”.

  • You are proactive & crave accountability, proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you.

  • You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality.

  • You’re ambitious, competitive, and care lots about your career. You are probably happiest when working really hard and solving challenging problems/winning deals. You know this requires dedication & some sacrifice but you think it’s worth it.

  • You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

  • Du verantwortest und koordinierst das Office Management und stellst einen reibungslosen Ablauf des Büroalltags an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Berlin & München sicher.
  • Du verantwortest die Themen Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz und die Einhaltung relevanter gesetzlicher Vorgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit den zuständigen internen und externen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Office-Prozesse, Standards und Richtlinien kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst für deren Umsetzung an den Standorten.
  • Du steuerst unsere Benefits und Services für Mitarbeitende, koordinierst externe Dienstleister und verantwortest die Auswahl sowie Weiterentwicklung unserer Angebote.

title: (Lead-) Software Engineer / Energie-Startup (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Wir bei Gridty entwickeln eine KI-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, ihren Energieverbrauch intelligent zu analysieren und nachhaltig zu reduzieren. ⚡️

Unsere Software verbindet Energiedaten aus vielen Standorten und technischen Anlagen, erkennt automatisch Anomalien und Ineffizienzen und unterstützt Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsteams mit KI-Agenten bei der Analyse und Optimierung ihres Betriebs.

Unser Fokus liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten – etwa im Einzelhandel, in der Logistik und anderen energieintensiven Branchen.

Wer sind wir?

Wir sind ein dynamisches Energie- und KI-Startup aus Köln und gerade in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase.

Unsere Plattform ist live und bei ersten Kunden im Einsatz. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen: mehr Standorte, mehr Datenquellen, bessere automatisierte Analysen und eine Plattform, die mit unseren Kunden skalieren kann.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer & Platform Lead (m/w/d), der Lust hat, früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere technische Plattform entscheidend mitzugestalten. 🚀

Unser Stack

Unter anderem arbeiten wir aktuell mit:

Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL / Timeseries · Google Cloud · Docker · LLMs / AI Agents

Du musst nicht jedes einzelne Tool davon bereits beherrschen.

Wo arbeiten wir?

Gridty hat seinen Sitz in Köln. Wir arbeiten hybrid und treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich als Team.

Daher wäre es ideal, wenn du aus Köln oder der weiteren Region kommst bzw. regelmäßig vor Ort sein kannst. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtiger, die richtige Person zu finden, als jeden Tag gemeinsam im selben Büro zu sitzen. 💻

Wie läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess?

  1. Kurzes Kennenlernen per Google Meet – ca. 15–30 Minuten

  2. Technisches und persönliches Gespräch – ca. 60 Minuten

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen in Köln

  4. Willkommen bei Gridty! ⚡️

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale technische Rolle bei Gridty und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unsere Plattform weiter.

Konkret bedeutet das unter anderem:

  • Technische Ownership für zentrale Teile unserer Plattform und Software-Architektur

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Services und APIs mit Python/FastAPI

  • Weiterentwicklung unseres React-/TypeScript-Frontends

  • Aufbau und Skalierung unserer Datenarchitektur für große Mengen an Energie- und Zeitreihendaten

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-basierten Analysefunktionen und Integration von LLM-/Agenten-Workflows

  • Integration neuer Datenquellen, Messsysteme und externer APIs

  • Umsetzung technischer Kundenintegrationen und Unterstützung bei komplexem Troubleshooting

  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Testing, Reviews und sinnvolle Engineering-Standards

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, Deployments und CI/CD-Prozesse

  • Monitoring, Security und Performance-Optimierung unserer Plattform

  • Mitgestaltung unserer technischen Roadmap und zukünftigen Architektur

Und vor allem: Du bekommst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung.

Wir sind ein kleines Team – gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht in fünf Abstimmungsebenen, sondern können direkt Teil des Produkts werden.

Qualifikation

Wer bist du?

Du…

  • hast Lust, an einem Produkt mit echtem Impact auf Energieverbrauch und CO₂-Emissionen zu arbeiten.

  • magst Verantwortung, Gestaltungsspielraum und die Geschwindigkeit eines Startups.

  • bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit.

  • fühlst dich im Backend und bei Software-Architektur zu Hause und hast gleichzeitig keine Angst davor, auch mal ins Frontend zu schauen.

  • hast Erfahrung mit Python und idealerweise FastAPI oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.

  • kennst dich mit JavaScript/TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Technologien wie React aus.

  • hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken und idealerweise auch mit größeren Zeitreihendaten.

  • denkst nicht nur in Features, sondern auch in skalierbarer Architektur, sauberem Code, Testing, Security und zuverlässigem Betrieb.

  • kannst technische Entscheidungen eigenständig treffen und verständlich kommunizieren.

  • sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Data Engineering, LLMs/AI Agents, Energiesystemen oder IoT-/Messdaten. Entscheidend ist aber vor allem, dass du Lust hast, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
