title: Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Shape complex technology solutions and help redefine the future of financial services.

The Role

Lead the design of complex, resilient technology solutions that help financial services organisations modernise their platforms, address architectural challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

At Capco, you will play a pivotal role in delivering some of our clients’ most complex and high-profile transformation programmes, drawing on your expertise in solution architecture and technology transformation.

You will move between hands-on solution design, collaborating closely with engineers, and articulating compelling technology visions to senior stakeholders. You will bring sound technical judgement, constructive challenge and a clear understanding of client objectives to architectural decisions, ensuring that solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned with business priorities.

You will work across business, data, application and technology domains, guide cross-functional teams and support the development of colleagues. You will also have opportunities to contribute to enterprise architecture strategy and technology roadmaps, alongside supporting the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through community leadership, delivery excellence and business development.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, scalable, secure and resilient solutions across legacy and cloud environments, applying modern distributed architecture patterns and engineering principles.

  • Translate business objectives into practical technology solutions, evaluating architectural options, managing technical trade-offs and ensuring designs deliver measurable value, reliability and long-term maintainability.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture and engineering teams, promoting collaboration, delivery excellence, continuous learning and the development of colleagues.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate compelling architecture visions and influence strategic decisions while contributing to business development and commercial opportunities.

  • Explore and apply approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows to strengthen architecture analysis, design documentation and delivery efficiency, ensuring appropriate human review, security controls, responsible AI governance and clear escalation pathways.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex solution architecture initiatives, translating business and technology requirements into practical, high-quality solutions.

  • Strong architectural judgement, with the ability to evaluate options, challenge assumptions constructively and balance delivery priorities with security, reliability and maintainability.

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence decisions across business and technology teams.

  • Experience guiding multidisciplinary technical teams, encouraging engineering excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing and effective problem-solving.

  • Commercial awareness and a client-focused mindset, with the ability to understand business objectives, identify opportunities for improvement and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Technical Skills & Experience

Essential requirements

  • Strong solution architecture experience across legacy and cloud environments, including practical experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.

  • Experience applying modern distributed architecture patterns, including microservices, event-driven, containerised, serverless and zero-trust architectures.

  • Working knowledge of recognised architecture frameworks and methods, including TOGAF, Zachman, Domain-driven Design or NIST.

  • Experience working within Agile and DevOps delivery environments, collaborating closely with engineering teams to support effective solution implementation.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience shaping enterprise architecture strategies, technology roadmaps and governance frameworks across complex organisations.

  • Experience designing greenfield architectures, cloud-first enterprises or establishing and maturing enterprise architecture functions within agile delivery environments.

  • Senior-level consulting experience, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries with complex compliance, risk and security requirements.

  • Experience leading pre-sales activities, proposals or bids, including commercial ownership and client engagement.

  • Awareness of emerging AI capabilities, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, and their potential application to enterprise architecture and engineering productivity; relevant professional certifications in architecture frameworks or cloud technologies are also welcomed.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

  • Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

  • Access continuous learning, training and industry certifications.

  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across financial services and energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.

  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.

  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.

  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.

  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way – a minimum of 40 hours of training annually. Take your pick from workshops, certifications and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from Day One, offering one-on-one guidance to support your goals and accelerate your development.

  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.

  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary 

As our M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel, you will work directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. In close collaboration with our Business and Finance teams, you will play a key role in structuring, drafting and negotiating Mistral’s external growth transactions and equity fundraisings.


Mistral operates at the frontier of AI, where the pace of innovation demands transaction execution speed and precision that match the technology itself. You will help shape the growth and business relationships that will define Mistral’s next chapter.

Key responsibilities

  • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of M&A transactions, including acquisitions, acqui-hires and other internal or external growth projects worldwide.

  • Take an active part in every stage of M&A transactions: deal structuring, due diligence, negotiations, signing and closing.

  • Coordinate the process for Mistral’s equity fundraisings, including legal communication with prospective investors, structuring the company's due diligence disclosure, drafting investment documentation and leading the signing and closing of equity fundraisings.

  • Coordinate and assist on Mistral’s secondary sale transactions on behalf of investors and employees.

  • Draft, negotiate, and advise on transaction documentation, including LOIs, NDAs, SPAs, shareholders' agreements, investment agreements, and other ancillary transaction documents.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other corporate functions.

  • Build internal templates, practices, and guidelines for M&A and equity financing documentation.

  • Support on other legal topics as needed, particularly on compliance matters related to corporate affairs.

Qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor's degree or above (LLB, LLM or Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one additional jurisdiction, in particular the USA or the UK, would be a plus.

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je.

Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

  • Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

  • Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

  • Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

  • Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

  • Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

  • Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

  • Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

  • Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

  • Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

  • Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

  • Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

  • Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

  • Een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

  • Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap.

Interesse?

Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services?

Dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

title: Marketing & CRM Executive (Graduate/Entry Level)
descriptionHtml:

Caddy Comps is the UK's leading golf prize competition platform. Founded in 2021 and based in Stamford, Lincolnshire, we've awarded over £15m in prizes to more than 50,000 winners and hold a 5-star Trustpilot rating from 8,400+ reviews.

We're now building the marketing team and infrastructure to take us to the next level, and this role is a key part of that.

The Role

Caddy Comps is growing fast, and our CRM activity is key to how we turn first-time entrants into regulars. We're looking for a Marketing & CRM Executive to help make that happen.

You'll work closely with our CRM & Lifecycle Manager to deliver the campaigns, automations and tests that onboard customers and keep them coming back. Day to day, you'll own outbound sends across email, SMS and push. You'll write the copy, brief the creative and build the automations, making sure every message goes out right.

You'll also spend part of your time on performance marketing: tracking what's selling, spotting trends and flagging opportunities to the wider team.

This is a hands-on role in a small team, so your work goes live quickly and you'll see its impact. If you're early in your career and want to learn CRM, with real responsibility from day one, this is the role.

Tasks

CRM (around 60% of the role)

  • Support the CRM & Lifecycle Manager in delivering the CRM strategy

  • Manage outbound CRM campaigns, including creative briefing, copywriting and execution

  • Assist in building automated communications across multiple channels

  • Assist in setting up and continually monitoring the testing framework for CRM activity

  • Assist in CRM reporting

  • Assist in managing our Klaviyo account, including segmentation and list management

  • Maintain high standards across all outbound communications

  • Stay up to date with trends in CRM

Sales & Marketing Analysis (around 20%)

  • Support the monitoring of daily and weekly sales performance across our key competition categories and bestselling prizes

  • Support the team in tracking channel performance in weekly reports, highlighting trends and wins against benchmarks

  • Identify opportunities for digital promotional activity, bringing ideas to the team each week to help each draw sell out

Team Support (around 20%)

  • Support the day-to-day running of the marketing team

Requirements

Essential

  • Highly motivated, with a desire to deliver results

  • Positive energy and enthusiasm to learn

  • Creative, with an eye for design

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Technically proficient, with an eagerness to learn about new innovations

  • Good communication skills

  • Comfortable working within a small, fast-moving team

Nice to Have

  • Passion for golf

  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g. Klaviyo)

  • Experience using Meta, TikTok or Google ad platforms

  • Experience with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT)

  • Experience with design tools (e.g. Canva, Photoshop)

  • Awareness of GDPR/PECR and marketing consent

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skill level and experience

  • Hybrid working, 2 days per week with the team in our Stamford office

  • Hands-on training in CRM and lifecycle marketing from our CRM & Lifecycle Manager

  • A genuinely exciting brand to work on: great product, great ambassadors, growing fast

  • Direct access to the Head of Marketing and a small, high-performing team

  • Real responsibility from day one, your work goes live quickly and you'll see its impact

  • The chance to build something. This role will grow as the brand grows

descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. title: Material Flow Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.

You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time.

  • Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies.

  • Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates.

  • Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation.

  • Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules.

  • Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes.

  • Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Masters’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical/analytical discipline.

  • 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-volume production environment involving complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor.

  • Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design.

  • Experience querying and analyzing operational and ERP/WMS data using SQL, Python, or advanced Excel to drive material flow and inventory decisions.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) line launches, greenfield facility buildouts, and production ramps.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with a proven ability to influence production teams, engineering peers, and leadership on the shop floor.

  • Adaptable, hands-on problem solver willing to balance analytical modeling with immediate physical execution on the factory floor in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Ability to work 100% onsite and travel up to 20% as needed to supplier sites or sister manufacturing facilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)
descriptionHtml:
Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs.

  • Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes.

  • Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably.

  • Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors.

  • Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests.

  • Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++.

  • Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions.

  • Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits.

  • Knowledge of page lifecycle, network idle, service workers, client-side rendering, and shadow DOM; experience debugging JavaScript and fluency with Chrome DevTools, CDP, HAR files, curl, and packet captures.

  • Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined.

Nice to have

  • Experience developing CDN, caching, or web performance systems.

  • Experience operating crawlers, headless browsers, or distributed content-acquisition systems at scale.

  • Contributions to a browser engine or JavaScript runtime.

title: Mobile Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

Your impact:

We’re hiring Mobile Product Engineers across different levels of experience, from junior to staff level engineers. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring.

As a Mobile Product Engineer, you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete mobile experience.

What you will do:

  • Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building.
  • Own complete features: Turn problems into practical solutions across clients, services and data. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production.
  • Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed.
  • Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team.
  • Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness.

What you will bring:

  • Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release.
  • Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in Mobile Development (Android, iOS or both) and can contribute beyond it. You don’t need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system.
  • Practical capability with coding agents: You’ve used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output.
  • Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it.
  • Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk.
  • Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome.
  • Technical leadership: You’ve led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on.

Our mobile teams work with Swift and SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, and Rust for cross-platform mobile development. You may bring depth in iOS or Android, or experience across both—there’s no expectation that you know every technology we use. The mix of platform focus and cross-platform work varies by team, and we value strong fundamentals and your ability to learn.

What we offer:

  • Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
  • A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.
  • Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.

title: Move to New Zealand - Technical Strategist (Solution Architect)
descriptionHtml:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company. We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country. The Role:

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.


Skills & Experience Required:
  • 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications.
  • Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.
  • Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
  • Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.
  • We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
  • Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.
  • Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists.
  • You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback.
  • Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose.
  • Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

    Benefits:

    • Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

    • Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

    • Opportunity for professional growth and development.

    • Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

    • Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

    • This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

    • Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

    Cover Letter:

    *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.

    It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

    At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.

title: Operations Assistant (Lab and Office)
descriptionHtml:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

Job Description

Job Title: Operations Assistant (Lab and Office)
Department: Laboratory
Term: Full-time
Location: Canary Wharf, London (on-site, 5 days per week)
Reports To: Caitlin Dwight-Evans, Laboratory Manager

Overview

We are looking for a reliable, practical and organised Lab & Office Operations Assistant to provide hands-on support with the day-to-day running of our laboratory and office.

This is a varied, task-focused role involving routine laboratory housekeeping, stock management, deliveries, cleaning, waste handling and general administrative support. The ideal candidate will enjoy practical work, take pride in completing tasks thoroughly and be happy to lend a hand wherever needed.

About the Role

Working alongside the Laboratory Manager and Lab Operations team, you will help keep our laboratory and office clean, organised, well-stocked and running smoothly.

This is primarily a practical, hands-on support role rather than a scientific or research position. You will be responsible for a mixture of daily, weekly and ad-hoc tasks, ranging from routine laboratory maintenance and stock replenishment to general office administration.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks, able to follow established procedures and happy to adapt to changing priorities. You should be willing to get stuck in and support the team with practical tasks as they arise.

The role is based at our head office in Canary Wharf and requires on-site attendance five days per week during standard working hours.

Core Responsibilities

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Lab

  • Receive, unpack, check and correctly store laboratory deliveries.

  • Assist with ordering, restocking and managing laboratory consumables and supplies.

  • Autoclave laboratory waste in accordance with established procedures and training.

  • Assist with laboratory waste management and recycling, including the daily removal of waste from designated laboratory areas.

  • Carry out routine laboratory cleaning, including wiping down surfaces, workbenches and equipment.

  • Maintain laboratory organisation and housekeeping, including keeping storage areas, cupboards and supply stations tidy and appropriately stocked.

  • Follow laboratory Health & Safety procedures, including the correct use of PPE, and help remind employees and visitors of established laboratory requirements.

  • Undertake routine manual handling tasks, including moving boxes, storing supplies and relocating appropriate equipment, in accordance with safe manual handling procedures.

  • Provide general hands-on assistance to the Laboratory Manager and wider lab team as required.

Office

  • Collect, receive and distribute office deliveries.

  • Scan paperwork and assist with document filing, organisation and storage.

  • Help maintain organised and well-stocked communal areas and office storage spaces.

  • Assist with general office administration, practical errands and day-to-day requests as needed.

Weekly Responsibilities

Lab

  • Assist with routine stock checks and flag low-stock, expired or soon-to-expire items.

  • Help prepare and refill routine laboratory solutions (e.g. 70% ethanol and sheath fluid) in accordance with established procedures and training.

  • Wash, clean and maintain laboratory glassware.

  • Assist with monitoring liquid nitrogen levels and coordinate with building facilities for refilling, following relevant safety procedures.

  • Perform weekly sink flushing.

Office

  • Monitor, order and replenish office sundries, including drinks, snacks, stationery and other regularly used supplies.

  • Check orders and deliveries against invoices, flagging any discrepancies.

Ad-Hoc Responsibilities

Lab

  • Provide practical support during audits, inspections and compliance checks.

  • Assist with equipment deep-cleaning as required and in accordance with training.

  • Assist with arranging access for on-site engineers, contractors, equipment repairs and maintenance visits.

  • Support sustainability initiatives to help maintain our My Green Lab Green certification.

  • Help with reorganising laboratory spaces, moving supplies and preparing areas for operational activities.

  • Suggest simple, practical improvements to laboratory organisation and everyday workflows where appropriate.

Office

  • Support office sustainability and recycling activities, including printer ink recycling, battery recycling and confidential waste collection.

  • Assist with the issuance, tracking and return of IT equipment, ensuring the Asset Management Log is kept up to date.

  • Help prepare office spaces and coordinate arrangements for visitors, contractors or internal activities as required.

The above list of responsibilities is not exhaustive, and the post holder may be required to undertake other reasonable duties consistent with the scope, purpose and level of the role.

Team and Ways of Working

This role sits within the Lab Operations team and reports to the Laboratory Manager, with regular interaction with colleagues across the laboratory and office.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

title: Partnerships Operation Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Partnership Operations Intern, you will help turn partner relationships into repeatable growth. You will have real responsibility for making partners successful, helping opportunities move forward, and building the systems that allow our partner ecosystem to scale.

This is a very hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how partnerships and the indirect channel really work. You will work directly with a wide range of external actors, including agency and consultancy leaders, partner sales and delivery teams, technology partners, and customers, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product at Dust.

You will not be limited to observing or executing a narrow checklist. You will own projects, see their impact, and help shape how Dust works with partners from the ground up.

What you'll do

Keep partners moving and growing

  • Animate the partner community through regular updates, follow-ups, check-ins, and activation initiatives.

  • Support partner onboarding and help partners find the right information, people, and resources at the right time.

  • Reply to partner questions and requests promptly, with clear next steps and strong follow-through.

  • Keep partner records, documentation, trackers, and workflows accurate and up to date across HubSpot, Introw, and Crossbeam.

  • Help design and improve scalable partner infrastructure, including onboarding flows, partner tiering, enablement tracking, and partner activity monitoring.

  • Track partner KPIs and help maintain dashboards covering activation, pipeline, attribution, engagement, and performance.

  • Identify recurring friction points and turn them into clearer processes, automations, or reusable resources.

Turn partner opportunities into revenue

  • Support partners throughout the deal creation process, from the first opportunity to a qualified pipeline item and a closed deal.

  • Create quotes and coordinate the information needed to move deals forward accurately and quickly.

  • Help maintain clean deal registration and partner attribution workflows in HubSpot.

  • Use tools such as Default, n8n, and Dust to reduce manual steps and improve visibility across the deal lifecycle.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

title: People Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, UK(hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C2

Team: People

Salary: £40,000 - £44,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: People Experience Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own the People service desk queue day-to-day: triaging, responding to, and resolving employee queries, and keeping response times and queue health on track.

  • Continuously improve our Jira Service Desk itself - refining triage, workflows, and automations - and feed recurring ticket themes back into our People Bot's knowledge base, so the answers people get before they ever need a human just keep getting better.

  • Be the main point of contact for new joiners between offer and day one, partnering with Talent Acquisition to make pre-boarding seamless and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Own and continuously improve the onboarding experience end-to-end - from offer acceptance to day one and beyond - so every new hire feels genuinely welcomed and set up for success.

  • Support payroll inputs, benefits administration, and compliance activities, making sure our processes hold up against internal policy and employment law requirements.

  • Help audit and redesign People processes, spotting where automation, AI, or self-service can reduce manual effort and put information directly in employees' hands.

  • Partner with the wider People team on cross-functional projects, from Reward cycles to hiring initiatives and employee experience improvements, bringing structure and good coordination to keep things moving.


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience in a People Operations or HR administrative role, with a genuine interest in how operational rigour underpins the employee lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with a HRIS, ideally Workday - confident keeping records accurate and up to date across onboarding and lifecycle changes.

  • A curious, detail-oriented approach to data - you notice when something looks off, dig into why, and flag it.

  • Experience with payroll input processes, and the attention to detail that accurate processing demands.

  • Experience administering employee benefits (enrolment, changes, queries), and a go-to point of contact when something needs sorting.

  • A track record of spotting clunky processes and making them better - you ask why things work the way they do, and you suggest or build improvements.

  • Experience running a queue in a service desk tool (Jira or similar), with good instincts for prioritising, keeping things moving and knowing what to escalate.

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law and compliance, and the judgment to know when to act and when to flag.

  • Clear, warm communication - equally comfortable writing to a nervous new joiner as flagging something to a manager.


What will set you apart:

  • You're curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You're already trying out tools, forming opinions, and bringing ideas back to the team rather than waiting to be asked.

  • You hold yourself to a high bar, and when you see something that could be better, you say so and take the lead on fixing it.

  • You share what you know and keep people in the loop, so a new joiner never feels like they're chasing you for answers.


Tech stack: Workday, Jira


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: People & Culture Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a (Senior) People & Culture Specialist (f/m/d) to play a central role in building and scaling our People & Culture function as we grow. This role is instrumental in managing payroll, contracts, mobility, compliance, and reporting, while also acting as a trusted partner to our leadership team. You will be responsible for ensuring operational excellence across core HR processes, building reliable and scalable People Operations systems, supporting employees and managers in a fast-moving, international environment, and reducing dependency on manual workflows as the company scales.

The successful candidate will bring a blend of operational expertise, strategic partnership, process-building capabilities, and a people-centered approach to help us scale smoothly and sustainably.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Scale People Operations and Global Mobility to support rapid company growth.

  • Take ownership of payroll for NL and DE, while supporting cases involving international payroll.

  • Manage contract management, employee lifecycle processes, compliance, and employee administration within our HRIS.

  • Build reliable, scalable systems and reduce dependency on manual workflows for daily People Operations.

  • Stabilize and document core People Operations and Global Mobility processes, including developing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Deliver reporting and analytics that inform decision-making, translate People data into meaningful insights, and shape company policies.

  • Partner with external experts (legal, insurance, accounting, relocation/visa specialists, payroll providers) to ensure smooth operations as the company scales.

  • Build strong collaboration with other People & Culture areas, including Talent Acquisition, People Experience, and People Development.

  • Provide business support to the leadership team, acting as a sparring partner on People Operations and business partnering topics.

  • Contribute to writing and rolling out policies that support compliance, clarity, and culture.

Your Qualifications

  • At least 5-8 years of hands-on experience in People Operations within an international company, ideally in a scaling technology, engineering, or deep-tech environment.

  • Practical experience applying German labour law in an HR environment, with the ability to make informed day-to-day decisions.

  • Strong knowledge of HRIS systems (Personio required), payroll and benefits administration systems, and reporting analytics.

  • Experience managing immigration, visas, relocation, and international mobility programs is a plus.

  • Experience building processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and HR infrastructure.

  • Skilled in decision-making, collaboration, and stakeholder management, with proven ability to balance operational needs with employee experience.

  • Strong hands-on mindset with high attention to detail and the ability to execute in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to build trust and act with professionalism and integrity.

  • Fluency in German (minimum C1) and English.

  • Advanced Microsoft 365 skills.

  • Previous experience in a fast-growing startup environment, ideally in deep tech.

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. title: People Operations Specialist | French Market | (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
Lexroom construit la plateforme d’IA sur laquelle s’effectue le travail juridique. En un peu plus de deux ans, nous sommes passés de zéro à 25 M€ d’ARR, et aujourd’hui plus de 20 000 professionnels du droit en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France et en Bulgarie s’appuient sur Lexroom.
Nous avons levé 73 M$ auprès de Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners et Eurazeo, et nous sommes une équipe d’environ 300 builders qui avancent vite, disent les choses franchement et assument chaque résultat.
Notre prochain objectif ? Devenir le produit juridique le plus utilisé en Europe.

Pourquoi Lexroom ?

  • Définir les standards : rejoignez l’équipe qui fixe la référence de l’IA juridique en Europe.

  • Travailler avec les meilleurs : collaborez avec des collègues d’exception, dans une culture qui valorise la compétence, la curiosité et l’ambition.

  • Avoir un impact concret : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les professionnels du droit exercent leur métier, plus rapidement, plus clairement et plus efficacement.

Chez Lexroom, nous laissons les buzzwords de côté. Ici, vous construirez quelque chose de durable : une plateforme de confiance, une solide réputation et un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique.

Le poste
En tant que People Operations Specialist pour la France, vous serez l’interlocuteur de référence de nos équipes parisiennes. Vous prendrez en charge l’ensemble des aspects opérationnels de l’expérience collaborateur, du premier contrat à la paie mensuelle, en veillant à ce que tout fonctionne de manière fiable, conforme et fluide au fil de notre croissance. Lexroom connaît une expansion rapide à travers l’Europe, et la France est l’un de nos marchés stratégiques. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe People à un moment clé, pour construire les fondations sur lesquelles notre équipe française pourra se développer.

Vos responsabilités

  • Être le référent People en France : devenir l’interlocuteur RH de confiance de nos équipes parisiennes, répondre aux demandes avec réactivité et clarté, tout en sachant dire non lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs : des contrats à l’onboarding en passant par les avantages sociaux, garantir que chaque étape soit fiable, conforme et fluide.

  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement des opérations : prendre en charge les éléments variables de paie et les données RH, en collaboration avec nos prestataires externes, pour une fiabilité irréprochable, mois après mois.

  • Construire un cadre de conformité évolutif : travailler avec nos conseillers juridiques pour mettre en place les standards adaptés à la France, au rythme de la croissance de nos effectifs.

  • Automatiser ce qui nous ralentit : utiliser l’IA, HiBob et les données pour réduire les tâches manuelles et construire les tableaux de bord qui aident l’équipe People à décider plus vite.

Profil recherché

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en People Operations, HR Operations ou en tant que généraliste RH, avec une pratique concrète des contrats, de l’onboarding et de la paie. Votre potentiel et votre motivation comptent davantage que le nombre d’années d’expérience.

  • De solides bases en droit du travail français : vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la législation sociale et avez déjà géré directement des contrats, des intégrations et des départs, idéalement avec une paie externalisée.

  • À l’aise avec les données et l’IA : les SIRH n’ont pas de secret pour vous, et vous repérez instinctivement les tâches répétitives qui pourraient être automatisées.

  • Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se) : vous savez gérer des échéances récurrentes, comme la paie mensuelle, sans rien laisser passer.

  • Proactif(ve) et résilient(e) : vous anticipez les besoins et agissez avant qu’un collaborateur n’ait à se plaindre.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit : français (langue maternelle) et anglais courant (C1 minimum). L’italien est un plus, sans être obligatoire.

  • Atouts supplémentaires : une connaissance de HiBob ou d’outils RH et de paie similaires, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le secteur juridique (aucune formation juridique requise).

Perspectives d’évolution
Ce poste repose sur la profondeur et la responsabilisation, pas sur une échelle hiérarchique. À mesure que notre équipe française grandit et que de nouveaux marchés s’ouvrent, votre périmètre évoluera avec elle. Vous contribuerez à définir la manière dont les People Operations fonctionnent sur un nouveau marché et travaillerez aux côtés d’un nouveau Head of People Operations. Vous développerez aussi une expertise très recherchée en paie, conformité et automatisation.

Ce qui nous distingue
Une équipe d’exception
Chez Lexroom, vous travaillerez aux côtés des meilleurs talents de la tech et de l’IA juridique. Nos équipes agissent avec sens et autonomie, pour que chaque contribution produise des résultats visibles. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes qui allient innovation et rigueur, curiosité et discipline, ambition et profondeur.

Une croissance qui compte
Nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour faire la différence, et nous leur donnons l’espace pour mener. Votre travail façonnera l’avenir de la legal tech et fixera de nouveaux standards pour le secteur. L’impact se mesure à la vision et à l’exécution, pas à l’âge ni au titre. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à prendre des responsabilités, vous trouverez de vraies opportunités de grandir et de piloter des projets à fort enjeu.

Valoriser votre contribution
Nous valorisons l’excellence et partageons le succès :

  • Rémunération : 30 000 – 45 000 € brut annuel

  • Equity : alignez votre évolution sur le succès à long terme de l’entreprise.

Des avantages qui comptent

  • Travail hybride : un équilibre entre télétravail et collaboration en présentiel dans nos bureaux à Paris (quartier du Marais)

  • Mutuelle Alan

  • Titres-restaurant

  • Accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être)

  • Team retreats & off-sites : des moments dédiés pour se retrouver, collaborer et faire naître des idées audacieuses.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien avec l’un de nos Talent Acquisition (45 min)

  2. Entretien manager avec Riccardo, notre Head of People (60 min)

  3. Mise en situation via un cas concret (45 min)

  4. Entretien final de culture fit (30 min)

  5. Offre

Chez Lexroom, l’ambition rencontre la discipline et le sens. Nous ne construisons pas seulement un produit : nous définissons un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à contribuer à quelque chose de durable et porteur de sens, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

Compensation: €30K – €45K • Offers Equity

title: Performance Marketer (Remote - Netherlands)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

Performance Analysis and Strategy

Creative & Funnel Optimization

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

Automation & Scaling Systems

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

title: Performance Marketing Manager B2B – Paid & Kundenbindung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bielefeld (Hybrid)

Wir sind getspecialfasteners und digitalisieren den schwierigsten Prozess im Handel mit Verbindungselementen: die Anfrage für Sonder- und Zeichnungsteile. Gemeinsam mit einem etablierten Sonderschrauben-Spezialisten bauen wir die Wachstums-Engine für den industriellen Mittelstand, erst für diesen Partner, später für weitere.

Outbound ist im Team besetzt. Dir gehört das Marketing: alle Kunden, die über Anzeigen, Website und Suche von sich aus anfragen. Gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb sorgst du dafür, dass aus dem ersten Auftrag eine Geschäftsbeziehung wird. Du baust das Marketing weitgehend neu auf, mit viel Freiheit, einem sechsstelligen Werbebudget im Jahr und einem klaren Ziel: Kunden gewinnen und halten, deren Aufträge mehr einbringen, als Werbung und Stelle kosten.

Wenn du Bock auf hands-on Performance-Marketing hast, datengetrieben arbeitest und Lust hast, in einem wachsenden Industrial-Tech-Startup echten Impact zu haben – dann lass uns reden.

Was die Rolle besonders macht

  • Paid zuerst. Über Google Ads fragen Kunden heute von sich aus bei uns an, Microsoft Ads läuft daneben. Beides steuerst du ab Tag eins selbst, ohne Agentur.

  • Die richtigen Anfragen statt vieler. Du hast nicht Tausende Conversions im Monat, sondern wenige, aber wertvolle Anfragen. Entscheidend ist, dass die passenden Kunden anfragen. Gut priorisieren, obwohl die Statistik nicht eindeutig ist, ist hier der Kern des Jobs.

  • Kundenbindung von Anfang an. Mit Vertrieb und Partner baust du in HubSpot auf, wie aus Neukunden Stammkunden werden. Später holst du ehemalige Kunden zurück.

  • Automatisieren, um dich freizuspielen. Wir arbeiten AI-first. Teile der Kontosteuerung laufen schon über eigene Agents. Wir erwarten, dass du das weitertreibst, statt Gebote von Hand zu schieben.

  • Ownership statt Auftragsliste. Niemand gibt dir eine To-do-Liste. Du entwickelst das Marketing eigenständig weiter und entscheidest selbst, was als Nächstes dran ist.

Woran wir dich messen

  • Anteil der Anfragen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen

  • Deckungsbeitrag aus den Aufträgen der Kunden, die über Marketing kommen

  • Kosten je Neukunde, mit klar fallender Tendenz

  • Neukunden über Marketing und wie oft sie wiederbestellen; die Wiederbestellung verantwortest du gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb

Deine Aufgaben

  • Das Werbebudget eigenständig verteilen und begründen

  • Kampagnen, Keywords und Gebote steuern; Landingpages und Anfrageformular auf Conversion optimieren, gebaut mit HubSpot, Lovable oder ähnlichen Tools

  • Tracking bis zum Auftrag aufsetzen und wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisieren

  • Mit Vertrieb und Partner einen Prozess definieren, wie aus Neukunden Wiederbesteller werden, den Marketing-Teil in HubSpot umsetzen und die Wirkung messen

  • Ehemalige Kunden gezielt zurückgewinnen

  • Positionierung und Botschaft entwickeln, die Website, Anzeigen und Outbound gemeinsam nutzen

  • Experimente mit Hypothese und Abbruchkriterium führen und dokumentieren

  • Inhalte mit dem Fachexperten beim Partner fachlich absichern

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Performance-Marketing im B2B, davon mindestens zwei mit eigener Verantwortung für ein Google-Ads-Konto und das Budget dahinter, idealerweise in einem guten Start-up- oder Scale-up-Umfeld

  • Google Ads auf Profi-Niveau: Du steuerst Konten selbst, dazu Microsoft Ads und Conversion-Tracking

  • Landingpages und Conversion-Optimierung hast du selbst umgesetzt

  • Du hast eine Kennzahl nachweislich verändert und kannst begründen, warum gerade diese

  • Du kommst mit einem Plan, verbindest Themen mit Kennzahlen und kannst jederzeit sagen, woran du arbeitest und was du davon erwartest

  • Du siehst selbst, welches Thema als Nächstes dran ist, strukturierst es und setzt es um, ohne dass dich jemand darum bittet

  • Was du zusagst, hältst du. Und wenn etwas kippt, sagst du es früh.

  • Ausgeprägte AI-Affinität und Lust, Abläufe zu automatisieren

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch

  • Mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in Bielefeld

Wo du bei uns wachsen kannst: Copywriting. Läuft Paid automatisiert, gewinnst du Zeit für Texte, die auf der Website, in Anzeigen und im Outbound wirken. Das musst du nicht perfekt mitbringen, aber Lust haben, darin richtig gut zu werden.

Ein Plus: Praxis mit CRM und Marketing Automation, idealerweise selbst gebaute Workflows in HubSpot · Erfahrung mit Kundenbindung oder Reaktivierung · Projektleitung · erklärungsbedürftige Industrieprodukte

Was wir bieten

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du entscheidest über Kanalmix und Budget und sitzt mit dem CCO am Tisch, wenn Strategie und Prioritäten festgelegt werden.

  • Ein AI-first Setup: Agents, Automatisierung und kurze Wege statt Freigabeschleifen.

  • Vergütung: 60.000–75.000 € brutto fix im Jahr, dazu ein Bonus.

  • Team und Ort: Moderne Büroräume in Bielefeld, regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.

  • Ein greifbares Produkt: Dein Beitrag macht die industrielle Beschaffung einfacher.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Kennenlernen (30 Minuten, remote)

  2. Gespräch vor Ort in Bielefeld mit dem Team

  3. Live-Arbeitsaufgabe vor Ort, ohne Vorbereitung: Wir wollen sehen, wie du arbeitest, nicht wie du präsentierst. AI-Tools sind ausdrücklich erlaubt.

  4. Zwei Referenzgespräche, bevor wir dir ein Angebot machen

Bei weiter Anreise legen wir Schritt 2 und 3 auf einen Tag.

Statt eines Anschreibens schick uns drei kurze Antworten:
