title: Personalreferent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Hauptverwaltung Düsseldorf · Direkt an die Geschäftsführung angebunden · Start kurzfristig, spätestens zum 01.01.2027

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Stell dir vor

Montagmorgen. Eine Standortleitung braucht bis Mitte des Monats eine neue Dozentin, also geht die Anzeige heute noch raus. Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Du sortierst, legst los – und am Abend ist alles erledigt und sauber in Personio dokumentiert.

Das ist kein Werbetext. Das ist der Job. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personalarbeit nicht delegiert, sondern macht: von der Stellenanzeige bis zum Zeugnis, selbstständig und mit Tempo.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg und Berlin sowie in Marokko. Wir konzipieren und realisieren geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprachkurse und Weiterbildungen – für Privat- wie Firmenkunden, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Worum es geht

Wir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. Dafür brauchen wir kurzfristig eine Person, die unsere Personalarbeit operativ in die Hand nimmt: das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung, schnelles Recruiting und eine Personalabteilung, die vollständig über Personio läuft.

Du arbeitest sehr eigenständig, verantwortest die operative Personalarbeit ab Januar in eigener Hand und hast den direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Wenn du gern selbst anpackst, statt Zuständigkeiten zu verteilen, bist du hier richtig.

Was du bewegst

  • Personalabteilung über Personio führen – Du führst unsere Personalarbeit in Personio: Stammdaten, digitale Personalakte, Abwesenheiten, Dokumente, Workflows und Auswertungen. Was noch nicht sauber läuft, richtest du ein.
  • Personalsachbearbeitung von A bis Z – Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und Schreiben erstellst du selbst. Du pflegst die Personalakten und behältst Fristen wie Probezeiten und Befristungen im Blick.
  • Kurzfristig einstellen – Du schreibst Stellen aus, sichtest Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche, stimmst Termine ab und bringst Einstellungen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift – auch wenn es schnell gehen muss.
  • On- und Offboarding – Du begleitest Eintritte und Austritte vollständig: Unterlagen, Unterweisungen, Zugänge, Übergaben.
  • Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung – Du bereitest die monatlichen Lohndaten vor, klärst Rückfragen und hältst den Kontakt zur Steuerberatung.
  • Ansprechperson im Alltag – Du bist erste Adresse für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei allen Personalfragen und bereitest arbeitsrechtliche Vorgänge wie Abmahnungen oder Kündigungen sauber vor.
  • Mitdenken und anpacken – Du kümmerst dich um das, was anfällt – auch wenn es nicht in der Stellenbeschreibung steht.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zur Personalkauffrau bzw. zum Personalkaufmann, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.
  • Erfahrung – Mehrjährige Praxis in der operativen Personalarbeit. Du beherrschst das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung und hast es selbst gemacht, nicht nur begleitet.
  • Personio – Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio und hast das System idealerweise selbst eingerichtet oder administriert.
  • Arbeitsrecht – Solide Grundkenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht für das Tagesgeschäft – und das Gespür dafür, wann du dir Rat holst.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität – Du packst an, kümmerst dich und arbeitest gern selbstständig. Du priorisierst sicher, wenn vieles gleichzeitig kommt.
  • Verfügbarkeit – Du kannst kurzfristig einsteigen, bestenfalls zum 01.01.2027 oder früher.
  • Persönlichkeit – Verbindlichkeit, strukturierter Arbeitsstil, klare Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift und absolute Diskretion.
  • Von Vorteil – Erfahrung bei einem Bildungsträger oder im SGB-II/III-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Was du bei uns findest

  • Eigenverantwortung – Du baust die Personalarbeit so auf, wie sie gut funktioniert – mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Wirkung – Deine Arbeit betrifft unmittelbar unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Führungskräfte und die Entwicklung der gesamten Gruppe.
  • Ein Team mit echter Diversity – Auf Augenhöhe, mehrsprachig und mit Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.
  • Entwicklung – Gezielte Förderung deiner Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung.
  • Sicherheit – Festanstellung bei einem Bildungsträger, der seit über 15 Jahren im Markt ist.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) mit Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Eintrittstermin an Herrn Debdoubi

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei einer der operativen Tochtergesellschaften der EuBiA-Gruppe – EuBiA GmbH, EuBiA Rhein-Ruhr-West GmbH oder EuBiA NRW GmbH – je nach Aufgabengebiet.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: PhD Researcher – Video Understanding & VLMs
descriptionHtml:
About Almetra

We build vision-language models that understand what happens on real factory floors. Cameras on 20+ production lines stream video into our models, which turn every step (assembling, screwing, inspecting) into structured data several times per second. Customers use it to see where time gets lost and how to improve their processes.

Your role

You’ll do your PhD with us from day one, working closely with Sascha, our Head of ML (VLM), on research problems that come straight from our product. Your research runs on real industrial video at a scale few academic labs have. The PhD is co-supervised by a university professor, and you’ll be enrolled at a partner university.

What you’ll work on

  • Video understanding with VLMs: action recognition, temporal grounding and long-video reasoning on factory footage

  • Making models robust in the real world: occlusions, unusual viewpoints, new stations and products with little labelled data

  • Turning research results into improvements in our production models

  • Publishing at top venues (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) together with our ML team

What you bring

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a closely related field, with a focus on computer vision or multimodal learning (finished or finishing by early-2027)

  • Solid deep learning foundations and hands-on PyTorch

  • Experience with computer vision, video or multimodal models (thesis, projects or internships)

  • Curiosity about real-world problems, not only benchmarks

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • First publications or a strong thesis in vision-language, video understanding or multimodal learning

  • Experience with open VLMs (e.g. Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA) or video models (e.g. VideoMAE, ViViT)

  • Training on GPU clusters (DDP / FSDP)

Why a PhD with us

  • A full-time, paid PhD position in Berlin

  • Mentoring from our Head of ML plus academic co-supervision

  • Unique real-world video data and the compute to use it

  • Your research reaches a real product, not just a paper

What we offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. title: Platform Associate (m/f/d): Talent, Growth, Content & AI Workflows
descriptionHtml:
Remote, with offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · Start January or February 2027

About us

First Momentum invests in deep tech and industrial tech founders across Europe at pre-seed when there's more lab than traction. We've made 40+ investments into industries like energy, space, industrial, and semicon, and our companies went on to raise from Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, or Insight Partners.

We're a team of engineers, scientists, and operators on a mission to build a different kind of VC fund. Our goal isn't the biggest fund or the loudest headlines, but to be the VC deeply technical teams need and deserve at inception. Someone who truly understands their tech, is humble and candid, and connects them with the relevant people they need at a given stage, be it a designer or a pilot customer. You won't find us at the after-party; instead, we're obsessing over good reads, fast bikes, and the latest moonshots we want to bring to life.

Your tasks

For us, platform is like a product with multiple customer groups: founders, LPs, Scouts, and the investment team. While we get inspired by playbooks and what other funds are doing, we treat them as what they are: past successes. For us, platform is much more similar to what our portfolio teams are doing: building products and driving growth, whether for our fund or our portcos. We come up with new ideas, identify the most impactful ones, test them, measure, iterate, or drop them and rerun the entire sprint. Your north star: helping our portfolio founders succeed through intros, hires, and any other random request. We measure ourselves on support per euro invested. Much of that support runs through the Platform team.

Call it Founder's Associate, Chief of Staff, Venture Ops, GTM, or Growth. Here, it means you take on some of the most pressing problems of our portfolio companies and the fund operations. You'll work with several super-technical, highly humble founders and the investment team at once.

  • Hiring for the portfolio: The first 10 people shape a startup more than anything else. You run multiple outbound campaigns in parallel, from sourcing and outreach to the final intro, and learn each field well enough to find the best talent. Sometimes that means building teams from zero for our incubation projects; previous ones: Telura (deep geothermal) and Starforge (fusion energy).

  • Content and website: You turn the technical and industry expertise from First Momentum's investment team and portfolio news (funding rounds, launches, technical results) into content for LinkedIn, our blog, and our newsletter. You also own our Webflow site and how AI search finds us.

  • European deep tech community: You grow our community of 100+ technical Venture Scouts and bring them into hiring and deals. You support in-person events like our annual meeting and help co-organize the European Spinoff Summit in Munich.

  • Tooling and workflows: If you've done something by hand twice, you build a Claude skill or automation for it the third time.

Your profile

  • 1–2 years of hands-on work at a startup, VC, recruiting firm, or similar

  • Sourcing or outbound experience, whether in recruiting or in sales/GTM

  • You write very well in English (full working proficiency); German is a plus

  • You can run 10+ workstreams at once without daily steering and know where the 80/20 is

  • You're fast, friendly, and specific with founders, partners, and candidates

  • You like building generally, also with AI tools, BUT know when not to use them and when your own judgment beats the model's

  • You're curious about many fields and fine switching from a Head of Biology search to a blog post to a website fix in one afternoon

  • A good eye for design

What we offer


Work with people building fusion reactors and foundation models

You work with the teams behind 40+ deep tech companies and with our partners from day one.


See Technology 5–10 years earlier

You see what comes straight out of research labs long before most people meet it in a product.


Your next job is already in the portfolio

You'll get to know dozens of startups from the inside. If at some time you feel like moving on, you’ll have a great network to rely on, but we will also actively help. If you want, you can stay part of First Momentum after your time with us through our Venture Scout program. Some Scouts have since joined Y Combinator, built $20M-funded robotics spinouts, or moved to Anthropic's design team. More here: https://www.firstmomentum.vc/venture-scouts


Room to build

New tools, workflows, and formats. If it works, it stays. You'll have few meetings, coordinate mostly async, and plan your own week.


Five fields in one job

Recruiting, content, design, web, and AI tooling. Most people with 1–2 years of experience get to work in one of them.


Remote Culture

Our team is spread across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Spain. We don't hire local optimum but hire the best people wherever they are in Europe. To work together and have some fun, we meet every two months for our team days.

Before you apply

Start: January/February 2027 · Full-time · Remote, offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · English required, German is a plus

Along with your CV, add 2–3 sentences on something you built, wrote, or sourced. If you don't tick every box, tell us in your application why you'd still fit. Career switchers and people from outside VC are explicitly welcome.

Please apply only if you can start in January/February 2027.

title: PMO Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As a PMO Operations Specialist, you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives.

You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone.

This is an opportunity to join the PMO during its early development and make a meaningful impact on how Focused Energy plans, tracks, and delivers its most important initiatives. You'll bring structure to complexity, ensure important details don't fall through the cracks, and help build a scalable foundation for the company's continued growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the PMO Operating Rhythm: Coordinate and manage the weekly project reporting cycle across dozens of active initiatives, ensuring timely updates, accurate information, and consistent visibility into project progress.

  • Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting.

  • Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues.

  • Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency.

  • Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation.

  • Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Support Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prepare and support workshops, meetings, and working sessions, ensuring the right information is available, discussions stay organized, and agreed actions are followed through.

  • Maintain Clear Documentation: Ensure PMO processes, project information, and supporting documentation are complete, accessible, and consistently maintained.

  • Keep Things Moving: Proactively identify overdue actions, unclear responsibilities, and emerging gaps, escalating risks to the PMO Lead before they impact project delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in project management, PMO operations, project coordination, or business operations, ideally within a technical, engineering, R&D, or fast-growing organization.

  • You understand project management fundamentals and the importance of consistent reporting, reliable documentation, clear ownership, and effective coordination across multiple initiatives.

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and large volumes of project information without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • You are comfortable translating processes and concepts into practical workflows, documentation, and guidance that people outside of project management can easily understand and adopt.

  • You take an ownership-driven approach to your work, naturally identifying what's missing, unclear, or unfinished and proactively driving it toward resolution.

  • You are a clear and confident communicator in both German and English, able to follow up persistently and constructively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical expertise.

  • You enjoy working with diverse teams, including scientists, engineers, and business professionals, and can adapt your communication style to different audiences.

  • You demonstrate good judgment and understand when to make decisions independently versus when to escalate process or scope changes to leadership.

  • You have a continuous improvement mindset and are interested in simplifying processes, reducing manual work, and leveraging automation and AI tools to improve efficiency.

  • You thrive in an evolving environment where processes are still being established and enjoy bringing structure, consistency, and momentum to a growing organization.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI Creator
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.

We’re building an AI Creator that turns learning into action—empowering users to instantly build, experiment, and solve real-world problems, transforming knowledge into tangible impact from day one.. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You’re a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve the core AI tutoring system, including prompt architectures, agentic workflows, and real-time adaptive behaviors.
  • Run rigorous experimentation and evaluation, developing custom metrics and frameworks to measure learning effectiveness and improve model reliability.
  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable software, integrating AI capabilities with platform systems, content pipelines, and user experience components.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with educators, content creators, and product teams to translate pedagogical goals into technical solutions.
  • Prototype and productionize novel model interactions, leveraging emerging research and capabilities to advance the tutor’s intelligence.
  • Ensure quality, safety, and observability through monitoring, testing, guardrails, and iterative refinement of model behavior.
  • Share knowledge and elevate teammates, contributing to a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous learning.

Qualifications

Technical

  • 1+ years building complex LLM-based systems, with strong prompt engineering intuition and experience designing agentic workflows.
  • Ability to design meaningful evaluation methods, including custom metrics and frameworks when off-the-shelf options fall short.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, architectural thinking, and fluency in Python; comfortable working with production infrastructure, cloud environments, and CI/CD.
  • Actively follows AI research and emerging capabilities, applying new ideas creatively to real problems.

Product & Pedagogy

  • Strong empathy for learners and content creators; able to translate pedagogical goals into system behavior and product decisions.
  • Ability to reason holistically across AI behavior, content structure, platform features, and user experience.
  • Familiarity with learning science or a desire to develop expertise.

Character & Collaboration

  • Drawn to difficult, ambiguous problems with no clear blueprint; persistent in exploring and refining solutions.
  • Preference for elegance and simplicity in system design.
  • Communicates clearly across mediums and enjoys mentoring and collaborating in small, high-ownership teams.

Why Datacamp? 

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible! 
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we’re awesome!

title: Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer, you will be Volta's technical authority for building and power management controls. You will set the controls architecture, standards and acceptance regime that every DSX site is built to, across Europe and North America.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will decide how controls are specified, integrated and proven, and your standards will be used by design, delivery, commissioning and operations teams across the whole portfolio.

What you will do

Controls architecture and standards

  • Set Volta's global controls architecture for BMS and PMS, including system boundaries, network design, redundancy and integration with facility monitoring and compute.

  • Own the controls standards library: sequences of operation, points schedules, alarm philosophy, naming conventions and FAT/SAT requirements.

  • Define controls requirements for high-density AI workloads, including liquid cooling, CDU integration and power-to-compute interfaces.

Technical authority

  • Make the final technical call on controls design deviations, vendor proposals and integration disputes across all sites.

  • Shape vendor and framework strategy with Procurement, setting the technical bar suppliers are selected against.

  • Set controls security requirements with Systems Security, covering segmentation, access and secure remote support.

Capability and improvement

  • Use operating data and incidents to evolve the standards and the reference design.

  • Coach and raise the capability of controls engineers and specialists across Volta and its partners.

What we are looking for

  • Recognised senior authority in BMS/PMS or mission-critical controls, typically 12+ years, with data centre experience essential.

  • A track record setting controls architecture and standards across a portfolio of sites, not a single project.

  • Deep knowledge of electrical and mechanical control sequences, supervisory platforms, and protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.

  • Experience making and defending high-consequence technical decisions with vendors, designers and executives.

  • Experience defining FAT/SAT and integrated systems test regimes for controls.

  • Ability to influence across functions and regions without direct authority.

Nice to have

  • Controls for high-density AI facilities and direct liquid cooling.

  • OT security and controls network architecture, for example IEC 62443.

  • Standardising controls across an international portfolio.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Product Manager – Atlassian Service Management
descriptionHtml:
You want to give service teams tools that make their work easier and make commercial sense. At XALT, you develop our offering for organisations considering a move from ServiceNow to Atlassian. You investigate what clients actually need and which gaps we must close to support them.

What we are working towards

We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.

What you will work on

  • Analyse differences between ServiceNow and Atlassian service management and prioritise relevant feature gaps.
  • Define Forge apps and work with engineering to develop them.
  • Support Marketplace go-to-market work and co-selling with Atlassian.
  • Help manage existing apps such as User2Assets and Visitation Calendar.
  • Develop a clear migration approach from ServiceNow to Jira Service Management.

What you bring

  • Experience in product management or developing service management offerings
  • Understanding of client processes, integrations and commercial product decisions
  • Interest in the Atlassian ecosystem and collaboration with engineering and sales
  • An AI workflow or prototype of your own whose value you can demonstrate

What we offer

  • Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
  • €70,000–95,000 gross per year
  • Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution

Your working arrangements

We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.

Our professional community

Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.

Your AI example

We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code.

title: Projektleiter Montage (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik · Projektabwicklung · Baustellenkoordination · Kalkulation

Vollzeit | Standort Erkrath | Baustellen- und Projekttermine nach Bedarf

Du willst Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass sie auf der Baustelle funktionieren?

Dann übernimm bei uns Verantwortung von der Besichtigung und Kalkulation über die Planung und Bestellung bis zur Begleitung der Montage. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, packst Probleme an und findest Lösungen, statt auf andere zu warten.

Wer wir sind

Kältetechnik Ollbrink ist ein familiengeführtes Mehrgenerationen-Handwerksunternehmen. Von unseren Standorten in Bochum und Erkrath realisieren und betreuen wir Lösungen rund um Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor. Als Teil eines starken Unternehmensverbunds verbinden wir gewachsene Erfahrung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und neuen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Warum diese Position?

Für unseren Standort Erkrath suchen wir keinen klassischen Bereichsleiter und auch keinen reinen Verkäufer. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Praktiker, der Montageprojekte aktiv vorbereitet, organisiert und bis zum Abschluss begleitet. Du arbeitest selbstständig, gibst den Monteuren eine klare Richtung und sorgst dafür, dass Material, Termine, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenpassen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Besichtigung und technische Bewertung von Baustellen sowie Abstimmung der Anforderungen mit Kunden und Projektbeteiligten

  • Erstellung, Kalkulation und Nachverfolgung von Angeboten sowie Bearbeitung passender Ausschreibungen

  • Planung und Vorbereitung der Montageprojekte einschließlich Personal-, Termin-, Material- und Bestellplanung

  • Koordination, praktische Anleitung und Überwachung der eingesetzten Monteure und Nachunternehmer

  • Begleitung der Baustellen, Teilnahme an Baubesprechungen sowie Abstimmung mit Kunden, Planern und anderen Gewerken

  • Kontrolle von Projektfortschritt, Terminen, Kosten, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit

  • Klärung technischer und organisatorischer Probleme und Entwicklung umsetzbarer Lösungen, bei Bedarf unter Einbindung geeigneter externer Fachpartner

  • Dokumentation, Nachtragsmanagement und Vorbereitung einer sauberen Projektübergabe bzw. Abrechnung

  • Aktives Beobachten der Projektauslastung: Wenn Folgeprojekte fehlen, bringst Du Ideen ein, stößt Vertriebsaktivitäten rechtzeitig an und holst Dir bei Bedarf Unterstützung, statt abzuwarten

  • Mitarbeit an praxistauglichen Verbesserungen unserer Abläufe am Standort Erkrath

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Eine technische Ausbildung im Bereich Kälte-, Klima-, Lüftungs-, Anlagen- oder Versorgungstechnik; eine Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend entscheidend

  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Abwicklung von Montage-, Bau- oder Anlagenprojekten

  • Technisches Verständnis, kaufmännisches Grundgefühl und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Angeboten, Materialbestellungen und Projektkosten

  • Die Fähigkeit, Monteure klar anzuleiten, Arbeiten zu kontrollieren und auf der Baustelle verbindlich aufzutreten

  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Themen konsequent bis zum Abschluss zu verfolgen

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Nachunternehmern und anderen Gewerken

  • Ein gutes Gespür für neue Projekte und die Bereitschaft, vertriebliche Impulse zu setzen, ohne dass Du ein klassischer Vertriebsprofi sein musst

  • Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen, insbesondere für Baustellenbesichtigungen, Baubesprechungen und Projekttermine

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristete Perspektive

Ein langfristig angelegtes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem familiengeführten Unternehmen.

  • Dienstwagen

Ein Dienstwagen für Deine projektbezogenen Termine und Baustellenbesuche, auch zur privaten Nutzung nach individueller Vereinbarung.

  • Eigenverantwortung

Du organisierst Deine Projekte mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Abstimmung.

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel

Eine angemessene technische und digitale Ausstattung für Deine Projektarbeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung

Fachliche Weiterbildungen und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten passend zu Deiner Aufgabe.

  • Starker Verbund

Du profitierst von den Strukturen und Benefits unseres Unternehmensverbunds.

  • Leistungsbezogene Prämien

Jährliche Bonusauszahlung durch den Verbund

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen

300 EUR Gesundheitsbonus pro Jahr sowie Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VL).

  • Gesundheit und Mobilität

Fahrradleasing und Angebote des Gesundheitsprogramms CareHuman ergänzen unser Leistungspaket.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Technik

Projekte für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor sorgen für unterschiedliche technische Anforderungen.

  • Finanzielle Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Bezuschussung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

  • Gemeinsame Teamevents

Ganz offen

Diese Position ist nichts für jemanden, der Projekte nur vom Schreibtisch aus begleitet oder bei Schwierigkeiten auf eine Entscheidung von anderen wartet. Baustellen laufen nicht immer nach Plan. Deshalb brauchen wir jemanden, der sich ein Bild vor Ort macht, Prioritäten setzt, mit den Beteiligten spricht und eine tragfähige Lösung organisiert. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Du die Auslastung im Blick behältst und frühzeitig aktiv wirst, wenn neue Projekte fehlen. Du musst dabei nicht alles allein können, aber Du solltest erkennen, wann Unterstützung erforderlich ist, und sie gezielt einbinden.

Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.

Learn more at www.shift-technology.com

Shift Technology : 

Shift is the leading AI platform for insurance. Shift combines generative, agentic, and predictive AI to detect fraud, assess risk, and recommend actions throughout the claims process. Our teams tackle complex data challenges and bring advanced models into production at scale, giving insurers deeper insights into their data while helping their customers get paid faster and enjoy a smoother claims experience. Our technology is adopted and trusted by the world’s leading insurers.

The QA Engineering Team 🧪:

The Quality Assurance team, part of Engineering, makes sure that Shift can ship fast and safely. Our AI-driven software is deployed for insurers worldwide, across many multi-tenant environments, and we use Generative AI, LLM agents, and modern automation to solve quality challenges at this scale. Here are just a few of the areas we work on:

  • Release validation: risk-based testing and delivery automation;
  • Automated regression suites and test automation;
  • Functional test coverage and test gap analysis;
  • Test data generation and test environment provisioning;
  • AI-powered QA tooling, built with LLMs and agents, that engineers and QA leads use every day

Working with Engineering teams and QA leads, we replace manual QA effort with intelligent tooling, and we measure the time it saves.

Your key responsibilities🧑‍💻:

You’ll own an end-to-end project that moves a real QA bottleneck from manual effort to intelligent tooling. You will build something the QA engineering teams use in their day-to-day work, not a proof of concept that stays on a shelf. Your subject will be defined with you during the selection process, within one of these example missions:

  • AI-driven release validation: build a “release copilot” that analyzes release tickets and code changes to compute risk scores and generate risk-based test plans. It also helps run bug bash sessions (scope, assignment, triage, duplicate detection) and drafts test reports and release notes.
  • Functional coverage and test gap analysis: use code intelligence and LLMs to detect shipped features, feature flags, and endpoints, map them against environment configurations and automated regression suites, and show untested areas in a live coverage dashboard.
  • Synthetic test data and environment provisioning: design a data generation and seeding pipeline (CLI / API) that produces realistic, deterministic, and privacy-compliant datasets, so teams can provision and reset test environments on demand, integrated into CI/CD.

Along the way, you’ll learn how QA, Engineering, and Product work together to ship AI software to insurers around the world. Your project will go beyond a prototype: you will validate it on real releases, hand it over with documentation, and present the results to leadership.

  • Your profile and requirements✅:
  • You are currently in your final year (BAC+5, Master 2 or engineering school) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data, or AI.
  • You have solid programming skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C#.
  • You have a good grasp of software testing fundamentals, Git, and REST APIs.
  • You are autonomous and rigorous, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Nice to have: hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or agent frameworks (LangChain, Copilot, OpenAI/Claude APIs); test automation (Playwright, Cypress); CI/CD (GitHub Actions, TeamCity); Docker/Kubernetes; SQL or lightweight dashboards (Streamlit, React, FastAPI).
  • You can provide a 6-month internship agreement (Convention de stage) signed by your school/university, starting around February 2027
  • Language requirements: English is mandatory at a fluent level (French is a plus).

Why join Shift Technology as a QA Engineer Intern? 

🤸‍♀️Flexibility, autonomy  and adaptability are part of our core values : We are a horizontal organization without bureaucracy (65% of staff are in tech roles) but optimal and reduced line management, focus on delivery and development while having a hybrid model.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
descriptionHtml:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

About the diploma

  • A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online.

  • Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision.

  • Full course fees funded by Montu UK.

  • Two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales.

Eligibility

  • A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu.

  • Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

What will you be doing?

  • Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions.

  • Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management.

  • Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing.

  • Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate.

  • Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice.

  • Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Completing the sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management alongside clinical responsibilities.

  • Participating in ongoing training and professional development, including specialist training in cannabis-based prescription medicines.

What you need

  • Full GMC registration with a current licence to practise.

  • Completion of specialist training in Anaesthesia (CCT/CCST) or equivalent.

  • Entry on the GMC Specialist Register for Anaesthesia.

  • Strong knowledge of analgesic pharmacology, pain management and safe prescribing.

  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach to care.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary clinical team.

  • A strong interest in chronic pain and alternative treatment options.

  • Willingness to participate in clinical outcome data collection and reporting.

  • Ability to commit to a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

Previous chronic pain experience is welcome but not essential, as the sponsored diploma and comprehensive in-house training will support professional development.

Why join us?

  • Competitive Salary: £170,000 FTE, pro rata for contracted hours.

  • Funded Postgraduate Diploma: Full course fees for the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, plus two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

  • Flexible Working: Fully remote working with flexible clinical sessions and a minimum commitment of 24 hours per week.

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for work undertaken within the role.

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on-call requirements.

  • Specialist Training: Access to CPD-accredited medical cannabis education and specialist training from experienced clinicians.

  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals.

  • Professional Development: Build expertise in chronic pain management and contribute to an evolving area of medicine.

Training & Development

  • Fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales.

  • Regular CPD sessions to support ongoing professional development, appraisal and revalidation.

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training in clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's clinical systems.

  • Appraisal and revalidation support where Montu is the main employer.

Working arrangements

  • Remote Role: Fully remote working with flexibility around working days and hours.

  • Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 24 hours per week, consisting of 22 hours of clinical work and two hours of protected, paid study time.

  • Sessions: Standard clinical sessions consist of four hours of patient consultations, with flexibility to arrange sessions around preferred working days and hours.

  • Appointment Durations: 15 minutes for new and existing patients.

  • Multidisciplinary Support: Nurses and pharmacists support pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing and patient care.

Our multidisciplinary model enables consultants to focus on their clinical expertise while benefiting from the support of an experienced wider healthcare team.

What we offer

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Data Engineer      

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business—from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud-native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Technical Expertise: 3+ years building and shipping production-grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure—ideally some exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.
  • Experience designing data APIs or services that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.
  • A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security—you understand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across teams with different priorities—engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and product.
  • A pragmatic, curious mindset—you enjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.
  • Pipeline Management: Hands-on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimize for performance and reliability.
  • Quality Focus: Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Documentation: Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Independence: Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.

What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications—from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.
  • Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.
  • System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.
  • Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.
  • Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.
  • Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions—not just the quickest ones.
  • Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: Remote Manager (Director) Partnerships DACH (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠
