title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

  • Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.

  • Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.

Nice to Have

  • Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.

  • Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.

  • Robotics or embodied AI.

  • Simulation for data generation.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
descriptionHtml:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

 We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

In particular, you will be responsible for:

  • Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.

  • Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.

  • Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.

  • Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

  • Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.

  • Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.

  • Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.

  • Technical stack:

    • Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).

    • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.

    • Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

 Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).

  • Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

  • Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

 #LI-HB1

Recruitment Process & Security

Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

title: Sales Manager, UK - SMB/MM/Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on sales leader for the UK. You’ll build, lead, and coach the regional Sales team, deliver against ARR and pipeline goals, and build a repeatable local growth engine.

You'll act as the business lead for your market, with accountability for revenue. As a sales leader, you'll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable sales approach that fits your market. As an orchestrator, you'll coordinate the local pipeline generation activities that feed your number, including marketing and pre-sales. You'll work closely with leaders across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, and influence how they support your market's priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Own the region’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Work with the CRO to set priorities, understand capacity needs, and support the team to deliver against the plan.

  • Build and lead the regional Sales team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop sellers, while staying hands-on in priority opportunities from prospecting and discovery through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on regional customer conversations, deal patterns, and market needs. Build and refine a repeatable regional sales approach using pipeline, win/loss learning, and customer outcomes.

  • Drive the plan in partnership with field marketing to set priorities for events, campaigns, customer advocacy and community programs, and direct how field marketing resources are used to support your pipeline and ARR goals.

  • Partner with the marketing leadership, who own field marketing standards, methods and team management, to make sure regional programs are well executed, measured and consistent with Dust's broader marketing approach

  • Partner with BDR and Growth leaders to build a qualified pipeline through a deliberate mix of outbound and other locally effective channels.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support regional priorities. Work with the Partnerships lead to identify opportunities for sourcing, co-selling, or delivery.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support credible evaluations, successful implementations, customer outcomes, and expansion.

  • Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust.

Market-specific focus

United Kingdom

Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market.

  • You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners

  • Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close.

  • Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing.

  • A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style.

  • An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth.

What success looks like

The region delivers against its ARR and pipeline goals while developing a repeatable sales approach suited to local customers. The team builds customer trust and referenceable outcomes, cross-functional support is focused on regional priorities, and market learning informs Dust’s broader GTM approach.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

title: Sales Team Lead (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
What we are building at Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

#3 How we operate

  • We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

  • We work hard, and we have fun.

  • To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

The Role

As a Sales Manager at Conveo, you'll lead a team of six Account Executives and turn them into the best-performing sales team in our category. You'll own your team's number, coach every rep to their full potential, and build the rhythm that makes great selling repeatable: sharp discovery, airtight qualification, accurate forecasting, and winning bake-offs. You'll stay close to the deals that matter most, stepping in with CMOs, insights leaders, and procurement when it counts, and you'll make sure every account and every new-logo pursuit on your team has a clear owner and a clear plan. You'll work hand in hand with the founders, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product, and you'll help us hire and ramp the next wave of sellers as we scale across EMEA. You'll report to our EMEA Head of Revenue.

Your Mission

Lead and Grow a Team of Six AEs

  • Own your team's quarterly and annual targets, and make sure every AE has a clear path to hitting their own number.

  • Run weekly 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews that are short, sharp, and actually change outcomes.

  • Coach in the field: join discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, and give feedback the same day.

  • Build individual development plans so every AE knows exactly what great looks like and how to get there.

  • Set the bar on activity, pipeline generation, and deal quality, and hold the team to it with care and candour.

Build a Repeatable Sales Engine

  • Embed our sales methodology (SPICED discovery, MEDDIC qualification, and mutual close plans) into every deal.

  • Own a forecast you would bet your reputation on, with HubSpot as the single source of truth.

  • Keep every account and new-logo pursuit on your team owned, planned, and moving.

  • Turn the patterns in won and lost deals into better talk tracks, playbooks, and enablement.

  • Partner with Marketing and our BDRs to make sure your team always has 4-5x pipeline coverage.

Win the Deals That Matter

  • Get involved in your team's largest and most complex opportunities, from first meeting to signature.

  • Help your AEs multi-thread across insights, marketing, product, procurement, and the executive suite.

  • Lead from the front on competitive bake-offs and keep our winning record intact.

  • Bring in founders and senior leaders at the right moments to win.

  • Hand every new customer over to Customer Success set up to expand.

Hire and Ramp the Best

  • Help us hire world-class AEs as we scale the team aggressively over the next year.

  • Onboard new hires fast, so they're running their own deals within their first few months.

  • Build a team culture people want to join: ambitious, generous, high-energy, and obsessed with our clients.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your team consistently hits its number, quarter after quarter.

  • Every AE on your team is growing, with a clear development plan and visible progress against it.

  • Accurate forecasts and healthy 4-5x pipeline coverage across your team.

  • New hires fully ramped within their first four to five months.

  • Repeatable plays, talk tracks, and coaching habits we can roll out across the whole sales org.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of B2B sales in Enterprise SaaS or Martech, including a strong track record as a quota-carrying AE.

  • 3-5+ years leading and coaching a team of AEs, with a history of hitting team targets.

  • Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder deals into large enterprises with long sales cycles.

  • A coach first: you make people better, and your reps would follow you to your next company.

  • A data-driven operator who lives in the CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) and forecasts with precision.

  • Great if you have a background in market research, insights, brand, or consulting.

  • Great if you've scaled a sales team through hypergrowth, across EMEA and the US.

  • High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

  • Excellent communication skills: clear, direct, and credible with both your team and senior executives.

  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

Why join us

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

Plus

  • Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Lead a team selling to some of the world’s most iconic brands.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

When your product is the front door to someone else’s product, security isn’t a feature, it’s the product. Every login and every signup that goes through Prelude is a moment where our customers trust us with their users, their phone numbers, and their reputation.

As our first dedicated Security Engineer, you’ll own security across Prelude: our cloud infrastructure, our codebase, our APIs and SDKs, and the way we handle the sensitive data that flows through them. You’ll start from solid ground: a certified ISO 27001 and SOC 2 program, short-lived credentials across our cloud environment, and a 24/7 on-call rotation. You’ll run that foundation day to day and take it further, with direct support from Engineering leadership and the founders.

This is a hands-on IC role: you’ll write code, ship guardrails, and fix things yourself, and set the standard for how every engineer at Prelude thinks about security.

What you’ll do

Own the security of our cloud infrastructure. Harden our AWS and ClickHouse environments and make the secure path the default for every service we deploy.

Build security into how we ship. Run threat modeling and design reviews with engineers, review critical code paths, and extend our automated checks in CI/CD (adding dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and IaC security scanning) without slowing the team down.

Protect our customers’ users and their data. Personal data is at the heart of our product. Design and enforce the controls that protect it (encryption, access control, retention, and auditability) in line with GDPR and our customers’ expectations.

Mature detection and incident response. Extend our logging, alerting, and runbooks to spot abuse and compromise early, lead incident response when something goes wrong, and write honest post-mortems the next morning.

Drive compliance and customer trust. Maintain and mature our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications through surveillance and recertification audits. Own our answers to enterprise security questionnaires, and be the technical voice of Prelude’s security posture with our largest customers.

Partner with our anti-fraud team. Fraud here isn’t theoretical. Work alongside the engineers fighting SMS pumping, toll fraud, bot traffic, and account takeover attempts in production, bringing an attacker’s mindset to the problems at the core of our product.

Use AI to multiply your impact. AI is already part of how we build. Make it part of how we defend: automate triage, log analysis, questionnaire answers, and code review so a team of one can operate like a team of five.

Join the on-call rotation for the systems you secure.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud and infrastructure security, ideally at a fast-growing tech company

  • Hands-on experience securing AWS in production (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, or equivalent), and comfort working with infrastructure as code

  • Strong software engineering skills: you can read and write production code, ideally in Go or TypeScript, and fix vulnerabilities yourself rather than just filing tickets

  • Solid knowledge of web and API security (OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization flows, rate limiting, abuse prevention)

  • Experience building or running security programs pragmatically: you know which 20% of controls cover 80% of the risk at a company our size

  • Experience with incident response and with setting up logging, monitoring, and alerting

  • A builder’s mindset: you prefer guardrails and automation over gatekeeping, and engineers see you as a partner, not a blocker

  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain risk to an engineer, a founder, and a customer’s CISO

  • Professional fluency in English, the working language of our international team

Nice to have

  • Experience maintaining SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001 certifications through audit cycles

  • Background in identity, authentication, fintech, telecom, or another regulated or high-stakes domain

  • Familiarity with fraud and abuse patterns (SMS pumping, bot traffic, account takeover)

  • Penetration testing or red team experience, or a track record in bug bounty programs

  • Knowledge of telecom protocols and ecosystem risks (SMPP, SS7, SIM swap)

  • Experience with Connect/gRPC and Protobuf, Rust, or AWS serverless architectures

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

Tech stack

  • Languages: Go, TypeScript, React

  • Infrastructure and data: AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, SQS), ClickHouse, Connect RPC and Protobuf

  • Infrastructure as code and CI: AWS CDK (Go), GitHub Actions

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Grafana

  • Build: Bazel

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever comes next

title: Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale.

Your mission

As part of Klim's Business Development Team within the Commercial team, you will scale our reach by building and deepening relationships with marketplaces, intermediaries, brokers, and distribution partners. You will drive revenue by developing the channels through which Klim's carbon credits reach buyers at scale and help bring carbon credits to market. This includes designing partnership structures, onboarding intermediaries, and enabling them to represent and sell Klim's offerings with confidence to buyers. This role is for someone who understands that the most durable commercial impact comes from building the right ecosystems, not just closing individual deals.

If you enjoy working in fast-moving environments, value thoughtful, consultative sales and want your work to contribute to real-world change, we are happy to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline, from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. We are looking at success measures activation of partners and sourced revenue via partnerships.

  • Research, structure, carry-out and review a partnership strategy to engage qualified and new market segments. Understand and communicate successes, risks, and mitigations transparent to management through optimized reporting and utilization of our CRM.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to understand prospective client needs, decision criteria and internal stakeholder dynamics to present offerings that position Klim as a strategic solution provider for clients’ sustainability, ESG and climate strategies.

  • Identify, evaluate and onboard marketplace partners and distribution channels (e.g. sustainability platforms, brokers, consultancies, ESG solution providers) that can scale Klim's reach into new buyer segments.

  • Lead joint business planning conversations with partners to align on value propositions, go-to-market approaches, integration requirements and shared success metrics.

  • Design and maintain a partner enablement program, providing marketplace partners and intermediaries with the materials, training and tools needed to represent Klim's offerings effectively and compliantly.

  • Collaborate closely with finance, certification, marketing and product to ensure seamless handovers and strong client outcomes.

  • Track and monitor key sales metrics through diligent CRM maintenance, track market trends in an independent way and gather client feedback proactively to optimise individual and team sales performance.

  • Stay on top of developments in carbon markets, standards, and regulation (e.g. SBTi, Verra, CCP, CRCF) to inform conversations and sharpen positioning.

  • Represent Klim at industry events, conferences and sustainability forums to expand your network and generate new leads.

Your profile

  • Business-ready fluency in English is a must. A upper intermediate level of German (B2) is a plus.

  • At least three years of experience in a quota-carrying partnership management or sales role, with full responsibility for closing deals.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling partnership channels or marketplace relationships — from identifying and structuring agreements to activating and growing them over time.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships with partners and intermediaries, paired with strong account management skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • A proven track record of managing the full sales funnel end to end, with confidence in handling six-figure deals and maintaining strong CRM discipline, including accurate opportunity stages and clearly documented next steps.

  • General working knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (preferably MEDDPICC) and the ability to run structured pipeline reviews, clearly articulating blockers, risks and decision paths across multiple active opportunities.

  • Experience drafting, tailoring and optimising presentations and other materials for client-facing and internal use; advanced proficiency with Google Workspace or comparable tools is required.

  • A collaborative, people-oriented mindset: you enjoy working closely with colleagues across teams and contributing to a positive, mission-driven culture.

  • Motivation to contribute to Klim’s mission of accelerating the transition to regenerative agriculture, and a belief that commercial excellence is a key lever for real-world impact.

  • A plus: experience in carbon markets and environmental policy, including voluntary carbon markets, pricing dynamics, and relevant standards and frameworks.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: We offer an attractive base salary plus uncapped commission on partner-sourced revenue. Commission is structured around partner activation and revenue growth, rewarding you for building a channel that performs at scale.

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Additional benefits for full time, Germany based employees: We offer membership in the Urban Sports Club or subsidisation of the Deutschlandticket, contribution to a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points (any of the following):

  • You have experience with Mixture-of-Experts models, expert parallelism, or sparse model inference
  • You are familiar with GPU communication libraries such as NCCL or NVSHMEM, and with compute/communication overlap
  • You have experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or similar kernel frameworks
  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have built GPU-intensive systems in graphics, rendering, simulation, or scientific computing
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or systems infrastructure projects

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Senior Analyst (Fraud & Financial Crime)
descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We’re looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Fraud & Financial Crime Analytics team at Zopa.

You’ll use your analytical skills and hands-on SQL experience to help protect our customers and the bank from fraud and financial crime, while making sure genuine customers experience as little friction as possible. Your initial focus will be on card transactions and related events, including card tokens and account takeover.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll own the analysis, implementation and ongoing performance of our controls. You’ll work with large datasets, identify emerging risks and use your findings to design and improve the rules and models that help keep our customers safe.

You don’t need to have worked in fraud or financial crime before. We’re looking for a strong analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, is curious about how things work and wants to build expertise in this area.

Why this role matters

Fraud and financial crime are constantly evolving, and so are the products and services we offer our customers. To grow safely, we need controls that can identify and prevent harm while allowing genuine customers to use their accounts with confidence.

We want to build the next generation of fraud and financial crime controls, using modern data, technology and AI to stay ahead of emerging threats and make our detection as effective as it can be.

You’ll be embedded in one of our product squads as part of the wider Fraud & Financial Crime Analytics team, working alongside Fraud Risk, Operations, Data Science, Engineering and Product. Together, you’ll help shape, build and continuously improve the controls that protect our customers.

This is one of the most impactful analytics roles in the business. In the same day, you could be triaging a new fraud risk, designing the controls to stop it and protecting our customers from harm.

This is an opportunity to bring your own ideas, shape how we solve problems and make a visible impact on both our customers and the business.


A day in the life

  • Own and improve controls:Analyse, implement, test and optimise rules and other controls that prevent and detect fraud and financial crime.

  • Investigate emerging risks: Use data to identify suspicious patterns, understand changing threats and recommend practical ways to respond.

  • Measure what matters:Monitor detection, losses, false positives and alert volumes to understand control performance and identify opportunities to improve.

  • Test and learn:Develop hypotheses and evaluate new approaches, balancing improvements in detection with the impact on genuine customers and Operations.

  • Build the next generation of controls: Work with Data Science, Product and Engineering to explore how new data, models, AI and automation can improve our detection and how we work.

  • Support change:Help implement and monitor model-led controls, and test and migrate controls as our platforms evolve.

  • Shape your priorities:Work with the squad to identify and prioritise opportunities, influence decisions and share your knowledge with others.


    • About you

  • Strong analytical experience and advanced SQL skills, including the ability to work confidently with large, complex datasets.

  • Experience using Python for analysis, or the ability and willingness to develop those skills.

  • A track record of owning complex analytical problems from initial question through to a clear recommendation or implemented change.

  • The ability to take an open-ended problem, work out where to start and turn it into a clear analytical approach.

  • Experience using data to assess performance, identify opportunities and make decisions.

  • An understanding of basic machine learning concepts and performance metrics, such as precision and recall, or exposure to using them to assess controls.

  • Sound judgement and the ability to balance analytical rigour with the need to make timely decisions.

  • The ability to tell a clear story with data and use your insights to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with people across different teams and levels of seniority.

  • Curiosity about new tools and an interest in using AI and automation to improve how you work and the controls you build.

    • It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk analytics or another controls-focused environment.

  • Experience analysing card transactions, payments or customer behaviour.

  • Stronger experience working with machine learning models, including evaluating, implementing or monitoring their performance.

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude to support analysis, coding or automation.

  • Exposure to decisioning systems, rule-based controls or experimentation.

  • Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau.

  • Experience in financial services, fintech or another fast-moving, product-led environment.


    • Interview stages

    1. Recruiter screening — 30 minutes: A conversation about your experience, motivations and interest in the role.

    1. SQL technical assessment — 1 hour: An opportunity to demonstrate how you write clear, accurate SQL.

    1. Analytics case study — 1 hour: A discussion about how you approach an analytical problem from end to end. No prior fraud or financial crime experience is required.

    1. Final interview — 1 hour, in the office: A conversation about collaboration, decision-making, your experience and Zopa’s values.

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.


Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter.


AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling.

  • Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review.

  • Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis.

  • Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it remains readable, testable, maintainable, and suitable for new product requirements.

Quality, Reliability, and Operations

  • Write automated tests at the appropriate level and integrate them into CI/CD so changes can be released with clear evidence of quality.

  • Instrument services with logs, metrics, traces, and alerts that make production behaviour and failures easy to understand.

  • Diagnose and resolve production incidents across services, databases, queues, integrations, and infrastructure.

  • Design for security, resilience, performance, and data integrity across business-critical workflows.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Partner with product managers, frontend engineers, and quality engineers to turn agreed product behaviour into implementation-ready technical solution designs covering assumptions, alternatives, service interactions, data and schema changes, failure modes, security, observability, rollout, rollback, and tests.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, review, and document code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Break specifications into small, reviewable changes and validate each change against its intended behaviour before release.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable patterns, review checklists, examples, and concise documentation.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers from problem framing through release and production operation.

  • Surface technical risks and trade-offs early, and propose pragmatic changes to scope, design, or delivery plans.

  • Review code and technical designs, setting a high bar while giving feedback that helps other engineers improve.

  • Coach mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, debugging, and design discussion.

Requirements

  • Expert-level Python and Django, with strong object-oriented design and software engineering fundamentals.

  • Strong command of API design, service-oriented architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing.

  • Expert-level relational data modelling, including the ability to produce clear ERDs, define entities, relationships, constraints, and ownership, and design PostgreSQL schemas that balance correctness, performance, and safe evolution.

  • Demonstrable ability to turn incomplete product requirements into clear technical solution designs for complex backend changes, identifying assumptions and resolving ambiguity with product and engineering colleagues through concise written analysis and appropriate architecture, sequence, data-flow, and entity-relationship diagrams.

  • Sound judgement around automated testing, observability, production reliability, security, and data integrity.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Demonstrable ability to review technical designs and code, explain trade-offs, and coach less-experienced engineers.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and delivery risks in plain English.

  • Pragmatic delivery judgement, balancing immediate product needs with the maintainability and scalability of a long-lived platform.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial commercial experience in Python and Django.

  • Experience building and operating Django-based services in production on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Django REST Framework or FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Track record of designing and safely evolving complex relational data models in a large, long-lived production codebase, using ERDs and written technical designs to align engineers and stakeholders while preserving design quality, testability, maintainability, and safe evolution.

  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams with shared ownership of customer outcomes and production operation.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored dinners and social gatherings

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents
descriptionHtml:
Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents

Sage AI Labs · Berlin · Full-time · [Remote]

About us

Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of.

The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the role

We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them.

You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO.

What you'll own

Our checkout agents. Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic.

Ingestion at scale. Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself.

Search and ranking. Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python

  • You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident

  • You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you

  • You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build

  • You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does

Nice to have

  • Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype

  • Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API

  • Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure

Why this role

Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.

title: Senior CAE and AI Expert
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Neural Concept accelerates the full engineering simulation cycle. Our AI platform compresses the time from design change to validated result, so engineering teams can explore more, iterate faster, and ship better products. The Vertical Solutions team turns that capability into production-grade, domain-specific solutions for our customers.

As a Senior CAE and AI Expert, you will own the simulation workflows, benchmarks, and solution assets that sit at the heart of what we deliver. Your work will land directly inside the engineering processes of leading automotive OEMs and consumer electronics companies — accelerating the entire cycle from geometry change through to crash, safety, and drop test results.

What You Will Do

  • Own vertical solution assets end-to-end. Design and develop simulation workflows, validation benchmarks, and solution templates for automotive structural analysis (crash, occupant safety, pedestrian safety) and consumer electronics durability (drop test, vibration). Take assets from concept through to handover to Sales and Customer Success.

  • Accelerate the full simulation pipeline. Map the complete cycle — design change, automated meshing, solver configuration, job execution, and design optimisation — onto Neural Concept's platform. Define accuracy and speed requirements, validate against benchmark data, and deliver repeatable, production-grade workflows using tools such as ABAQUS, LS-Dyna, Radioss, Hypermesh, ANSA, and Simlab.

  • Write Python automation and tooling. Script data preprocessing, solution packaging, and workflow integration. Maintain solution reproducibility standards and contribute to internal tooling libraries.

  • Drive the product roadmap from the field. Partner with Product and Engineering to surface simulation-specific platform requirements, validate new capabilities, and feed real-world use cases directly into development priorities.

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years of hands-on FEA simulation experience, in the application of vehicle crash, drop test, pedestrian and/or passenger safety, delivering production-quality models in automotive or consumer electronics environments

  • Deep expertise in leading Mechanical pre-solve-post tools, such as: ABAQUS, LS-Dyna, Radioss, Hypermesh, Simlab, ANSA, Meta, d3plot

  • Strong command of structural non-linear simulation: implicit/explicit solvers, contact formulations, material models, failure criteria

title: Senior Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Content Manager

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

We're reshaping how we plan and create content at Phrase. A new Content Working Group brings together demand generation, SEO and AI search, paid media, marketing ops, localization and creative under one strategic umbrella. The ambition is clear: every piece of content earns its place, engages in its own right and reflects the quality of the platform we build.

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager to sit at the centre of this. Someone who thinks editorially, obsesses over audience and brings the creative confidence to raise the bar across everything we publish. You'll own content strategy and planning, develop and maintain our content calendar, brief and manage writers, coordinate our design studio, and work alongside specialists in paid, organic, demand gen and localization who are collectively invested in the work. You'll also be working with the people building our product (genuine thought leaders in AI and language technology) and with external experts in the field, turning deep knowledge into stories that resonate.

This is a chance to shape a content function at a company that takes content seriously, in an industry going through one of its most fascinating periods of change.

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Own the content strategy across the full marketing funnel, working within the Content Working Group to shape quarterly plans, balance priorities and ensure every asset has a clear audience, purpose and measurable goal.

  • Develop and maintain the content calendar to keep a consistent, strategically aligned publishing rhythm across channels and funnel stages.

  • Write, commission and edit content across formats: blog posts, reports, video scripts, campaign narratives, case studies, ebooks, email sequences. You'll write well, and edit even better. For high-value pieces (original research, designed reports, narrative campaigns), you'll commission and manage specialist contributors and agencies to deliver work that genuinely stands out.

  • Apply our editorial approach. We want content that people genuinely want to read, watch and share. Content built on original insight, sharp storytelling and distinctive points of view. You'll champion this standard across the team and help inspire others to aim higher.

  • Compile and present content strategy and plans with confidence and conviction, whether to the Content Working Group, senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Coordinate the design studio. Two designers support content production, campaigns, reports and communications. You'll plan and prioritise their workload, keeping jobs moving and ensuring the right work gets the right attention at the right time. Think studio manager: organised, clear, good at keeping plates spinning.

  • Harness AI with intention. Phrase has developed a three-tier content model (Gold, Silver, Bronze) that determines how much human creative investment each piece needs. You'll apply this framework, using AI tools where they accelerate production and protecting the space for original, human-led thinking where it matters most.

  • Fly the flag for content. You'll be the person who pushes for great work, brings energy to the process and motivates the people around you to produce their best. Content touches every part of marketing at Phrase, and we need someone who promotes its value, celebrates what's working and holds the standard when it counts.

  • Track what's working. With support from Marketing Operations, use data and analytics to inform what we create next and to demonstrate content's influence on pipeline and business outcomes.

  • Manage the content budget, allocating resources across writing, design and production.

What you need:

  • 6-10 years in content marketing, editorial or content strategy, with meaningful experience in B2B technology or SaaS.

  • A strong portfolio that shows range: editorial flair, strategic thinking and the ability to shift between a thought leadership piece, a technically grounded blog post and a campaign narrative.

  • Sharp editorial judgement. You know when something is good enough and when it could be better, and you have the skill and the tact to close that gap.

  • Experience managing writers, freelancers or agencies, with a track record of getting strong work out of the people you brief.

  • Confidence with AI content tools. Phrase is an AI company and we expect fluency, not just familiarity.

  • A working knowledge of SEO and genuine curiosity about how AI search is reshaping content discoverability. Comfortable with analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics, Semrush) and able to draw insight from performance data.

  • Excellent project management instincts. You can juggle multiple workstreams, keep deadlines honest and stay calm when priorities shift.

  • The ability to coordinate creative resources, keep projects on track and manage competing priorities without losing your composure.

  • Energy! You bring momentum to the teams you work with. You push for great work because you care about it, and that's infectious.

Helpful extras:

  • Experience in localization, language technology or translation. (This isn't essential, but it gives you a head start.)

  • A background in journalism, editorial or publishing.

  • Familiarity with video content production, from scripting to briefing agencies.

  • Experience with HubSpot, WordPress or similar platforms.

Why this role is worth your attention

title: Senior Customer Service Leader

Samen met accountmanagers, architecten, projectmanagers en beheerteams bouw je aan sterke klantrelaties, optimale dienstverlening en nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je houdt de regie, stuurt op resultaat en zorgt dat we onze klanten blijvend toegevoegde waarde bieden.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Klaar om het verschil te maken?

descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Senior Digital Activation Executive at LOOKFANTASTIC? 

The Senior Digital Activation Executive role sits within THG Beauty's Retail Media structure, working closely with brand marketing leads, buying, trading, performance marketing and creative teams to deliver impactful, brand-funded media campaigns.

This is a hands-on digital activation role, combining platform expertise, campaign execution and performance analysis with brand-facing relationship management. You'll play a key role in bringing media plans to life across platforms such as Meta and TikTok, monitoring performance, making data-led optimisations and reporting on campaign success.

You'll act as an external-facing LOOKFANTASTIC ambassador and media specialist, building relationships with our brand partners and helping them maximise their investment through effective digital activation.

As a Senior Digital Activation Executive, you'll:

  • Build strong relationships with LOOKFANTASTIC's key brand partners, understanding their objectives and developing data-driven paid media strategies to drive brand growth.
  • Develop, pitch and activate multi-platform digital media plans across relevant paid social and digital advertising channels.
  • Take hands-on ownership of campaign activation across platforms, including Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, managing campaign set-up, implementation and ongoing performance.
  • Monitor live campaign performance, proactively identifying opportunities to optimise targeting, creative, budgets and delivery against agreed KPIs and ROI targets.
  • Own mid-campaign and post-campaign reporting, analysing performance data, identifying key insights and demonstrating campaign uplift and return on investment.
  • Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for brand partners, helping shape future media strategies and secure incremental investment.
  • Work collaboratively with our influencer team to commission high-quality influencer assets for paid media repurposing.
  • Support social-first creative and ad copy development, briefing our in-house creative team to deliver engaging, high-performing assets.
  • Work closely with wider marketing, e-commerce, buying and trading teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with wider commercial objectives.
  • Keep up to date with emerging digital platforms, advertising features and industry trends, bringing new ideas and opportunities to improve campaign performance.

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

  • 2+ years' experience in paid media, digital marketing or digital campaign activation.
  • Hands-on experience with paid media platforms, ideally Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, with confidence setting up, managing and optimising campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data, monitor KPIs and produce meaningful performance reports.
  • A commercial mindset, understanding how to use media investment effectively to drive performance, growth and ROI.
  • Confidence working with campaign budgets, targeting, creative testing and optimisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently present campaign recommendations to external brand partners.
  • A proactive, digitally savvy individual who naturally keeps up with emerging platforms, social trends and developments in the paid media landscape.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
  • A passion for beauty, e-commerce and the evolving retail media industry.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave

  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 

  • On-site staff shop.
     
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

descriptionHtml:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.
