title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Weekly office requirement: Hybrid: Minimum 2 days a week 
Employment type: Permanent
At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a Senior Account Executive to play a key role in our Enterprise team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.

Sounds great, what will I be doing?

As our Senior Account Executive you’ll be reporting into the Director of Enterprise. Your primary focus will be to identify and sell our suite of products and services to enterprise organizations who are on a mission to understand their ever changing audiences and optimize their GTM strategy. GWI is on a mission to become the default human insight layer for AI systems to give decision makers in the world’s largest companies certainty. 


A few things you’ll be responsible for:

👉 Go high-and-wide within enterprise organizations to understand the full scope of the opportunity 👉 Work cross-functionally with our marketing, custom and strategic insights, solutions partners and product teams to deliver outstanding results 👉 Lead the entire new business sales cycle from initial opportunity creation to close 👉 Partner closely with your assigned Sales Development Representative (SDR) to strategize and execute on your outbound prospecting plan 👉 Establish and build credibility with your prospects from the outset. You’ll form a unique understanding of business challenges and present needs-based solutions that meet their business objectives! 👉 Track all sales activity, manage all sales opportunities and accurately forecast revenue achievement via Salesforce 👉 Develop your own territory plan and a pipeline that will fuel the ongoing growth of your business enabling you to exceed your quarterly and annual sales quota   It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.

🧳 What do I need to bring with me? 🧳

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:


✔️ Follow MEDD(P)ICC sales methodology to qualify opportunities and progress deals through the pipeline ✔️ Experience of API based solutions ✔️ Proficient in leveraging AI tools to enhance day-to-day sales workflows, uncover insights, and create compelling client presentations and commercial materials ✔️ Sold to Enterprise sized clients (50k headcount and above) ✔️ Experience consistently closing deals >$100k ACV ✔️ Proven track-record of consistently meeting or over-achieving sales quotas ✔️ You are someone who takes ownership of their pipeline. Able to both execute your outbound strategy in collaboration with your SDR partner and with Marketing to close inbound leads.   Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.

Why GWI?

GWI is the human data layer that fuels decision-making and AI agents across the enterprise. In the age of AI, the way businesses consume insight is changing. Traditional research is no longer enough to keep up in a world of AI, automation, and agentic workflows. Our customers need insight, not just a platform, embedded directly into the tools and workflows they use every day. GWI has been at the forefront of this shift, through the launch of Agent Spark and by empowering decision makers to move with clarity, speed, and precision, grounding every action in real human understanding. GWI's mission remains the same: to help humans everywhere understand each other.

🧘 What We Offer 🧘

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

🌱 Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays. 🌱 Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support. 🌱 Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success. 🌱 Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget. 🌱 Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility. 🌱 Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.

Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.

🫶 Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—both as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to ensure our workforce is as diverse and inclusive as the insights we provide to our clients.

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to providing all necessary adjustments during the hiring process. We also actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalized communities.

At GWI, you will find a place where you can contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

title: Senior Field Performance Partner, AI
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The GTM Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across EMEA to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust.

You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in a B2B technology GTM organization across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, BDR, Enablement, frontline leadership, or a combination of these roles.

  • Experience working in a channel or partner-led GTM environment, with practical knowledge of selling with and through partners such as resellers, MSPs, distributors, and other channel partners, including partner engagement, account mapping, co-selling, and partner-led growth.

  • Experience carrying a quota, leading a frontline GTM team, or directly coaching customer-facing teams strongly preferred.

  • Strong business and analytical acumen, with demonstrated ability to diagnose performance problems, identify root causes, and turn insights into practical, measurable plans that improve skills, behaviors, and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of how to apply sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC in coaching, enablement, or field execution.

  • Credibility with frontline GTM leaders and sellers, built through curiosity, thoughtful discovery, and sound judgment, with the ability to operate independently as a coach, advisor, and constructive challenger.

  • High curiosity and fluency with AI, with experience using AI, automation, dashboards, and performance signals to make coaching more individualized, scalable, and measurable.

  • Understanding of how selling practices and customer needs vary across EMEA markets; additional language skills are helpful.

  • A bias toward action, experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

What you can expect:

  • Own the performance improvement cycle for the frontline managers and teams you support: diagnose, prescribe, activate, reinforce, measure, and adjust.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with managers, bringing data-informed insights and recommendations about where their coaching can have the greatest impact.

  • Combine business results, behavioral data, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify performance gaps and create focused development plans.

  • Create strategic enablement plans that address root causes and become part of the team’s day-to-day work.

  • Use AI-powered role-play, practice, feedback loops, manager coaching, live learning, and tools such as Hyperbound to support individualized development at scale.

  • Help managers reinforce key skills, products, messaging, partner motions, and GTM priorities through ongoing coaching and team practice.

  • Partner across Technical Enablement, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Engineering, and other teams to bring the right resources into identified performance challenges.

  • Facilitate workshops, webinars, and other learning experiences when appropriate, while enabling managers to lead reinforcement with their teams.

  • Measure whether interventions are changing behavior and improving outcomes, and share recurring performance patterns and field feedback with cross-functional partners.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £78,000 GBP and £113,000 GBP. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. title: Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Flight Dynamics team at STARK is dedicated to developing high-fidelity simulation models for our autonomous aerial systems. We work closely with the Flight Control team as well as program engineering teams across various projects.

YOUR MISSION

As Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer, you will own the evolution of our simulation model architecture and flight dynamics models to maximize simulation fidelity. You will analyze flight test data for system identification, build programs to replicate product–environment interactions, and mentor team members in model development best practices.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Develop and refine flight dynamics models to improve simulation accuracy and performance.
  • Analyze flight test data to perform system identification and validate model behavior.
  • Define and evolve the overall model architecture within the simulation environment.
  • Coach and mentor team members working alongside you on model development.
  • Investigate and resolve engineering challenges related to simulation performance and model fidelity.
  • Build and maintain simulation programs to replicate product–environment interactions without real-world testing.
  • Develop models primarily in MATLAB/Simulink, with integration of C++ where required.
  • Collaborate closely with the Flight control team and program engineering teams to support simulation-related needs across projects.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering or similar relevant areas of expertise.
  • 6+ years of experience in similar positions.
  • Proven experience in dynamic systems modeling and aircraft simulation.
  • Strong proficiency in MATLAB and Simulink.
  • Expertise in data analysis and system identification, extracting system behavior and parameters from test data.
  • Demonstrated contribution to projects that reached a tested or operational stage.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is considered a plus).

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with deployment and integration of simulation models (CI/CD).
  • Programming skills (e.g., C, Python, or other languages) for task automation and model enhancement.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills to communicate complex technical insights clearly.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

This is a hands-on technical role within Staffbase Build, responsible for turning specific enterprise customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions of the Staffbase platform, using its extensibility capabilities (widgets, plugins, integrations, and other platform objects). The role owns assigned customer solutions end-to-end, defining the use case with stakeholders, building and testing across the stack, deploying it, and validating it with users.

The aim is to drive adoption and stickiness of the platform, not to create one-off, standalone customer solutions. The role acts as a bridge, helping customers do what they and the platform can't do alone yet, and feeds what's learned back into shared standards and the product roadmap.

The role reports into the regional Build Leader.

What you’ll be doing

Solution Delivery

  • Owning the technical design, implementation, testing, and release of assigned custom solutions end-to-end
  • Building across the stack (customer-facing UI, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third-party APIs)

Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partnering with customers, consultants and internal teams, e.g. Sales, to define and detail use cases before development. Supporting pre-sales in a technical advisory capacity, primarily during requirements discovery: join customer and Sales conversations to clarify needs, assess technical feasibility, and help scope custom solutions
  • Validating shipped solutions with users and gathering feedback afterward
  • Supporting customers in building basic solutions themselves using Staffbase-provided platform tools where appropriate, rather than defaulting to a fully bespoke build

Platform-First Engineering

  • Keeping up to date with new and evolving platform capabilities (new extensibility primitives, APIs, and platform objects) so solutions are built using the latest native capabilities rather than defaulting to more bespoke patterns
  • Applying the company's architectural, security, and compliance standards so solutions remain supportable

Pattern Capture & Product Feedback

  • Identifying reusable patterns and components arising from customer engagements; documenting and contributing them to a shared Build asset catalogue
  • Surfacing recurring, validated customer needs for consideration in the product roadmap

title: Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Leadership & AI Enablement Consultant (w/d/m)
descriptionHtml:
Führungskräfte sollen entscheiden, wo AI in ihrem Bereich hilft. Viele können nicht einschätzen, ob ein Prozess RPA, generative AI oder einen Agenten braucht und ob die Daten reichen. Mit dir lernen sie das an einem eigenen Use Case, den sie über mehrere Wochen bearbeiten.

WE BUILD AI ist eine AI-Beratung mit eigenem Engineering in Köln. Wir sind rund zehn Leute und arbeiten mit Mittelstand und Konzernen. Uns geht es um AI, die in Prozessen und in der Wertschöpfung wirkt.

Deine Rolle

Gemeinsam mit einer Partnerberatung für Führung und Change bauen wir gerade ein Programm für Führungskräfte im Konzernumfeld auf. Es verbindet Präsenzblöcke, eine Praxisphase am eigenen Use Case und Coaching über mehrere Wochen. Du leitest Präsenzblöcke allein und deckst dabei Führung, Technologie, Prozesse und Daten ab, immer aus Sicht der Führungskraft. Dafür bist du etwa einmal im Monat für zwei Tage vor Ort, in NRW und Norddeutschland.

Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du in unserem Trainingsbereich, den wir gerade ausbauen. Dort gibst du Trainings und Workshops bei weiteren Kund:innen und sammelst Use Cases für unsere Discovery Sprints. Deine Arbeit wirkt, wenn Use Cases nach dem Training weiterlaufen und Projekte daraus entstehen.

Aufgaben

  • Du leitest Präsenzblöcke von zwei Tagen allein und führst die Gruppe von der eigenen Rolle bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage.

  • Technologie erklärst du so, dass Führungskräfte einordnen können, was RPA, klassische AI, generative AI und Agents leisten.

  • Mit Design Thinking und Service Design führst du die Teilnehmenden vom Pain Point zum priorisierten Use Case.

  • In der Praxisphase coachst du die Gruppe remote und gibst Feedback auf Problemdefinition, Datenlage und erste Lösungsideen.

  • Übergaben und Trainingsdesign stimmst du eng mit den Trainer:innen der Partnerberatung ab.

  • Die Inhalte prüfst du jedes Quartal und passt Beispiele und Übungen an neue Entwicklungen an.

  • Außerhalb des Programms gibst du Trainings und Workshops und bringst vielversprechende Use Cases in Discovery Sprints.

  • Formate, Methoden und Vorlagen für unseren Trainingsbereich baust du mit auf.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Trainings oder Workshops für Führungskräfte gegeben, gern auch mehrtägige Formate.

  • Eine Gruppe aus Abteilungs- und Bereichsleitungen hältst du zwei Tage allein bei der Sache, auch bei kritischen Rückfragen.

  • AI nutzt du selbst jeden Tag. Wie Sprachmodelle und Agents funktionieren und wo ihre Grenzen liegen, kannst du einfach erklären.

  • Design Thinking, Service Design oder Prozessanalyse hast du in echten Projekten eingesetzt.

  • Bei Daten bleibst du skeptisch und erkennst, wann ein Dashboard eine Entscheidung trägt.

  • Erfahrung mit großen Organisationen hilft, etwa mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und AI Act.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus Beratung, Learning & Development, Organisationsentwicklung oder Change Management.

  • Reisen gehört für dich dazu, und Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher.

Was wir bieten

  • Remote-Arbeit mit regelmäßigen Teamtagen in unserem Büro in Köln-Ehrenfeld, wo Getränke, Snacks und Bürohunde warten.

  • Ein Trainingsbereich, der gerade entsteht und den du von Anfang an mitgestaltest.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Mentoring und ehrliches Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.

  • Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket.

  • Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive.

  • Teamevents und gemeinsame Workations.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Kennenlern-Call mit Mounir und Frederic, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns und schauen, ob die Grundlage stimmt.

  2. Probesequenz im Call, 45 bis 60 Minuten. Du bereitest eine Trainingseinheit für Führungskräfte vor und führst sie mit uns durch.

  3. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblicken in unsere Projekte und Sparring mit dem Team.

title: Senior Lease Administration Analyst
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Role

CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.

You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.
  • Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.
  • Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.
  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.
  • Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.
  • Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.
  • Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.
  • Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.
  • Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.
  • Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.
  • Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.
  • Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.
  • Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.
  • Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.
  • Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.
  • Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.
  • Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.

Preferred:

  • Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.
  • Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.
  • Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.
  • Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.
  • You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, GPU Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a ML Engineer in GPU Optimization, you will own how fast and how reliably our structure models train. Every hour cut from a training run is another experiment our researchers can run; a near-term goal is a 1.5x speedup on our structure model, with long runs finishing without interruption.

You will spend most of your time embedded with a research team (such as pre-training, post-training or biologics), working side by side with research scientists, and the rest with Research Engineering on tools shared across teams. You'll also work with Platform Engineering, who own GPU orchestration across Boltz.

This role is ideal for an engineer who loves profiling, can look at a GPU utilization or loss curve and know where to start digging, and wants their speedups to show up in better science.

What you'll do

  • Speed up large-scale training of our structure models, finding and removing bottlenecks in kernels, memory, communication, data loading and parallelism.

  • Write and tune custom GPU kernels where they pay off (e.g. Triton or CUDA), and get the most from each new GPU generation.

  • Make long training runs complete without interruption: diagnose failures and degraded runs from throughput, utilization and loss signals, and fix the root cause.

  • Build reusable profiling and optimization tooling, including agent-assisted, profile-guided optimization, so speedups carry across teams.

  • Feed what you learn about performance back into how researchers design models and experiments.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience in optimizing deep learning training on multi-node GPU clusters (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron).

  • Deep GPU performance expertise: profiling (e.g. PyTorch Profiler, Nsight), memory and communication tuning, and kernel work in Triton or CUDA.

  • Strong PyTorch and Python, with enough ML intuition to judge how an engineering change affects training dynamics and results.

  • A track record of measurable speedups or reliability gains on real, large training workloads.

  • You enjoy investigating problems with researchers, rather than taking tickets.

Preferred Requirements

  • Exposure to structure prediction, diffusion models, or biology and chemistry data.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cluster operations; coding agents as a core part of your workflow.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or contributions to open-source training frameworks or kernel libraries.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Make training faster for open models used by 100,000+ scientists.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Diagnosis interview: work through a degraded training run with us (no manual coding test)

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are....

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have....

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

title: Senior Manager, Site Merchandising UK
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Site Merchandising - UK

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Site Merchandising to own the customer journey across the Quince UK site—our largest and most important market. This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and data. You’ll be responsible for how products and content come to life on the site to attract, engage, and convert customers.

Beyond optimizing the onsite experience, this role will take a leading position in SEO and organic growth, leveraging content and site merchandising tools to drive awareness, discovery, and traffic. You’ll use insights and data to ensure Quince’s unique value proposition shines through every page—from homepage to product detail.

This role will participate in shaping our growth in the UK and EU through leveraging our global tools and processes, helping improve them and developing impactful localization strategy and tactics across web and app. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Category Management, and Engineering to ensure site merchandising supports both brand and business goals.

This role requires being onsite at our London office four days a week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Quince UK website and mobile apps, ensuring a seamless and inspiring customer experience.
  • Manage and optimize merchandising tools and platforms that power product discovery, personalization, and site and app performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and Data teams to align onsite experiences with seasonal campaigns, assortment shifts, and brand priorities.
  • Partner with global teams to ensure improvements to tooling, automation, merchandising best practices can be easily adopted in the region as well as improving our key metrics.
  • Use analytics and testing to continuously improve site navigation, product placement, and content engagement.
  • Own site merchandising calendar and execution for key selling moments (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, holiday, new launches).
  • Drive best practices in product storytelling, cross-selling, and navigation to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Partner with Engineering and Data teams to implement content automation, metadata structuring, and semantic optimization that improve site crawlability and ranking in AI search results.
  • Stay ahead of evolving SEO landscapes (Google’s SGE, OpenAI’s search integrations, etc.) to ensure Quince ranks prominently in next-generation search ecosystems.

Qualifications

Required:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of experience in site merchandising, ecommerce, digital merchandising, site optimization, or growth/SEO
  • Proven track record of an end-to-end customer journey across web and app for a high-volume consumer brand.
  • Experience leading a merchandising or digital experience function for an international or multi-market business and strong localization expertise.
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using A/B testing, web analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel), and experimentation platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of SEO foundations: metadata, internal linking, site structure, schema marketup, crawlability.
  • Strong understanding of UK/EU ecommerce consumer behavior, online buying patterns, seasonal trends, and regulatory considerations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Experience leading a design-forward team that is obsessed with pixel-perfect craftsmanship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4 days onsite at our London office is required.

Preferred:

  • Personalized customer experience across multiple channels.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools.
  • Track record of success in fast-scaling, high-growth environments, ideally in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or omnichannel commerce.
  • Familiarity with search & merchandising tools (Bloomreach, Algolia).
  • Familiarity with SEO platforms (Botify, Semrush).
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO) and product analytics tools (Looker, Tableau). 
  • Excited by super-IC role with broad scope and impact.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.

As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.

Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.

You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.

Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support. 

The team and culture

You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.

As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements. 

What we’re looking for

AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.

  • At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.
  • Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.
  • Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.
  • Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.
  • Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.
  • Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents. 

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.

Unsere Ambition im Acquisition Team:

  • Das beste Media-Buying-Team in ganz Deutschland aufbauen.
  • Search, Shopping, PMax und Demand Gen auf ein neues Skalierungsniveau heben
  • Profitable Neukundenakquise mit klarer CAC-Logik, Subscription-Fokus und Full-Funnel-Denken

Dafür investieren wir massiv: in Tracking-Infrastruktur, Funnel-Architektur, Creative-Assets und Talente. Wenn du nicht nur Kampagnen verwalten, sondern als Senior im Acquisition Team aktiv einen Markt dominieren willst, lies weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Eigenständige Skalierung und strategische Steuerung unserer Google-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen / YouTube) mit klarem Fokus auf profitabler Neukundenakquise
  • Restrukturierung und Konsolidierung unserer Kampagnenarchitektur: weg von fragmentierten produktbasierten Strukturen hin zu konversionsstarken, volumenfähigen Account-Setups
  • Aufbau und Steuerung skalierbarer Demand-Gen- und YouTube-Strategien, um Top-of-Funnel-Reichweite gezielt in Mid-Funnel-Conversion zu überführen
  • Ownership über Tracking und Measurement: saubere Conversion-Architektur in Google Ads, GA4 und Google Tag Manager als Pflichtdisziplin, nicht als Nice-to-have
  • Leidenschaftliche Analyse des gesamten Funnels vom ersten Search-Klick über Advertorial und Landing Page bis zum Checkout, und Identifikation konkreter Optimierungshebel (Match Types, Bidding, Angles, Offer, LP-Varianten, Trust-Elemente)
  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Funnel-Architektur mit unterschiedlichen Advertorial-Formaten (Erfahrungsberichte, Tierarzt-Inhalte, Produkt-Vergleichsseiten) und konsequenter CRO-Logik
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Direct Response Copy, Funnel Manager und CRO, um Performance-Hypothesen schnell zu testen und iterativ zu verbessern
  • Datengetriebene Steuerung anhand von CAC, LTV, ROAS und Funnel-Metriken
  • Kontinuierliche Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und US-Research, um Performance-Impulse (insbesondere im kompetitiven Subscription-Markt) frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu nutzen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Hands-on Erfahrung im Paid Search / Google Ads, davon mind. 3 Jahre im D2C-Bereich, idealerweise Supplements, Pet, Beauty oder Cosmetics
  • Tiefes technisches Verständnis von Google Ads in der Breite: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen / YouTube, Competitor Campaigns – und wie diese zusammenspielen
  • Absolute Tracking-Kompetenz: Google Ads Conversion Tracking, GA4 und Google Tag Manager sind keine Blackbox für dich – du stellst sicher, dass Daten stimmen, bevor du Entscheidungen triffst
  • Account Hygiene ist für dich nicht optional: du erkennst Fragmentierung, konsolidierst konsequent und hast ein Gefühl für Conversion-Volumen auf Kampagnen-Ebene
  • Erfahrung mit Subscription-Modellen und kompetitiven, preissensiblen Märkten – du weißt, wie man hochpreisige D2C-Produkte mit klarer Subscription-Logik profitabel skaliert
  • Funnel-Denken statt Ad-Denken: du analysierst Zahlen nicht nur, du leitest konkrete Hypothesen und Tests daraus ab – von der Keyword-Intention bis zur LP-Performance
  • Erfahrung mit Direct Response Funnels (ua. Advertorials) und dem strategischen Zusammenspiel von Paid Search und Conversion-Architektur
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

title: Senior Partner Manager - Italy, Spain and The Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.  

The opportunity

We’re looking for a Partner Account Manager to grow Algolia’s partner ecosystem across Italy, Spain and the Netherlands, with a primary focus on Italy and the Netherlands.

As part of our Global Alliances team, you’ll build strong relationships with system integrators, digital agencies and other services partners. You’ll bring partners and Algolia teams together around shared opportunities, helping customers create better digital experiences while generating pipeline and revenue.

This is an opportunity to make an impact across a diverse territory: you’ll help develop the partner ecosystem in Italy and Spain while deepening established relationships in the Netherlands. You’ll have room to shape your approach to each market, supported by a collaborative team and a shared focus on growth.

Examples of partners include Atoms, Reply, Accenture, Kega, SQLI, Ogilvy, VASS, Shopify and commercetools.

What you’ll do

  • Own a revenue quota based on the business generated by your partners across Italy, Spain and the Netherlands.
  • Develop and execute a partner strategy for Italy, Spain and the Netherlands, prioritizing the opportunities with the greatest potential for growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with key system integrators and digital agencies, from sales and marketing teams to alliances leaders and executives.
  • Create joint business plans and coordinate sales and marketing initiatives that generate qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Help partners understand Algolia’s value, build their capabilities and position our solutions with their customers.
  • Represent Algolia at partner meetings, events and other activities across the territory.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 5 years of experience in partner management, alliances, channel sales or a comparable role.
  • Experience carrying a quota, with a track record of driving pipeline and revenue through partners.
  • Experience building and growing relationships with system integrators, digital agencies or other services partners.
  • A strong ability to identify opportunities, develop joint plans and turn them into results.
  • Confidence working across sales, marketing and technical teams, both internally and within partner organizations.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to execution.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Fluency in English and Italian, both written and spoken. Additional languages, particularly Dutch or Spanish, are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across the territory

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range£108,000—£150,000 GBP

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an ----- email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.
  • We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remote
descriptionHtml:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest E-Commerce-Brands über Meta und TikTok profitabel zum Wachsen bringen? Paid Social ist bei vielen unserer Kunden der entscheidende Wachstumskanal. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn zu verantworten und auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets zu skalieren. Unser internes Team aus Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik, Video- und Landingpage-Spezialisten unterstützt dich dabei.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Mittwochmorgen. Im Business Manager laufen zwei neue Hooks deutlich über Benchmark. Du erhöhst die Budgets und briefst das Creative Team auf Iterationen der Best Performer. Daraus entsteht ein neues Set aus UGC, Founder Ads und Statics, das wenige Tage später live geht.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance, die nächsten Schritte und deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Funnel. Danach briefst du dein Team, jeder Schritt ist klar verteilt.

Drei Tage nach dem Launch steht ein Performance-Uplift von 30 %, der Account skaliert auf 3.000 € Ad Spend am Tag, profitabel bei stabilem CAC. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote ab Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Paid Social bei EVOLVE

Dass Creatives über die Performance entscheiden, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel für unsere Kunden mit. Denn Skalierung entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads, sondern auch aus dem Angebot dahinter.

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Ad verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Du arbeitest damit wie mit einem Junior an deiner Seite, von der Creative-Recherche bis zur Auswertung

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Skalierung: Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend

  • Creative: Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit dem Creative Team. Welche Hooks, Formate und Angebote gelauncht werden, entscheidest du

  • Testing: Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Denn ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohem Ad-Spend-Level nicht lange

  • Datenanalyse: Du bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten

  • Kunden: Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst Kunden ganzheitlich, nicht nur auf Kanalebene

  • Aufbau des Bereichs: Du entwickelst Social Ads weiter, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien und entscheidest, was getestet wird. Die Detailarbeit übernimmt das Team aus Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik und Video. Perspektivisch übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid-Social-Team und entwickelst dich zum Paid Social Lead.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, admetrics oder Tracify

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce und sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst die Systematik dahinter, warum ein Creative verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung, Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern. Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring mit

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR. Es geht um gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, menschlich und fachlich.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Wie lange das dauert: Wir legen Wert auf einen schnellen Bewerbungsprozess. Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Prozessen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied.

Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social-Ads-Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, mit bis zu zehn Personen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle ermöglichen es dir, dein Privatleben und den Arbeitsalltag zu vereinbaren
  • Ob sportlich oder bequem, auf alle Fälle umweltfreundlich: Bei uns kannst du ein Job-Bike leasen, ein Jobticket abschließen oder dir ein Sportangebot bezuschussen lassen
  • Frisch gekocht: Unser Agentur-Koch verzaubert uns dreimal pro Woche mit seinen frischen und leckeren Gerichten direkt aus unserer Agenturküche.
