  • Gut vorgesorgt: Mit dem Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge von 20% hast Du bei uns auch (wenn es schwerfällt) an Deine Rente gedacht.
  • Deine Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen: Daher bleiben wir im regelmäßigen Austausch, wohin Du Dich entwickeln möchtest und legen gemeinsam Schritte und Ziele für Deinen weiteren Weg fest, sodass Du Deine Potenziale optimal entfalten kannst.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

Operations is roughly half of Lendable's people. Central Ops Engineering is a small product engineering team that builds the tooling to help keep back office operations lean and efficient, while maintaining good customer outcomes.

We're hiring a senior product engineer who can own and deliver large problems in that space. You'll build the internal web apps and automations that agents use every day, and help shape how the team uses AI coding tools.

What you'll work on

Current problems include:

  • Complaints: we've already made handling much more efficient for officers, and are continuing to push on this.

  • Fraud and Fincrime: putting the signals an investigator needs into one place.

  • Quality assurance: using AI to review far more calls than a QA team can sample, and directing coaching to the agents who need it.

How we work

We use Claude Code, Codex, Augment and other AI tools every day. They've tripled our productivity, and we want you to help decide where we take that next. You'll hand real work to coding agents and take responsibility for what ships.

You'll work directly with ops agents and their managers, and with Product. Data Science and Analytics own the models and prompt engineering, and you'll build the tools that put their work in front of agents.

Who you are

  • An experienced product engineer with a strong track record of delivering practical, full-stack solutions on modern technology

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and focused on business outcomes, looking beyond the stated requirements to address the underlying problem

  • Experienced in shaping team ways of working and mentoring other engineers

  • Enthusiastic about AI-assisted development, ideally with a record of using it to improve how your team delivers

Our tech stack

This is what we use today, to give you a feel for the work. If your tech stack is different, we'd still like to hear from you: we've successfully onboarded engineers from different stacks in the past.

  • Backend: Python and FastAPI

  • Frontend: React, Next.js and Tailwind

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo and Terraform

  • Data: SQL & Snowflake

  • Patterns: Domain Driven Design, message-driven systems and event sourcing

Interview process

  1. Intro call with Talent (30 min).

  2. Coding exercise in your own time ([2-3 hours max]). It's a small internal-tool problem, and you should use AI tools as you normally would.

  3. Technical interview (60 min). You'll walk us through your exercise, then we'll change the requirements and extend it together.

  4. Culture and behavioural interview (60 min), with time for your questions.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Who You Are

We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager to own our Identity Graph / Enrichment & Audience Enhancement products. You will lead an already established Identity & Audience team to grow Verve's presence in the AdTech space through the innovative execution of key strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will participate in the development of the product strategy and product roadmaps, leading product initiatives end-to-end from ideation to launch and go-to-market. They will inform product requirements, collaborate with engineering on implementation, take products to market through extensive A/B testing & experimentation, and be responsible for commercial success.

What You Will Do

  • Grow our Identity Graph / Enrichment & Audience Enhancement products' impact based on the data-driven insights that shape your roadmap
  • Ensure the product increments we build are aligned with the overall strategy and product vision
  • Own and lead product development end-to-end from discovery to launch to iteration
  • Come up with hypotheses, run experiments, and holdout tests to quantify the incremental value of identity and audience features.
  • Collaborate daily with engineering, data, and product teams
  • Keep building the knowledge of the market landscape, including the needs of publishers, advertisers, and DSPs
  • Handle communication with internal/external stakeholders & partners 
  • Understand and map out cross-product dependencies with the other business units 
  • Set and monitor product KPIs to make sure the initiatives are driving product & business success

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product management roles, at least 2+ years of product management experience in the AdTech industry
  • Problem solver - You can capture business problems, come up with solutions, and write good product requirement documents to keep everyone aligned on the scope
  • Technically skilled - You have a good understanding of databases, data structures, and how software systems can be integrated and exchange data with each other
  • Self-starter & self-motivator - you don’t wait to be told what needs to be done; you take full ownership of product initiatives
  • Collaborator & communicator - you can gather tech and business stakeholders across functions & levels around you to work towards a common goal, speaking their language
  • Achiever - You focus on outcomes & prefer to have something done rather than have it perfect; you value an iterative process
  • Data-driven - you value the power of data and can perform data analysis to make decisions / assess results based on metrics

What We Offer

Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: 

  • Recharge with 3 Wellness Days throughout the year, in addition to your annual vacation and public holidays
  • Support your mental well-being with our Workplace Mental Health Solution
  • Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes
  • Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)
  • … and even more reasons to join us!

Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Position Bei Lanes & Planes ist kein Tag wie der andere. Dein Fokus: Als Senior Product Manager verantwortest du mehrere große Produktthemen pro Quartal, von der Discovery bis zum messbaren Impact. Du verstehst Probleme erst tiefgehend, bevor du Lösungen baust, und zwar zunehmend selbst mit AI-Agenten, abgestimmt mit unseren Tech Leads. Du hältst Stakeholder aligned, steuerst komplexe Rollouts und belegst deinen Erfolg in Zahlen. Wenig Meetings, viel Fokuszeit.   Dein Arbeitsalltag
  • Du verantwortest mehrere größere Produktthemen pro Quartal, von der Discovery über die Delivery bis zu Adoption und messbarem Impact.
  • Du verstehst die Probleme unserer Kunden tiefgehend, gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Data, bevor du Lösungen baust.
  • Du entwickelst Lösungen zunehmend selbst mit AI-Agenten, vom Prototyp bis zu produktionsnahem Code, und stimmst Architektur, Qualität und Priorisierung mit unseren Tech Leads ab.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Bereich selbst und hältst Stakeholder aus Finance, Customer Service und Engineering aligned.
  • Du steuerst Rollouts kontrolliert, gerade bei Supplier-Integrationen wie Hotelaggregatoren, und misst den Erfolg nach dem Launch.
  • Du gestaltest den Wandel zu AI-first Development und unsere Priorisierung über Shape Up (Pitches, Betting Table) aktiv mit.
  • Wir arbeiten schriftlich und asynchron: wenig Meetings, viel Zeit für Discovery und Fokusarbeit. 
Dein Profil
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management.
  • Erfahrung mit komplexen, prozesslastigen B2B-Produkten, idealerweise in Fintech, Travel, Logistik oder SaaS mit Billing und Invoicing.
  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Ownership: Discovery, Business Case, Implementation, Launch.
  • Du triffst datengetriebene Entscheidungen und belegst sie mit Zahlen.
  • Du arbeitest Lean und hypothesengetrieben.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools heute schon aktiv, für Prototyping, Analyse oder Code, und willst damit Produkte bauen, nicht nur Specs schreiben.
  • Technisches Verständnis für APIs und Datenmodelle; du kannst von AI erzeugten Code einordnen und prüfen.
  • Unternehmerischer Drive, hohe Eigenständigkeit, fließend Deutsch und Englisch.
Deine Vorteile bei uns

Du hast Lust zu uns ins Lanes & Planes Cockpit einzusteigen und als Lanie abzuheben? Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle:

  • 50% Office und 50% Home Office
  • Bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr kannst du mobil aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • Du bekommst eine neue IT-Ausstattung, inkl. MacBook, Tastatur und Maus, von uns gestellt.

Urlaub & Benefits:

  • Genieße 28 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die sich automatisch in Intervallen steigern (bis max. 30 Tage).
  • Du erhältst 10% Rabatt auf private Reisen, die du über die L&P-Plattform buchst.
  • Du bekommst eine DRV-Karte, die dir viele ermäßigte Freizeitangebote bietet (nach der Probezeit).
  • Zusätzlich erhältst du einen 30€ Zuschuss für ein Benefit deiner Wahl: Deutschlandticket, Wellpass, Jobrad, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge (nach der Probezeit).

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest:

  • Wir fördern eine offene Feedback-Kultur. Dafür haben wir u.a. zwei fest etablierte Feedback-Gespräche pro Jahr, in denen wir Feedback austauschen und deine individuellen Weiterentwicklungsperspektiven besprechen.
  • Unsere Teams verbringen einmal im Jahr eine Workation zusammen, um noch stärker zusammenzuwachsen und gemeinsam eine gute Zeit zu haben.
  • Modernes Büro am Hirschgarten (direkt an der S-Bahn-Stammstrecke) mit Blick auf die Berge und Münchens Skyline
Über uns

Suchst du nach einer spannenden, neuen Herausforderung? Bist du ein echter Team-Player? Dann bieten wir dir eine hervorragende Gelegenheit, Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte zu werden!

Lanes & Planes ist die erste Travel und Beleg Management Lösung, die wirklich end-to-end alle Bereiche einer Dienstreise voll digital abbildet - von der Reisebuchung, bis zur Abrechnung und darüber hinaus. Eine Geschäftsreise-Plattform, die unseren Kunden dabei hilft, Zeit, Geld und Nerven zu sparen. Unser Team besteht aus talentierten und engagierten Menschen mit einer Leidenschaft für neue Technologien und dem Wunsch, Reisen im B2B Bereich einfacher und bequemer zu gestalten.

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung bei Lanes & Planes.

Dein Lanes & Planes Talent Acquisition Team!

title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
  • Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
  • Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
  • Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
  • Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

title: Senior Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities:

  1. INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  2. INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  3. INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  4. INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management).

  5. INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more).

About the program:

AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. 

You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs.

Responsibilities:

Lead program delivery end to end 

Planning and implementation

  • Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder.

  • Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews.

  • Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report.

  • Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes.

  • Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team.

  • Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together.

Monitoring and evaluation

  • Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads.

  • Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way.

  • Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice.

Budget and resources

  • Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead.

  • Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests.

  • Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal.

Manage the consortium and partners 

  • Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements.

  • Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed.

  • Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones.

  • Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO.

  • Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment.

Manage the funder and stakeholders

  • Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early.

  • Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders.

  • Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership.

  • Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches.

  • Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break.

Coordinate the team

  • Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them.

  • Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR).

  • Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you.

Support growth 

  • Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over.

  • Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs.

  • Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem.



Essential

  • At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe.

  • Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance.

  • Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments.

  • At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage.

  • Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts.

  • High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity.

Desirable

  • Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants).

  • Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements.

  • Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC.

  • A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish.

  • A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2).

  • Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

Wat bieden wij jou?

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. title: Senior Sales Engineer, Europe
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact
Dedrone, by Axon is the world’s most trusted smart airspace security company. Hundreds of commercial, government and military customers around the world rely on Dedrone’s comprehensive, command and control (C2) solution to protect against the persistent and escalating threat from drones while enabling “good” drones to fly. By leveraging AI/ML, Dedrone is the only solution that provides continuous, autonomous interrogation and verification of drones that enables both multi-sensor and multi-mitigation options onto a single fused "pane-of-glass". Whether on-premise / air-gapped or in the cloud, Dedrone customers can easily detect, track, identify, analyze, and mitigate drone threats.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Select UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team.

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.
  • Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.
  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent
  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win.
  • Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments
  • Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems
  • Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience
  • IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Senior Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate and do their best work. That’s why we’re on the Forbes Cloud 100 list and a Great Place to Work accredited company. And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners. And we need your help. Join us to build the digital economy of tomorrow.

The role

Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge payment solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan.

Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Identify the most promising merchants and prospects and grow a healthy pipeline across various verticals

  • Sell our new cross-borders payment solutions and services to eCommerce merchants through outbound and inbound techniques

  • Help new merchants evaluate Checkout.com and handle detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert

  • Prepare thorough presentations and proposals for prospective merchants

  • Orchestrate the entire Sales process and act as the main point of contact for merchants and internal stakeholders

  • Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the Role

Zable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them.

AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Alert Triage & Monitoring

  • Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team.

  • Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions.

  • Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow.

2. Incident Command & Response

  • Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents.

  • Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code.

  • Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls.

  • Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota.

3. Operational Reporting & Assurance

  • Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes.

  • Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity.

  • Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards.

  • Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP.

  • AI fluency: You understand how AI use creates security risk, including data exposure, agent misuse and AI-assisted attacks, and you can investigate and contain incidents that involve it.

  • AI-first ways of working: You already use AI and automation to speed up your own work, whether in investigation, enrichment, detection engineering or reporting, and you can judge when to trust the output and when to check it.

  • Composure and influence: You stay calm and structured under pressure, and can direct engineers and senior stakeholders without formal authority over them.

  • Communication: You can brief a senior leader in plain language during a live incident, and write a post-incident report that an engineer, an auditor and a board member can each use.

  • Pragmatism: You understand that security supports a business moving quickly, and you balance risk, speed and proportionality in your decisions.

  • Regulated environment awareness (desirable): Experience in financial services or another regulated sector, including incident reporting and evidence expectations.

  • Certifications (desirable, not required): GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or equivalent practical experience.

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with one of the talent team

  • A Hiring Manager call with our Head of InfoSec

  • Technical Interview with two of the team

  • Final stage interview with our VP of Engineering

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Agent Platform
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

We build the engineering foundations that enable AI agents to work with enterprise tools and workflows.

Our work focuses on the Agent Platform, which coordinates agent execution and provides controlled access to tools and execution environments. Our platform directly powers the Celonis Context Model, meaning we work as a product team in close collaboration with product managers and other roles rather than an infrastructure team. Expect to work close to the end-user experience, shipping tangible product improvements in rapid iteration loops.

The Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services that serve the platform with the AI capabilities they need to perform useful work.

You will own complex features from understanding the problem and defining the technical approach through implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement. The work combines Python development, asynchronous execution, data processing, and practical application of large language models.

You will help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions, balance delivery with maintainability, and turn evolving requirements into dependable software.

The work you'll do:

  • Build agent execution capabilities: Develop services for agent sessions, execution state, streaming responses, tool integrations, and controlled execution environments.
  • Design for reliable execution: Handle concurrency, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and recovery so that long-running operations behave predictably.
  • Protect customer data and actions: Implement authorization, tenant isolation, input validation, and appropriate controls around agent access to tools.
  • Own complex features through delivery: Clarify requirements with stakeholders, document design choices, break work into manageable increments, and follow through to production.
  • Measure and improve quality: Develop automated tests and evaluations, investigate failures, and improve latency, resource usage, and operational visibility.
  • Strengthen the engineering foundation: Refactor complex code where needed, improve development and deployment tooling, and contribute reusable APIs and libraries.
  • Help the team succeed: Review code, share knowledge, support less experienced engineers, and work with product and engineering partners to define success.

The qualifications you'll need:

  • Substantial professional experience building and operating backend software with Python, typically 5+ years, with demonstrated ownership of complex features or services.
  • Proven track record in technical architecture, high-level software design, and scalable system patterns.
  • Practical experience deploying agentic frameworks, machine learning models, or supporting backend ML infrastructure.
  • Experience developing production APIs using FastAPI or a comparable framework.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting services in a cloud environment, using containers, CI/CD, logs, metrics, and tracing.
  • Ability to work through ambiguous requirements, explain technical tradeoffs, and balance customer needs with long-term system health.
  • Clear communication in English and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical colleagues (German is a plus).
  • Interest in building dependable AI applications and the ability to learn new tools and concepts as the field evolves.

Experience That Would Be a Plus:

  • Building applications with LLMs, tool calling, agent orchestration, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Evaluating agent behavior using representative datasets and regression checks.
  • Working on multi-tenant SaaS systems, authorization boundaries, sandboxed execution, or defenses against prompt injection.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as Pydantic AI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, message queues, object storage, and Kubernetes.

You do not need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering judgment, ownership, and the ability to learn.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis

· Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack

Your Role💻

As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. About the Role

How will I use AI at Roku?

We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

Build systems ( itBake/Yocto preferred)

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

You’ll contribute to IMPECT’s internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation. You’ll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation. In addition, you’ll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT’s applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.

We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain Angular web applications
  • Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
  • Design and implement database schema
  • Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
  • Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
  • Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
  • Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
  • Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • At least 5 years of software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.
  • Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
  • Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Other Requirements:

  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter.
  • Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.
  • Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability 
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

Tech Stack:

Agentic tooling and automated workflows are embedded across our software development lifecycle, from design and coding through to testing, review and release, and we are building our own software factory, using services such as Claude to automate and accelerate how our engineers work.

On the back end, we build highly scalable, performant distributed services in Scala, capable of processing huge volumes of data. Our services are built on the Typelevel ecosystem (Cats, Cats Effect and fs2) and Apache Pekko, and we apply techniques such as event sourcing and CQRS in our persistence layer, giving us scalable datastores, flexible enough to meet the varied requirements of our customers. Our front end is built with Angular, TypeScript and Signals and is designed to be highly extensible, with AI agents accelerating how we build UI components and Playwright underpinning our component and integration testing. We also use Python for our client SDKs, enabling data scientists and engineers to work with the Platform from notebooks and data science environments.

  • Take a big picture approach to solving problems, considering security, reliability and how solutions fit within the wider system

  • Have experience owning significant pieces of work through the full engineering lifecycle and into a live SaaS environment, and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving setting

  • Enjoy mentoring others and can communicate complex technical ideas clearly to engineers and stakeholders

Experience in the following would be beneficial:

  • Building large-scale data processing and ETL/analytics pipelines with Apache Spark, ideally on managed cloud platforms such as GCP Dataproc, Azure Databricks or AWS EMR

  • Improving data quality through cleansing, parsing and standardisation, and indexing data into search technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

  • DevOps tooling and practices such as Infra-as-Code, containerisation, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and delivering software that runs both on-premise and as a service (automation is something we’re passionate about, and we even have a dedicated Developer Tooling team)

  • Building or extending AI-enabled developer tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers or automated review workflows

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

What You'll Be Doing 🚀

  • Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges.

  • Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models.

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

You also bring depth in at least one of:

  • Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems.

  • Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production.

Technologies We Use 💻

  • Python, Go

  • AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript)

  • GCP, BigQuery, Looker

  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus

  • GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Claude Code

  • Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design


Our interviewing process 🪜

  • Intro call with the hiring manager

  • Live coding challenge solving a problem

  • A take home case study, followed by a discussion

  • On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

🔍 Want to learn more?
