title: Senior Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Tide is one app with many products for small businesses: business accounts, payments, credit, insurance, invoicing, accounting and more. Over 2 million members across the UK, India, Germany and France use it to run their businesses.

Our Product Design team designs every part of that experience. Designers work inside cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers, Engineers, UX Writers and Researchers, and we encourage designers to move between teams so they keep learning and growing.

We’re at an exciting point. Under our new design structure, we’re raising the bar on craft, making the whole app feel like one connected experience, and building a stronger design community. We’re also building a senior individual contributor track in design for the first time. This role is one of the first, so you’ll help define what design looks like at Tide.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Senior Staff Product Designer, you’ll work on our most complex and high-visibility problems. You’ll report directly to the Head of Design and work across teams rather than sitting in one, moving to wherever the biggest design challenge is.

Projects include continuing to evolve our AI solutions, helping shape the next phase of our app architecture and taking lead on new 0 to 1 initiatives. You will also help actively raise the quality bar across the entire design organization.

We’re open to designers operating at Senior-Staff or Principal level. Titles vary across companies, so what matters most is the strength of your craft, the quality of your thinking, and the impact you’ve had.

As Senior Staff Product Designer, you will:

  • Lead multiple projects end to end. Go from early discovery and concepts to prototyping, testing and handover to engineering, working hands-on in Figma.
  • Shape the experience strategy. Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to turn messy, ambiguous problems into a clear design vision, priorities and roadmap.
  • Connect the app. Work with design leads across Tide to create shared patterns and foundations, as Tide app continues to evolve across 55+ products. 
  • Raise the craft bar. Set the example for quality, mentor other designers, and introduce better ways of working.
  • Pioneer AI. Shape how AI shows up in our product, and how we use AI in our own design process, from ideas to code.
  • Measure and iterate. Ship, learn from real member behaviour, and improve. You’d rather launch, learn and refine than wait for perfection.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • 12+ years in product design, with experience operating at Staff level or above (or equivalent scope) in a SaaS, fintech or scale-up environment
  • A strong track record designing intuitive mobile & web experiences
  • Experience leading complex, cross-team work, such as a product or platform redesign or new 0-to-1 product and iterations.
  • Expert-level craft across the full product lifecycle: from early discovery, research, and concepting to prototyping, validation, and design-to-code handover
  • Systems thinking: you design across features and touchpoints, not just single screens
  • Business acumen: you balance member needs with commercial goals, and speed with quality
  • Comfort with ambiguity and change
  • Confidence working with senior leaders. You can present, shape, defend and adapt your ideas with VPs and SVPs.
  • Open, collaborative style: you enjoy discussing work in the open, being challenged, and working closely with Product Managers and Engineers

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (UK)
descriptionHtml:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

Dragos is seeking a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) to serve as a trusted advisor to some of the most critical infrastructure and industrial organisations across Europe.

In this role, you will help customers maximise the value of their investment in Dragos solutions while strengthening their Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity capabilities. You will work closely with cybersecurity, engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders to understand business priorities, operational challenges, and security objectives, translating these into practical, measurable outcomes.

Through advisory engagements, goal-setting workshops, technical enablement, and ongoing guidance, you will help customers operationalise key use cases, improve cyber resilience, and mature their OT security programmes over time.

This role combines deep OT/ICS cybersecurity expertise with strong relationship management and consulting skills. You will help customers navigate complex security challenges, align initiatives with recognised industry frameworks, and build sustainable programmes that reduce risk and improve operational resilience.

As the voice of the customer, you will provide valuable feedback and insights to internal teams, helping shape product innovation, customer experience improvements, and future capabilities. Success in this role requires technical credibility, business acumen, curiosity, resilience, and a genuine passion for helping customers achieve meaningful outcomes while advancing Dragos' mission of Safeguarding Civilisation.

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and technical advocate for assigned customer accounts. 
  • Lead customer onboarding and adoption, helping customers maximise the value of their investment in Dragos.
  • Facilitate goal-setting workshops and planning sessions to align platform capabilities with customer objectives and success measures.
  • Guide customers in the operationalisation of key use cases and integration of Dragos into existing security and operational workflows. 
  • Provide ongoing technical guidance, best practices, and recommendations to improve platform utilisation and cybersecurity maturity. 
  • Monitor customer health, platform adoption, and utilisation trends, proactively identifying risks to customer success and value realisation. 
  • Support the development and execution of engagement and recovery plans for at-risk or underutilised accounts. 
  • Conduct regular account reviews and value realisation discussions, demonstrating progress against customer goals and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. 
  • Deliver technical enablement, workshops, and training to improve customer proficiency and self-sufficiency. 
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and Sales teams to deliver seamless customer experience and represent the voice of the customer.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for OT cybersecurity topics, contributing to customer workshops, QBR and executive briefings.
  • Travel throughout the European region as required (up to 30%).

Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years' experience working in OT, ICS, or critical infrastructure environments, with knowledge of ICS, SCADA, or DCS systems. 
  • Experience in security operations, threat detection, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, or related cybersecurity disciplines. 
  • Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity, OT/ICS environments, cyber risk management, and security operations workflows. 
  • Experience applying frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF, SANS ICS Five Critical Controls, CAF, the Cyber Resilience Act, and other relevant European frameworks to improve cybersecurity maturity and customer outcomes. 
  • Ability to engage and influence both technical and business stakeholders, delivering workshops, training, and advisory engagements. 
  • Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills, with a customer-first mindset focused on driving value realisation. 
  • Familiarity with critical infrastructure regulations and cyber resilience requirements across Europe is highly regarded.
  • Multilingual candidates, particularly those speaking German and other European languages, are highly preferred.

Compensation: 

  • OTE:  £88,000.00
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Service Designer

Technology Transformation practice

Consultant/Senior Consultant

About Us

You want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? We are growing and are looking for people to join our team. You'll be part of an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment of 300.000 employees. Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready?

The Team

Our Technology Transformation practice is helping organizations all over the world transform their operating model to succeed in the new normal – scaling up digitization and cloud transformation programs, optimizing costs, and accelerating value realization. Our solutions focus on the big-ticket value items on the C-Suite agenda, providing a deep link between business and IT to help you lead with influence beyond the back-office remit. For more information and details on the services we provide and the clients we serve, please visit or careers page.

The role

As a Service Designer at Infosys Consulting, you help our clients understand what their customers really need and turn those insights into services that work seamlessly across every touchpoint – digital and physical, frontstage and backstage. You make the entire customer journey smooth and enjoyable for users and successful for the business, driving satisfaction, retention and long-term growth.

You bring a solid foundation in human-centered design, CX strategy and digital transformation, and you understand how service experiences connect to the client’s marketing, CRM, customer care and operations. Working directly with client stakeholders, you lay the groundwork for a holistic service and CX strategy, establish standards, processes and ways of working, and build the client’s own capability.

Key Responsibilities :

Service & CX Strategy

  • Define a service vision and CX strategy that delivers consistent, high-quality experiences across all channels and aligns with business objectives.
  • Translate business goals into service principles, experience goals and measurable KPIs (e.g. NPS, CSAT, CES, retention)
  • Map and re-orchestrate the service ecosystem along the customer life cycle using ecosystem maps and stakeholder maps
  • Develop service propositions and value propositions together with business owners
  • Define the roadmap of guidelines, trainings and key projects needed to realize the strategy
  • Shape the target operating model and team structure for service design and CX on the client side
  • Work with leadership to embed Service Design and Design Thinking in the company’s culture

Insight Management & Customer Understanding

  • Turn customer data, research and behavior into actionable insights in collaboration with research and analytics teams.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into personas, jobs-to-be-done, mental models and insight statements
  • Use NPS, satisfaction and operational metrics to assess the current experience and spot patterns, trends and pain points
  • Present data-driven recommendations that improve retention and satisfaction
  • Set up an insight and requirements pipeline that continuously feeds product, channel and solution owners

Journey Mapping & Service Blueprinting

  • Make the end-to-end service visible and design how it should work in future – for customers, employees and systems.
  • Facilitate as-is customer journey maps and service blueprints across channels, including frontstage, backstage and supporting processes
  • Identify moments of truth, breakpoints and improvement opportunities online and offline
  • Design to-be journeys and blueprints across multiple applications as well as in depth for specific services
  • Connect journey and blueprint work to process, organizational and technology changes

Co-Creation, Ideation & Prototyping

  • Lead the double-diamond process from problem framing to tested solution together with clients and their customers.
  • Plan and facilitate co-creation workshops, design sprints and ideation sessions with cross-functional teams
  • Frame problems with How-Might-We questions, opportunity areas and design challenges
  • Create and test service prototypes – storyboards, service walkthroughs, desktop walkthroughs, role-play and click dummies
  • Run experiments and pilots, measure impact and iterate towards scalable solutions

Service Standards & Guidelines

  • Initiate and support standards that ensure high service quality across websites, native apps, phone, email, chat and in-person support.
  • Create service design playbooks, journey and blueprint libraries, persona sets and design principles
  • Establish service standards, benchmarks and end-to-end testing approaches
  • Set up quality assurance processes to monitor and evaluate customer interactions

Requirements

  • Degree in Service Design, Interaction/UX Design, Design Management, Business, Psychology or a related field
  • Consultant: 3–5 years of experience in service design, CX or UX, ideally in consulting or an in-house design team
  • Senior Consultant: 5–8 years of experience, including leading projects and client workstreams
  • Hands-on command of core service design methods: stakeholder and ecosystem mapping, personas, customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, co-creation and service prototyping
  • Experience with design research (interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, diary studies) and synthesis (affinity mapping, insight clustering)
  • Ability to link customer insight with business objectives, KPIs and business cases
  • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management skills, from operational teams to C-level
  • Confident with collaboration and visualisation tools such as Miro, Mural, Figma or similar
  • Ability to integrate AI tools throughout every stage of the design process, from research and insight generation to ideation, prototyping, testing, and service optimization, enhancing both efficiency and innovation.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills in both GERMAN and ENGLISH

Preferred/Desirable experience

  • Experience in CX strategy and digital transformation programmes
  • Knowledge of adjacent areas on the client side: marketing, CRM and loyalty, customer care and contact centres
  • Experience designing omnichannel services that combine digital and physical touchpoints
  • Preferred tool proficiency: Miro, Figma, FigJam, Claude Code
  • Familiarity with CX metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES) and Voice-of-Customer programmes
  • Exposure to agile delivery, Lean UX and product operating models
  • Experience applying AI and GenAI in services or CX operations
  • Experience building design capabilities, playbooks or design systems at client organisations
  • Industry experience in e.g. retail, automotive, financial services, telecommunications, utilities or the public sector
  • Certification in Design Thinking, Service Design (e.g. SDN) or agile methods

Level differentiation

Consultant: delivers service design work within a project, applies methods confidently and facilitates workshops with guidance

Senior Consultant: owns workstreams and client relationships, shapes the approach, coaches junior team members and contributes to proposals and business development

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for individuals who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

title: Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineer

UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.devwas founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Owning Production Reliability & Scale

We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, you will share ownership of our production environment as a whole—keeping SourceFS fast, observable, and rock-solid under heavy real-world workloads. You will have the autonomy to chase the most critical problems across the stack, with a strong initial focus on performance, where many of our biggest scaling challenges live today. Using your deep knowledge of the Linux stack and the available tools, you’ll root cause bugs, eliminate tail-latency spikes, and turn deep telemetry insights into lasting reliability and ultra performant builds.

What You’ll Work On

  • End-to-End Production Reliability & Root-Cause Analysis: Share ownership for production health—leading deep-dive investigations into anomalies, resource contention, OOMs, and partnering with core engineers to turn findings into lasting systemic fixes.

  • Performance Diagnostics & Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, network, and disk I/O bottlenecks in production and benchmark environments.

  • Linux Systems & Storage Tuning: Analyze and tune Linux kernel parameters, filesystems, caching layers, and cloud compute/storage configurations to improve reliability, eliminate tail latency, and maximize I/O throughput.

  • Observability & Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust SLIs/SLOs, telemetry dashboards, and reproducible benchmarking suites to track overall system health and catch regressions under heavy concurrent workloads.

  • Scaling Build Infrastructure: Optimize compute, caching, and ephemeral storage utilization across massive build workloads (Android, Yocto, and beyond) running on high-core cloud environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Holistic SRE & Linux Systems Mindset: You approach systems as a whole and bring deep, hands-on expertise troubleshooting, observing, and tuning Linux infrastructure at scale. You confidently use OS tracing tools like perf, eBPF and flamegraphs to isolate root causes across CPU, memory, and I/O layers, paired with strong systems programming skills (C, Rust).

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale CI/CD systems, build infrastructure, or I/O-heavy distributed workloads.

  • Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality—you see a friction point in production or the developer journey and don’t stop until it’s resolved.

  • Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

  • Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant engineer, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate—someone who leads with kindness.

  • Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

 

A Note on Our Search

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev?

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

  • Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

  • Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

  • Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

Experience in delivering digital services for the UK government is highly valuable for many of our projects. Therefore, familiarity with the GDS toolkit will be beneficial.

Up to £450 per day (working inside IR35)

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Actuator Control & Locomotion), Intern
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.

This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night.

What You'll Work On

  • Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation.

  • Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

  • Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data.

  • Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics.

  • Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: experiment tracking, version control, reproducible training runs.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a motivated robotics or machine learning student excited to apply academic training in a fast-moving startup. You'll be surrounded by a team that values learning, experimentation, and building things that actually work in the real world.

Your Background

  • Currently pursuing a PhD or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related field.

  • Hands-on experience training reinforcement learning policies for robot control, in simulation or on hardware.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo.

  • Solid grounding in robot dynamics and control.

  • Good coding skills in Python, with PyTorch (or JAX).

  • Comfortable using Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience deploying learned policies on physical robots, ideally legged.

  • Experience with low-level actuator, motor, or joint control.

  • C++ and ROS 2 experience.

  • Publications at top robotics or ML venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Stage Online Marketing | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Online Marketing Stagiair(e) bij Flagship Amsterdam krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan de online zichtbaarheid van deze unieke rondvaartorganisatie en al haar labels, zoals Flagship Bike Tours, Aemstelland en Voyage. Je houdt je bezig met het verbeteren van onze websites, het ondersteunen van online campagnes en het analyseren van resultaten. Praktisch

Startdatum: februari 2027;

Type stage: meewerkstage;

Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam.

  • Ervaring met SEO, online advertenties of websitebeheer is mooi meegenomen.


Over Flagship Amsterdam

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: Steuerungstechniker:in Kundendienst
descriptionHtml:
Würenlos (AG) · 100 % · ca. 50 % bei Kunden vor Ort

Bei der AKSA Würenlos AG entwickeln, realisieren und betreuen wir hochverfügbare Notstromlösungen – individuell, technisch anspruchsvoll und geschäftskritisch für unsere Kunden.

Unsere Steuerungstechniker:innen für Projekte begleiten eine Anlage bis zur Abnahme. Danach übernimmst Du: Du verantwortest die Steuerungstechnik unserer Anlagen im Betrieb – bei Retrofit-Projekten, Änderungen und im Service. Dafür brauchst Du dasselbe Können wie im Projektgeschäft, nur setzt Du es an bestehenden Anlagen ein, die oft anders aussehen als auf dem Plan.

Wenn Du nicht einfach Störungen beheben, sondern Ursachen verstehen, Lösungen konzipieren und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, bist Du bei uns richtig.

Deine Aufgaben

Elektrokonstruktion

  • Erstellung komplexer Stromlaufpläne für Retrofit-Projekte und Anlagenänderungen (eXs-CAD) gemäss Konzept

  • Aufnahme und Nachführung bestehender Schemas, auch bei Fremdfabrikaten und lückenhafter Dokumentation

Automationsplanung

  • Verantwortung für Steuerungslösungen in Retrofit- und Service-Projekten

  • Unterstützung bei der Erarbeitung von Retrofit-Konzepten inkl. Umschaltplan und Rückfallebene, abgestimmt mit dem Projektleiter

  • Integration von Notstromanlagen in übergeordnete Systeme (SPS, Leitsysteme, Gebäudeautomation)

Steuerungssysteme

  • Programmierung und Anpassung von SPS-Programmen, auch in fremden und älteren Systemen

  • Parametrierung und Optimierung von Generatorsteuerungen (z. B. ComAp, Cummins PCC)

  • Anpassung und Optimierung von Netzersatz-, Synchronisations- und Lastmanagementfunktionen

Service, Tests und Inbetriebnahme

  • Analyse umfassender Störungen vor Ort und Ableitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

  • Test von Änderungen im Prüffeld und Inbetriebnahme nach Retrofits und Anlagenänderungen beim Kunden

  • Durchführung anspruchsvoller Prüfungen der Steuerungs- und Elektrotechnik

Dokumentation und Standards

  • Sicherstellung einer sauberen, nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation aller Änderungen

  • Rückmeldung von Erfahrungen aus dem Feld ans Engineering zur Weiterentwicklung von Standards

Team und Zusammenarbeit

  • Übernahme der Anlagen von den Projekt-Steuerungstechniker:innen nach der Abnahme

  • Fachliche Unterstützung der Servicetechniker:innen bei steuerungstechnischen Fragen

  • Technische Ansprechperson für Kunden, Betreiber und Projektleitende im After-Sales

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automation oder vergleichbar

  • Weiterbildung (z.B. HF Systemtechnik oder ähnlich) von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerungstechnik im industriellen Umfeld

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Inbetriebnahme, Fehlersuche und im Umgang mit komplexen Anlagen

  • Erfahrung im Schema-Engineering (vorzugsweise eXs) – Du erstellst Schemas, nicht nur Änderungen

  • Erfahrung mit SPS-Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit Umbauten oder Modernisierungen bestehender Anlagen

  • Erfahrung mit Generatorsteuerungen von Vorteil

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration von Anlagen und Systemen

  • Gute Kenntnisse von Stromnetzen, Netzformen und Netzverhalten

  • Sicheres und kundenorientiertes Auftreten

  • Lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Qualitätsbewusstsein

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch- und Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

  • Reisebereitschaft ca. 50 %

  • Pikettdienst

Was Dich auszeichnet

  • Systemisches Denken – Du erkennst Zusammenhänge, auch an Anlagen, die Du nicht selbst gebaut hast

  • Analytische Stärke – Du findest Ursachen, nicht nur Symptome

  • Hands-on & pragmatisch – Du bist gerne dort, wo die Anlage steht

  • Ruhe beim Kunden – Du behältst den Überblick, wenn etwas nicht läuft, und erklärst verständlich, was Du tust

  • Umsetzungsstärke – Du bringst Dinge zu Ende

Bist Du das?

Du bist nicht der Typ, der nur tauscht, was kaputt ist. Du verstehst, warum eine Anlage so aufgebaut ist – und sorgst dafür, dass sie auch nach Jahren im Betrieb zuverlässig läuft. Bei uns arbeitest Du an Anlagen, bei denen es zählt, dass sie wirklich laufen.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Technik, die zählt:

Du arbeitest an Notstromsystemen, die im Ernstfall funktionieren müssen – kein Spielplatz, sondern echte Verantwortung.

Abwechslung:

Einsätze beim Kunden und Engineering im Haus, etwa zur Hälfte.

Stabilität trifft Wachstum:

Ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit klarer Richtung – und gleichzeitig genug Dynamik, um Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.

You will join us as our Strategic Sourcing Manager, reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, owning strategic sourcing across the categories that make up our robot's bill of materials. You'll build and lead supplier relationships from early development through mass production, working closely with engineering to make sure sourcing decisions keep pace with the product as it matures. title: Supplier Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role

In a context of strong growth and increasing industrial production volumes, we are looking for our future Supplier Quality Engineer to support the development of our industrial partner network and ensure the quality of our products throughout the entire supply chain.

You will act as the main quality point of contact for our strategic industrial partners, both in France and internationally, particularly those involved in the serial production of our drones. You will also work closely with suppliers of critical components (batteries, electronic boards, etc.), with one key objective: to raise their quality standards and maturity levels to support our industrial scale-up.

This is a highly hands-on role, involving regular travel to production sites in France and abroad.

Key Responsibilities

Supplier Quality & Partner Development

  • Manage the quality performance of our portfolio of suppliers and industrial partners.

  • Deploy and ensure compliance with our quality requirements across the supplier base, in line with our internal standards and customer requirements.

  • Support the development of our industrial partners' capabilities as they scale up the production of our systems.

  • Act as the primary quality point of contact for strategic suppliers and major industrial groups.

  • Assess suppliers' quality maturity and identify areas for improvement.


Audits & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare and conduct supplier quality audits in France and internationally.

  • Identify non-conformities, perform root cause analysis, and lead corrective and preventive action plans.

  • Monitor the effectiveness of implemented actions and challenge suppliers to deliver measurable results.

  • Support suppliers in their continuous improvement and problem-solving initiatives.

  • Take part in the qualification and assessment of new suppliers.


Industrialization & Production Ramp-Up

  • Support suppliers throughout industrialization and production ramp-up phases.

  • Ensure the robustness of manufacturing processes and their ability to consistently meet quality requirements in serial production.

  • Participate in quality reviews and industrialization milestones with internal teams and external partners.

  • Anticipate quality risks associated with increasing production volumes and contribute to their mitigation.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to ensure product quality.


Performance Management & Process Development

  • Establish and monitor supplier quality performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Develop and structure processes for monitoring and evaluating the supplier base.

  • Provide regular reporting on risks, non-conformities and improvement plans.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the supplier quality management system.


Candidate Profile

  • Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Engineering, Quality Management or a related industrial discipline.

  • 3–5 years of experience in Supplier Quality, ideally in a demanding industrial environment.

  • Experience working with major industrial groups, preferably in the aerospace, defense, automotive or electronics sectors.

  • Good understanding of serial production environments and the challenges of large-scale industrialization.

  • Strong knowledge of audit methodologies, root cause analysis and problem-solving tools (8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, CAPA, etc.).

  • Ability to challenge suppliers and drive improvement plans with a demanding yet pragmatic approach.

  • Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate confidently in a professional international environment.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly within France and internationally.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and interact with a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a hands-on mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working for an aerospace or defense OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) or Tier 1 supplier.

  • Knowledge of aerospace and industrial quality standards and frameworks (EN 9100, ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, etc.).

  • Experience supporting suppliers through production ramp-up or industrial transfer phases.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes for electronic components, batteries or embedded systems.

  • Experience working in an international, multi-site environment.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing environments involving complex systems.

title: Supply Planner H/F
descriptionHtml:
At Marso, as a Supply Planner, you will make sure the right components arrive at the right time to build Marso robots. You will own supply planning end to end, from demand forecasting to purchase orders and inventory, and you will help structure the supply chain as production scales.

Responsibilities

  • Turn the production plan and demand forecasts into supply plans (MRP) for all components and subassemblies.

  • Place and track purchase orders, and secure supplier deliveries and lead times.

  • Manage inventory levels to balance component availability with working capital.

  • Anticipate and handle shortages, long lead-time items, and end-of-life components, especially electronics, by finding alternatives with engineering and purchasing.

  • Keep planning data reliable in the ERP: BOMs, lead times, safety stocks, and MOQs.

  • Build and monitor supply KPIs: on-time delivery, inventory coverage, shortages, and forecast accuracy.

  • Work closely with purchasing, industrialization, production, and finance to align supply with business goals.

Profile

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in supply planning, procurement, or supply chain, ideally in hardware, electronics, or industrial manufacturing.

  • Strong command of MRP logic and ERP tools (Odoo, SAP, NetSuite, or equivalent).

  • Experience managing complex BOMs and long lead-time components.

  • Strong analytical skills and an advanced level in Excel or Google Sheets; SQL or BI tools are a plus.

  • Organized, proactive, and calm under pressure, and you enjoy solving problems before they turn into shortages.

  • Good communication skills with suppliers and internal teams, and professional English.

  • Nice to have: experience in a scale-up or NPI-to-production environment; knowledge of electronics supply (semiconductors, PCBA); experience with S&OP processes.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant que Supply Planner, vous veillerez à ce que les bons composants arrivent au bon moment pour fabriquer les robots Marso. Vous prendrez en charge la planification des approvisionnements de bout en bout, des prévisions de la demande aux commandes et aux stocks, et vous participerez à la structuration de la supply chain à mesure que la production monte en cadence.

Missions

  • Traduire le plan de production et les prévisions de la demande en plans d’approvisionnement (MRP) pour l’ensemble des composants et sous-ensembles.

  • Passer et suivre les commandes fournisseurs, et sécuriser les livraisons et les délais.

  • Piloter les niveaux de stock pour équilibrer la disponibilité des composants et le besoin en fonds de roulement.

Profil

  • 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en planification des approvisionnements, achats ou supply chain, idéalement dans le hardware, l’électronique ou l’industrie.

  • Bonne maîtrise de la logique MRP et des ERP (Odoo, SAP, NetSuite ou équivalent).

  • Expérience de la gestion de nomenclatures complexes et de composants à long délai.

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et niveau avancé sur Excel ou Google Sheets ; SQL ou outils BI appréciés.

  • Un plus : expérience en scale-up ou en passage du NPI à la série ; connaissance des approvisionnements électroniques (semi-conducteurs, PCBA) ; expérience des processus S&OP.

title: System & Infrastructure Engineer || Linux - Windows
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a new colleague to join our Systems & Infrastructure team.

In this role, you’ll work across the full WTSS IT infrastructure. And because of what we do, that infrastructure is genuinely interesting. It’s a broad technical role where Linux, Windows, networking, scripting and many different types of hardware all come together.

Our infrastructure is essential to our daily operation. As a FinTech partner for banks, we run real-time banking and payment journeys. Day and night, we execute tests for our clients across all kinds of hardware — PCs, laptops, smartphones and tablets.

That means your work directly contributes to our technical reliability, continuity and security.

Together with two other colleagues, you’ll be responsible for keeping our environment running, maintaining it and continuously improving it. The goal is that you can fully cover for one another when needed. So we’re looking for someone who can work independently, keeps a clear overview and actually enjoys understanding multiple layers of infrastructure.

Who is WTSS?

Banks process millions of transactions every day. When something goes wrong, issues need to be found, understood and resolved quickly. That’s where we come in.

WTSS is an independent FinTech partner for international banks. We act as a safe, patient and risk-free ‘pilot customer’, so banks don’t have to test new or critical journeys on their actual customers.

We design structured test journeys — both manual and automated — across many different environments to detect issues early and help our clients understand what is really happening.

From our HQ in Rotterdam, a small and highly technical team of around 20 people works for some of the world’s largest banks.

We call ourselves ethical techies: curious technical people who enjoy breaking things in order to make them better. Incidents don’t scare us; they make us curious.

What you’ll be doing

This role is quite different from the average systems or infrastructure position. You won’t be one small part of a large DevOps transformation. The work is much more hands-on and technical — a bit like infrastructure work used to be, but without the slow-moving legacy environment.

You’ll be working on things such as:

  • Managing both Linux and Windows environments

  • Scripting with Bash and PowerShell, and improving automation processes

  • Managing and improving our network and firewall environment, including OPNsense firewalls with high-availability pairs and UniFi switches

  • Working with virtualisation and backup environments, including Proxmox VE clusters, Ceph storage and Proxmox Backup Server

In short: real, hands-on systems and infrastructure work. If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving technical problems and getting your hands dirty, your analytical brain will feel right at home here.


Do you love technology as much as we do?

You’ll join a team of people who genuinely enjoy tech. We’re the ones our families call when the printer won’t connect or the Wi-Fi starts acting strange. Some of us install a new operating system on our own laptop just for fun. On a Saturday. Voluntarily.

If you have that same curiosity for new tools, technology and figuring out how things work, we’d love to hear from you.

What you bring

  • HBO-level working and thinking ability. Your exact degree matters less to us than how you think and how quickly you learn.

  • A technical mindset that looks for solutions and enjoys solving problems, even under pressure.

  • A careful and structured way of working: you follow steps accurately and quickly notice small differences or anomalies.

  • Curiosity about hardware, banking, payments, security or FinTech is a big plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary

  • A role you simply don’t come across very often

  • Plenty of variety in a growing, tech-minded and no-nonsense team

  • A solid pension plan, travel allowance and work-from-home allowance

title: Technical Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams, as well as memory design and strategic partnership teams, you gather validated information to create key materials, including product and specification documents in line with system architects and product managers, datasheets, reference manuals, whitepapers, application notes, technical blogs, and technical presentation decks.

In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences.

Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market.

Technical writing/content development | primary focus

  • Write technical documentation (product, specifications..), customer-facing datasheets, reference manuals.

  • Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content.

  • Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering.

  • Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations.

  • Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders.

  • Create and coordinate high-quality technical content: website copy, product pages, whitepapers, presentations, and conference materials

Interface with Product, Architecture & Engineering

  • Work closely with the Product/Architecture team and relevant engineering experts to gather information about functionality, use cases, performance, power, bandwidth, integration and system-level trade-offs.

  • Ask probing technical questions, distinguish demonstrated results from targets, and turn source material into precise, readable drafts.

  • Coordinate technical review and approval with the relevant subject-matter owners and marketing lead before external release; maintain the traceability and versioning of technical claims.

Technical marketing & enablement

  • Participate in first-level customer technical meetings to present and support technical specifications, architecture choices, and performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs to system architects.

  • Support early customer engagements with tailored messaging and technical storytelling

  • Produce technically sound product and competitive comparisons that support the positioning and priorities defined by the Marketing Lead.

  • Develop technical content for product pages, demonstrations, customer briefings, partner presentations and Business Development enablement.

  • Support agreed conference submissions and product milestones with the technical material needed by speakers and customer-facing teams.

  • Support presence at industry events, conferences, and partner demos

Content execution & quality

  • Own timelines, drafts, review loops, version control and delivery for assigned content; flag missing inputs and risks early.

  • Maintain a curated, approved repository of technical facts, diagrams, reusable explanations and reference materials.

  • Demonstrate adaptability to a fast-moving startup environment and evolving targets.


Training background : Degree in electronics, microelectronics, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience is also welcome.

Relevant experience: Practical experience in technical writing, technical marketing, applications engineering, product engineering, or another engineering-facing communication role. Suitable seniority may range from an emerging independent contributor to an experienced specialist.

Technical / industry knowledge: Solid understanding of semiconductor hardware and system concepts; familiarity with memory architectures, SoCs, AI accelerators, advanced packaging or compute infrastructure is strongly valued. Ability to understand performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs and data from technical experts is essential.

Writing / communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate effectively in meetings, structure detailed technical arguments, edit precisely, and tailor content to technical audiences. Evidence of authored documentation or published technical content is a strong plus.

Design & Visual Content Independence: Must be capable of creating compelling technical content, diagrams, and visual assets independently (e.g. Powerpoint, Google slides, Canva, Gimp..) without relying on external agencies, and should be well-versed with office productivity tools and presentation software.

Interpersonal skills and ways of working: Curious, rigorous, comfortable challenging ambiguous input; proactive in working with engineers; strong prioritization, commitment to deadlines and careful technical-review discipline.


Other considerations: Portfolio or writing samples preferred. You should be able to write strong first drafts independently, while keeping in mind that final product definitions and external claims are handled by the product and marketing leads.

Generative AI Tools: Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflows to enhance content creation productivity and efficiency.

title: Technical Product Manager - Code Quality
descriptionHtml:
Position description

As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents.

The team:

You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence.

What will you own:

  • The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

  • Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete.

  • New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code.

  • Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed.

  • Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions.


What you will do
You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

  • Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

  • Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

  • Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

  • Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development


    • Experience and qualifications

    Must-haves

  • 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development.

  • 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment.

  • Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development.

  • Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty.

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

    • Nice to have

  • Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem.

  • Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work.

  • Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins.

  • Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences.

    • If you meet most of the must-haves and this work interests you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn’t match every point.


    Benefits of Working with Sonar:
  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.
  • We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.
  • Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.
  • Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.
  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

title: Technical Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Technical Support helps customers and internal teams get the most from Airwallex’s products after integration. You’ll investigate complex technical issues, turn recurring problems into practical guidance, and help coordinate clear responses when incidents affect customers.

  • Support developers, merchants and internal teams with post-integration issues, providing technical guidance, consulting and best practices.

  • Investigate issues across code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints by designing and running test scenarios.

  • Configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products to reproduce issues and support effective resolution.

  • Communicate technical issues clearly to customers and internal teams, identifying irregularities and unexpected behaviour in Airwallex products and services.

  • Create practical technical resources, including sample code, log-searching guidance and FAQs, for customers and internal teams.

  • Coordinate communication and responses between clients, internal stakeholders and senior leadership during global incident management.

  • Support occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage as the business requires.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in programming, technical support, implementation or a related role.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and appropriately with customers and internal teams.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong prioritisation, organisation and attention to detail when managing multiple urgent issues in parallel.

  • Sufficient technical knowledge to communicate effectively with Engineering and Product teams.

  • A strong commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

  • The ability to learn new technologies and products quickly.

  • Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, PHP, C#, JavaScript or shell scripting.

  • Familiarity with web technologies, HTTP and HTTPS.

  • Experience with REST, JSON, SOAP and SQL.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk and Grafana.

  • Willingness to participate in occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage.

Preferred

  • Experience in ecommerce, payments or fintech.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Technischer Projektmanager (m/w/d) – Industrial Innovation & Systems Integration
descriptionHtml:
Gemeinsam aus industriellen Herausforderungen neue Lösungen entwickeln.

Wie gestalten wir die Fabrik der Zukunft – mit zuverlässigeren Produktionsprozessen, intelligenter Automatisierung, höherer Effizienz und flexibleren Fertigungssystemen? Welche Technologien schaffen dabei einen echten Mehrwert und wie entstehen daraus funktionierende Lösungen?

Beim Smart Systems Hub beantworten wir solche Fragen gemeinsam mit Industrieunternehmen, Entwicklern und Technologiepartnern. In interdisziplinären Teams entwickeln und erproben wir innovative Lösungen – von der ersten Idee bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototypen.

Dafür suchen wir dich: einen technisch versierten Projektmanager (m/w/d), der industrielle Problemstellungen versteht, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringt und technische Innovationsprojekte mitgestaltet und vorantreibt.

Über uns

Der Smart Systems Hub in Dresden ist ein Co-Innovationszentrum für industrielle Automatisierung und Digitalisierung. Gemeinsam mit Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Technologiepartnern entwickeln und erproben wir neue Lösungen für die vernetzte Produktion.

Unsere Projekte verbinden Technologien aus den Bereichen Software, Hardware, Industrial IoT, Datenökosysteme, Robotik und künstliche Intelligenz.

Deine Rolle bei uns

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Industriekunden, Engineering und Technologiepartnern. Dabei verbindest du technisches Projektmanagement mit Requirements Engineering, Systemverständnis und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.

Dein Arbeitsalltag ist vielfältig: Mal begleitest du ein mehrmonatiges Entwicklungsprojekt, mal konzipierst du einen Technologiesprint, baust gemeinsam mit dem Team einen Demonstrator auf oder unterstützt einen dreitägigen Thin[gk]athon.

Deine Aufgaben in der technischen Projektleitung

  • Industrielle Entwicklungsprojekte leiten: Du koordinierst gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklungsteams mehrmonatige Projekte mit passenden agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensweisen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und Validierung.

  • Technologiesprints gestalten: Du strukturierst industrielle Use Cases, bewertest technologische Lösungsoptionen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams erste Lösungsansätze und Prototypen.

  • Demonstratoren aufbauen: Du konzipierst mit unseren Technologiepartnern funktionsfähige End-to-End-Demonstratoren und integrierst dabei auch selbst Hardware, Software, Schnittstellen und bestehende Open-Source-Komponenten.

  • Co-Innovationsformate begleiten: Du bereitest Thin[gk]athons und Hackathons technisch vor, unterstützt Entwicklungsteams und hilfst, innerhalb kurzer Zeit erste funktionierende Lösungen zu realisieren.

  • Anforderungen und Architekturen erarbeiten: Du übersetzt industrielle Problemstellungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklern in technische Anforderungen, Systemarchitekturen, Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse.

  • Technologien bewerten: Du recherchierst geeignete Lösungen, vergleichst Standardprodukte und Individualentwicklungen und beurteilst deren Machbarkeit, Integrationsfähigkeit und Entwicklungsaufwand.

  • Entwicklungsteams fachlich begleiten: Du diskutierst technische Entscheidungen auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialisten, erkennst Integrationsrisiken und unterstützt die Umsetzung und Bewertung der Ergebnisse.

  • Projekte voranbringen: Du koordinierst Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Projektpartner, verbindest iterative Entwicklungszyklen mit verlässlicher Planung und sorgst für eine transparente, lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich – alternativ entsprechende praktische Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung in der agilen oder hybriden Leitung technischer Entwicklungs-, Integrations- oder Innovationsprojekte sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes technisches Systemverständnis und Kenntnisse moderner industrieller IT-/OT-Architekturen – vom Shopfloor über Maschinensteuerungen, SCADA und MES bis zu ERP-, Edge- und Cloud-Systemen. Du kannst deren Zusammenspiel sowie Hardware-, Software- und Datenarchitekturen schnell erfassen und verständlich darstellen.

  • Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering und die Fähigkeit, aus Kundenanforderungen technische Lösungsansätze abzuleiten.

  • Solide Grundlagen in Softwareentwicklung, industrieller Netzwerk- und IoT-Konnektivität sowie Systemintegration. Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Softwarekomponenten, APIs und Schnittstellen und kannst bestehende Frameworks und Open-Source-Bausteine nutzen, um einfache Anwendungen und technische Prototypen selbst umzusetzen.

  • Technologische Neugier, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der praktischen Umsetzung. Du kannst auch bei unklaren oder widersprüchlichen Anforderungen strukturiert und handlungsfähig bleiben, Annahmen überprüfen und Lösungswege an neue Erkenntnisse anpassen. Du nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und kannst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten.

  • Deutsch (C1/Muttersprache) und Englisch (fließend)

Das wäre zusätzlich hilfreich

Besonders hilfreich ist, wenn du Technologien aus den folgenden Bereichen fachlich einordnen, ihre Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Grenzen bewerten und auf industrielle Anwendungsfälle übertragen kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit einzelnen Technologien ist ein Plus – tiefes Spezialwissen in allen Bereichen erwarten wir nicht.

  • Industrial IoT & Embedded Systems: Sensorik, Mikrocontroller wie ESP32, industrielle Kommunikationsprotokolle wie OPC UA und MQTT sowie Maschinen- und Anlagenintegration.

  • Software & Rapid Prototyping: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Open-Source-Frameworks und -Bibliotheken wie Angular, React oder Bootstrap sowie Node-RED, REST APIs, Docker und Cloud-Dienste wie AWS oder Azure.

  • Industrielle Zukunftstechnologien: Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Datenräume und Manufacturing-X, Robotik, Simulation oder digitale Zwillinge.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Abwechslungsreiche Innovationsprojekte mit Industrieunternehmen, unter anderem aus Halbleiterfertigung, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau.

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Technologien praktisch zu erproben und gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Spezialisten in die Anwendung zu bringen.

  • Ein interdisziplinäres Team, ein starkes Technologie- und Industrienetzwerk und viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Gestaltung.

Benefits

Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns von Anfang an wohlfühlst — fachlich, persönlich und im Arbeitsalltag. Deshalb bieten wir dir neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz auch attraktive Zusatzleistungen und flexible Rahmenbedingungen.

Flexibles Arbeiten

    Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, flexibel remote zu arbeiten und deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich zu gestalten.

  • Arbeitstechnik wird gestellt
    Die für deine Tätigkeit notwendige Arbeitstechnik stellen wir dir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung.

Urlaub & freie Tage

    Zusätzlich zu den gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen 20 Urlaubstagen erhältst du 10 vertraglich geregelte Zusatzurlaubstage. Damit stehen dir insgesamt 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr zur Verfügung.

title: Thermal Simulation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As a Thermal Simulation Engineer, you join the early team and own the thermal performance of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. From transient heat spikes during peak actuator loads to the airflow in our cooling ducts, you make sure every watt finds its way out - keeping our robots reliable under real duty cycles, not just in a demo.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Transient Thermal Analysis: Model the transient events that define real operation - peak loads, duty-cycle heat spikes and thermal soak - not just steady state.

  • CFD & Cooling Design: Simulate airflow and heat transfer through ducts, heat sinks and cooling loops, covering both active and passive cooling architectures.

  • System-Level Thermal Management: Define thermal budgets across the robot and translate them into concrete cooling requirements for the design teams.

  • Design Collaboration: Partner with the design engineers from the earliest concept stage, turning simulation insight into design decisions rather than after-the-fact checks.

  • Validation: Correlate simulation results with physical thermal testing to continuously refine model accuracy.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

Must have

  • Experience: 5+ years in thermal engineering and CFD in high-performance robotics, aerospace or automotive engineering, with a track record of cooling architectures that held up under real peak loads.

  • CFD Mastery: Expert level in CFD tools (e.g. Ansys Fluent/Icepak or comparable) for airflow and cooling analysis, validated against physical measurements.

  • Transient Thermal Simulation: Deep expertise in modeling transient thermal behavior under dynamic, high-peak-power operating conditions.

  • Cooling System Design: Practical knowledge of fan selection, duct and heat sink design and passive cooling architectures.

  • CAD Fluency: Comfortable in CAD and in coupling thermal results with structural workflows.

  • Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge mechanical, electrical and software teams, and you iterate until predicted and measured behavior match.

Nice to have

  • Battery & Electronics Cooling: Experience with liquid cooling, cold plates and thermal interface materials for batteries and compute.

  • Thermal Testing: Hands-on experience with thermal imaging, sensor logging and climate chamber tests.

  • Scripting & Automation: Python or similar to automate pre- and post-processing.

  • Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.
