title: VAT/Indirect Tax Manager
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Payments, e-money and credit throw up some of the most interesting VAT questions in financial services. Add new markets, new entities and new products launching every few months, and you have a genuinely complex indirect tax picture. You will be the go-to person for VAT across the Group, reporting to the Head of Tax and owning the full compliance cycle end to end.

This is an early, high-ownership role in a tax function that is still being built. You will work closely with the Head of Tax and external advisers on technical questions, support the wider tax agenda and have a direct line of sight from your work to the business moving faster and cleaner.

What you'll build and own

  • Own the VAT returns end to end: prepare, review and submit UK (MTD) and Irish filings, and oversee indirect tax filings in Canada, Australia, Nigeria, the US and other jurisdictions with local advisers as the Group expands.

  • Maintain and document the VAT treatment for every product line, including the financial services exemption for payments, remittance, e-money and credit, agreed with the Head of Tax and advisers.

  • Run partial exemption calculations and input VAT recovery workings, including annual adjustments, with full reconciliation to the general ledger.

  • Spot VAT exposure early: identify the indirect tax impact of new products, markets, entities and intercompany recharges before launch, and make sure finance captures the right data.

  • Manage all correspondence with tax authorities, including audits and disclosures, coordinating advisers where needed.

  • Build and maintain VAT controls and documented procedures, and give the Accounts Payable team the guidance they need to keep data clean at source.

  • Support the Head of Tax on corporate tax, transfer pricing and Group tax governance, and cover the Group tax calendar during peak periods.

Your experience

  • CTA, ADIT (indirect tax) or ATT qualified, or ACA/ACCA with a clear VAT specialism.

  • 3 or more years of VAT experience in financial services, whether in-house or in practice, with hands-on partial exemption work.

  • Solid command of the VAT financial services exemption as it applies to payments, e-money and lending.

  • Hands-on UK VAT return preparation under MTD.

  • Strong analytical and reconciliation skills, Excel to a high standard, and a rigorous approach to evidence, deadlines and documentation.

  • Able to explain VAT clearly and plainly to non-specialists across finance, product and legal.

Nice to have

  • Irish VAT experience, or exposure to GST in Canada or Australia.

  • Big 4 or equivalent indirect tax background, or experience in remittance, payments or e-money businesses.

  • Understanding of transfer pricing, particularly how intercompany recharges interact with VAT recovery.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Werkstudent Financial Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Onze missie

Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

LOGEX ontvangt elke maand data vanuit ziekenhuizen. Wij hebben een grotendeels geautomatiseerd proces om op basis van de data van het ziekenhuis periodieke analyses uit te voeren en de resultaten op te leveren aan de klant. Na de oplevering kunnen de ziekenhuizen via ons online platform op een interactief dashboard de resultaten inzien. Naast het interactieve dashboard leveren we ook detail informatie op richting deze ziekenhuizen.

Elke oplevering kent echter ook maatwerk:

  • Is de data correct ingeladen?

  • Zijn de uitkomsten betrouwbaar?

  • Zijn alle onderdelen van het interactieve dashboard goed gevuld?

  • Sluiten de cijfers tussen de detailinformatie in het interactieve dashboard op elkaar aan?

  • Welke aandachtspunten moeten we communiceren richting het ziekenhuis?


Jouw rol is om het gehele proces te bewaken van de data aanlevering tot de uitkomsten in het interactieve dashboard. Jij zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat alle ziekenhuizen periodiek inzicht hebben in hun financiële resultaten.

Het team

Het Financial Analytics-team – momenteel ~40 mensen – groeit snel en is in volle gang. Het team is primair verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van financiële planning en controle van ziekenhuizen door hen met tools te ondersteunen bij o.a. duurzame portfoliobeslissingen, operationele processen en financiële overeenkomsten. Mede gedreven door de demografische ontwikkeling is er (reeds langere tijd) een sterke stijging van de zorgkosten. Om deze stijgende kosten onder controle te houden, is het essentieel om strategische portfoliobeslissingen te nemen, efficiënte zorg te bieden en duurzame financiële controle te behouden. De tools van het Financial Analytics team bieden hiervoor oplossingen.


Jouw profiel

Kan jij de onderstaande vragen met “ja” beantwoorden, dan is deze functie zeker wat voor jou!

  • Doe jij een technische HBO of universitaire bachelor?

  • Vind je het gaaf om de verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor de financiële inzichten, voorspellingen en doelmatigheidsdoorlichtingen van een groot aantal ziekenhuizen?

  • Maak jij graag deel uit van een jong en enthousiast team?

title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
01 · Why this role exists

This is not your typical student job.

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

02 · What you'll do

  • Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes.

  • Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here.

  • Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities.

  • Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers.

  • Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

03 · What you bring

  • Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar.

  • Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed.

  • Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way.

  • AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

  • Languages: Fluent German and good English.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Flexible hours: They fit around your studies.

05 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions.

  1. A mayor gives you 2 minutes. Which energy problem in their city would you tell them RIZM can help with?

  2. Research funding sounds dusty to most students, but we think it's not :) How would you convince your friends it's actually cool, in the language you'd really use with them?

After that:

  • Intro call: 15 minutes on video to get to know each other.

  • Meet the team: At our office, with the team and one of our founders. Then we decide together.

title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.
